Method: （1）设计了一种带主动表面的欠驱动夹爪：主动表面拇指可在不调整机械臂或其他手指的情况下实现书本的抓内重新定位；欠驱动手指与环境和物体建立柔顺接触；可重构结构适应不同书本配置。（2）建立夹爪运动学模型，确定平放桌面和竖放书架两种典型场景的初始抓取姿态。（3）通过对平放书本的物理模型与其同夹爪、环境交互的分析，系统优化结构参数和抓取策略。（4）开展广泛实验验证有效性。

Result: 实验验证表明：对平放薄物体（书本、纸张、布料、塑料薄膜、鼠标垫）的抓取具有强鲁棒性和适应性；对竖放书本的抓取成功率高；夹爪能够可靠完成长时间连续"抓取-放置"任务。

Conclusion: 提出了将主动表面与欠驱动柔顺性相结合的夹爪设计方案，通过运动学建模和物理交互分析优化结构与策略，在不依赖复杂控制的前提下实现了对薄物体的稳定、鲁棒抓取，显著提升了夹爪在薄物体抓取场景中的适用性和实用性。

Abstract: Robotic grippers face substantial challenges in grasping and manipulating thin objects. Most existing grippers rely on highly precise approach and grasp motions, which limits robustness and reduces applicability. This paper explores thin-object grasping using books as a representative example. Here, we propose a novel solution that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve stable grasping of thin objects without complex control. First, an underactuated gripper with an active surface is designed. The active-surface thumb performs in-hand repositioning of the target book without requiring adjustments of the robot arm or the other fingers, while the underactuated fingers establish compliant contact conditions with the environment, and the reconfigurable structure enables reliable grasping of books under different configurations. Second, we establish a kinematic model of the gripper, and determine the initial grasp postures for two representative scenarios (books lying flat on a desktop and books vertically packed in a shelf). Third, by analyzing the physical model of a book lying on a table and its interaction with the gripper and the environment, we systematically optimize the structural parameters and grasping strategy. Finally, extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed gripper and strategy. The results demonstrate strong robustness and adaptability when grasping thin objects placed flat (including books, paper, fabric, plastic film, and mouse pad), as well as a high success rate when grasping vertically packed books. Moreover, the proposed gripper can reliably complete long sequential "grasp-place" tasks.

</details>


### [238] [Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26888)
*Michele Grimaldi,Enrico Di Maria,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了Stonefish模拟器的物理与传感器接地扩展，增强了深海环境下的水动力模型、随机传感器漂移（IMU/DVL）、磁力计扰动、地形力学、压力驱动的环境变化及基于物理的水下光学，旨在更真实地模拟深海AUV/ROV/着陆器/ASV/滑翔机的行为，同时保持实时仿真能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下模拟器多强调视觉真实感而忽视物理保真度，主要聚焦浅水效应，对深海环境适用性有限且计算开销高。深海长航时导航和基于学习的自主系统常因不准确的传感器与环境模型而产生非物理伪影和过于乐观的性能评估，亟需更真实的深海模拟框架。

Method: 在Stonefish模拟器基础上引入多项物理与传感器接地增强：(1) IMU和DVL的随机漂移建模；(2) 磁力计扰动；(3) 高阶水动力学；(4) 地形力学（terramechanics）；(5) 压力驱动的环境变化；(6) 基于物理的水下光学。所有扩展保持与实时仿真兼容。

Result: 该框架能够更准确地捕捉深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和滑翔机的受力与测量行为，支持实时仿真，为深海条件下的导航、感知与自主性研究提供了实用基础。

Conclusion: 该工作将水下模拟从视觉主导推向物理与传感器保真方向，更贴近深海真实工况。尽管仍面临复杂流固耦合和完全环境随机性建模等挑战，该框架为深海导航、感知和自主性研究奠定了可行基础。

Abstract: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-driven environmental variability, and physically based underwater optics. These additions are designed to better capture the forces and measurements shaping the behavior of deep-ocean AUVs, ROVs, landers, ASVs, and gliders, while remaining compatible with real-time simulation. This work advances underwater simulation toward more representative deep-sea operating conditions, which is particularly relevant for long-duration navigation and learning-based autonomy, where inaccurate sensor and environmental models introduce non-physical artifacts and overly optimistic performance. While challenges remain, including complex fluid-structure interactions and full environmental stochasticity, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for navigation, perception, and autonomy research under deep-sea conditions.

</details>


### [239] [Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization for Underwater Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26932)
*Michele Grimaldi,Yosaku Maeda,Hitoshi Kakami,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot,Tomoya Inoue*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种接触辅助因子图定位框架，通过将机械臂吸盘接触事件建模为高置信度几何约束，并与自适应视觉里程计、目标检测及惯导-DVL传感器紧密融合，解决水下近距离海底采样任务中弱纹理平面海底导致的定位漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主水下机器人在低高度海床采样时面临严峻的定位挑战：相机下视特征平面海底导致尺度模糊、横向退化及特征跟踪不一致；而惯性-DVL融合缺乏结构漂移校正机制，难以维持长时间高精度状态估计。

Method: 提出Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization框架，核心要素包括：(1) 将吸盘式机械臂接触事件建模为高置信度因子，形成隐式闭环而无需外观识别；(2) 视觉里程计相对位姿因子和地标方位-距离因子根据内点统计自适应缩放不确定性，避免弱视觉帧破坏估计器；(3) 系统支持运动期间在线初始化；(4) 与自适应视觉里程计、学习式目标检测及机载传感器紧密融合。

Result: 在实验水池、港口及仿真环境中的实验表明，接触诱导约束显著降低轨迹漂移，并相比滤波式导航和无线接触的图优化方法提升了目标回访精度。

Conclusion: 物理交互（接触）可作为一种有效的定位原始量（localization primitive），在感知退化的水下环境中发挥关键作用，填补了视觉退化与纯惯性-DVL漂移之间的定位空白。

Abstract: Accurate state estimation for autonomous underwater vehicles performing close-range seafloor sampling remains challenging. In low-altitude operation, down-looking cameras over featureless planar seabeds produce scale ambiguity, lateral degeneracy, and inconsistent feature tracking. Meanwhile, inertial-Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) fusion alone provides no mechanism for structural drift correction. We propose a Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization framework that treats physical interaction as an informative geometric constraint within a smoothing-based localization formulation. The method tightly fuses suction-based manipulator contact events with adaptive visual odometry, learned object detections, and on-board sensors. Visual odometry relative-pose factors and landmark bearing-range factors are uncertainty-scaled according to inlier statistics to prevent visually weak frames from destabilizing the estimator, while contact events are modeled as high-confidence factors that induce implicit loop closures without appearance-based place recognition. Furthermore, the system can fully initialize online during motion. Experimental evaluation in tanks, harbor, and simulation environments demonstrates that contact-induced constraints significantly reduce trajectory drift and improve object revisit accuracy compared to filtering-based navigation and contact-free graph formulations. These results highlight the role of embodied physical interaction as a localization primitive in perception-degraded underwater environments

</details>


### [240] [4DSynth: Controllable Procedural World Synthesis for Dynamic Embodied Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26947)
*Zehao Qi,Haochen Luo,Jia-Wang Bian,Zeyu Ma,Shuyang Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 4DSynth是一个可控的程序化系统，能够从自然语言描述、蓝图掩码或单张照片生成可编辑的4D环境（含显式几何、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪状态），并基于此构建了4DSynth-Nav导航基准。实验显示两种视觉语言模型在该基准上大多任务失败，表明该系统可用于可复现、可调参的具身智能体评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要视觉多样、物理可交互且随时间变化的环境。程序化模拟器可生成大规模交互场景，4D生成器可产生动态视觉，但将两者结合到一个环境中仍需要大量人工努力，且结果难以编辑和控制以支持规模化复用。现有方法缺乏一个统一、可控且可持续生成4D环境的管线。

Method: 提出4DSynth，一个可控的程序化4D环境生成系统，支持三种输入模式（自然语言描述、蓝图掩码、单张照片），输出包含显式几何、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪状态的4D环境。多条场景生成路线共享一个基于几何的统一表示，使动画、相机规划、渲染和任务生成共用同一管线。并基于该系统构建了4DSynth-Nav导航基准，包含三个难度层级。

Result: 4DSynth-Nav基准上，两种视觉语言模型在三个难度层级中均未通过大多数任务，且在早期子任务后即停滞。程序化可控性使每个失败均可复现，每个难度轴可独立调节。

Conclusion: 该工作同时提出了可控的4D环境生成管线及其衍生的可扩展基准，为开发与评估具身智能体提供了实用基础。程序化生成的可控性既保证了环境的高效生产，又确保了评估的可复现性和难度可调性。

Abstract: Embodied agents need environments that are visually diverse, physically interactive, and changing over time. Procedural simulators can generate large interactive scene collections, and recent 4D generators produce compelling visual dynamics. Combining these properties in one environment, however, still demands extensive manual effort, and the result is rarely editable or controllable enough to reuse at scale.
  We present 4DSynth, a controllable procedural system that turns a natural-language description, a blueprint mask, or a single photograph into an editable 4D environment with explicit geometry, animated actors, collision-free trajectories, and physics-ready simulation state. Multiple scene routes share one geometry-grounded representation, so the same pipeline handles animation, camera planning, rendering, and task generation.
  To validate the full pipeline, we construct 4DSynth-Nav, an interactive navigation benchmark generated entirely from 4DSynth's procedural scenes. Two vision-language models evaluated across three difficulty tiers both fail the majority of tasks and stall after early subtasks. The same procedural controllability that produces these environments also makes each failure reproducible and each difficulty axis independently tunable. This paper presents both a controllable generation pipeline and the scalable benchmark it enables, offering a practical foundation for developing and evaluating embodied agents.

</details>


### [241] [Arbitrary-Order Hermite Interpolation of Rigid-Motion Jets via Hyper-Multidual Quaternions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27000)
*Daniel Condurache*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究由单位对偶四元数表示的有限阶刚体运动射流（jets）的双边插值问题。通过引入超多对偶（HMD）四元数这一数学框架，作者分析了时间变换的酉性与递归系数约束，提出了直接HMD-ScLERP与基于Hermite多项式的全纯插值两种方案，并通过数值实验验证了理论缺陷与端点射流的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚体运动的插值在机器人学、计算机动画和机构综合中至关重要。已有的对偶四元数（如ScLERP）可以插值位姿，但难以同时匹配高阶运动学信息（速度、加速度等）。作者希望建立一种统一的理论框架，使得插值不仅匹配端点位姿，还能匹配端点的高阶导数（即射流），同时保证插值曲线的"全纯性"（holonomicity），即曲线确实是由位姿的时间演化产生的。

Method: 作者将阶数n的多对偶（MD）代数与对偶四元数结合，构造超多对偶（HMD）四元数。首先证明了时间HMD变换及其相对描述子的酉性，推导了递归系数约束及可实现的局部逆命题。随后将ScLERP代数地推广到单位HMD四元数，分析其非全纯性并给出系数判据及接触缺陷公式。最终提出了全纯替代方案：将端点变换映射到对数码坐标，应用匹配到n阶导数的次数为(2n+1)的Hermite多项式，再通过指数映射提升回HMD四元数空间。此外还利用HMD算术直接恢复高阶刚体运动加速度场，无需对dexp显式求导。

Result: 推导出了时间HMD变换的酉性条件与递归系数约束，以及可实现的局部充分条件。证明了直接HMD-ScLERP在一般端点射流下不满足全纯性，并给出了明确的系数判据、端点及一阶内部接触缺陷表达式。全纯Hermite多项式方案能够精确匹配端点n阶导数。通过二阶旋转与完整SE(3)数值实验，并辅以三阶多项式校验，验证了理论推导中所述的缺陷和端点射流均与实验一致。

Conclusion: 本文建立了基于HMD四元数的刚体运动高阶插值理论，揭示了直接代数推广ScLERP的局限性（非全纯性），并提供了一种利用Hermite多项式的全纯替代方案。该框架不仅能处理位姿插值，还能精确匹配高阶运动学量，为刚体运动的高阶平滑插值提供了坚实的数学基础。

Abstract: We study bilateral interpolation of finite-order rigid-motion jets represented by unit dual quaternions. An order-$n$ multidual (MD) algebra is the truncated polynomial algebra $\mathbb{R}[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^{n+1})$; hyper-multidual (HMD) quaternions are dual quaternions with coefficients in this algebra. Temporal HMD transforms encode a pose and its derivatives, whereas a generic HMD curve need not be the temporal jet of its pose projection; we call this requirement holonomicity. We show that a temporal transform and its relative descriptor are unitary and derive recursive coefficient constraints, together with a local realizability converse in an admissible logarithm chart. We then extend screw linear interpolation (ScLERP) algebraically to unit HMD quaternions. Although it matches complete endpoint transforms, direct HMD--ScLERP is generically non-holonomic for arbitrary endpoint jets. We give a coefficient criterion and explicit endpoint and first-order interior contact defects. A holonomic alternative is obtained by mapping endpoint transforms to logarithmic dual-quaternion coordinates, applying the degree-$(2n+1)$ Hermite polynomial that matches derivatives through order $n$, and lifting by the exponential. HMD arithmetic also recovers higher-order rigid-motion acceleration fields without explicit differentiation of $\mathrm{dexp}$. Rotation and full $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ tests through second order, with an additional third-order polynomial check, reproduce the stated defects and endpoint jets.

</details>


### [242] [Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27033)
*Haofeng Sun,Jiangbo Pei,Fei Kang,Zexiang Liu,Yaokun Li,Boyi Jiang,Hua Xue,Cindy Zhou,Wei Li,Yichen Wei,Mengyin An,Fanliang Zhao,Biao Jiang,Zile Wang,Yang Liu,Yangguang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Riemann-1.0是一个全因果自回归世界动作模型（World Action Model），通过统一的因果自回归序列联合建模多视角视觉观测、机器人状态和具身特定动作，使同一模型既能作为可执行的机器人策略，又能作为多具身视觉世界模拟器。基于20万+小时交互数据的渐进式具身预训练框架，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中均达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAM）多采用联合生成、视频优先预测或解耦建模等范式，未能统一在线机器人策略执行与动作条件世界模拟。作者希望构建一个能够将大规模异构具身经验转化为可泛化机器人操作能力的统一模型。

Method: Riemann-1.0采用全因果自回归架构，将多视角视觉观测、机器人状态和具身特定动作统一建模为因果自回归序列，将机器人动作与世界演化表示为因果状态转移。此外，开发了渐进式具身预训练框架，统一学习来自自我中心人类视频、手持夹爪演示和异构机器人轨迹的数据，在共享的世界动作建模目标下进行训练。

Result: 在仿真基准中：RoboTwin2.0上成功率达94.3%，LIBERO上为99.0%，长时序组合基准RoboCasa-365上为62.6%，比此前最佳方法高出8.4%。在真实世界长时序操作任务中，SR达85.0%，PSR达94.4%，SR超过最强开源基线15%。

Conclusion: 统一的世界动作建模与渐进式具身预训练相结合，能够有效地将大规模具身经验转化为可泛化的机器人操作能力，Riemann-1.0在仿真和真实世界任务中均表现出最先进的性能。

Abstract: We introduce Riemann-1.0, a fully causal autoregressive World Action Model for embodied intelligence. Riemann-1.0 jointly models multi-view visual observations, robot states, and embodiment-specific actions within a unified causal autoregressive sequence, representing robot actions and world evolution as causal state transitions. Unlike existing WAMs based on joint generation, video-first prediction, or decoupled modeling paradigms, Riemann-1.0 unifies online robot policy execution and action-conditioned world simulation within a single model, enabling it to function as both an executable robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual world simulator. To scale embodied experience across heterogeneous data sources, we further develop a progressive embodied pretraining framework that unifies learning from egocentric human videos, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and heterogeneous robot trajectories under a shared World Action Modeling objective. Built upon 200K+ hours of interaction data, Riemann-1.0 progressively transfers large-scale embodied experience into executable robot manipulation capabilities. Riemann-1.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. It achieves success rates of 94.3% on RoboTwin2.0, 99.0% on LIBERO, and 62.6% on the long-horizon compositional benchmark RoboCasa-365, outperforming the previous best method by 8.4% On long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks, Riemann-1.0 achieves a Success Rate (SR) of 85.0% and a Progress Success Rate (PSR) of 94.4%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 15% in SR. These results demonstrate that unified World Action Modeling together with progressive embodied pretraining effectively transforms large-scale embodied experience into generalizable robot manipulation capabilities.

</details>


### [243] [GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27079)
*Yibo Qiu,Haoliang Ye,Shu'ang Sun,Zan Huang,Ronald X Xu,Mingzhai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GRAFT是一个用于生物医学机器人操作任务的高效在线VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略适应框架，通过区域级监督学习任务相关的视觉锚点，并结合单步动作生成与缓存式视觉-语言前缀复用，在四个生物医学操作任务上将成功率提升了25个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽为机器人操作提供强大先验，但在细粒度生物医学任务中的在线适应仍具挑战：任务成功依赖细微的、视图相关的视觉线索，而任务级奖励难以提供区域重要性的指导，导致在有限的真实机器人交互中难以学习任务相关的视觉定位；此外，VLA推理和回放更新的计算成本限制了在线适应效率。

Method: GRAFT提出区域级监督来学习视图特定的视觉锚点，使感知聚焦于任务相关的局部线索，且部署时无需区域提案。同时，结合单步动作生成与缓存式视觉-语言前缀复用，加速在线学习并降低计算开销。

Result: 在四个生物医学操作任务中，在匹配的适应预算下，GRAFT将成功率提升了25个百分点，并减少了在线策略更新的计算开销。

Conclusion: GRAFT通过grounded perception（基于视觉锚点的感知）实现了高效在线VLA适应，证明区域级监督和计算优化相结合能够在有限交互预算下显著提升生物医学操作任务的性能。

Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them online to fine-grained biomedical tasks remains challenging. Task success often hinges on subtle, view-dependent visual cues, while task-level rewards provide little guidance about which regions matter, making it difficult to learn task-relevant visual grounding from limited real-robot interaction. Online adaptation is further constrained by the computational cost of VLA inference and replay-based updates. We introduce GRAFT (Grounded Reinforcement Adaptation for Fast Task Learning), a framework for efficient online VLA adaptation through grounded perception. GRAFT uses region-level supervision to learn view-specific visual anchors that focus perception on task-relevant local cues without requiring region proposals at deployment. It further combines single-step action generation with cached visual-language prefix reuse to accelerate online learning. Across four biomedical manipulation tasks, GRAFT improves success rates by 25 percentage points under matched adaptation budgets, while reducing the computational overhead of online policy updates.

</details>


### [244] [Pass the Bucket: Efficient, Robust, Local Load Balancing for Teams of Heterogeneous Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27085)
*Tobias Wallner,Dominik Krupke,Arne Schmidt,Sándor P. Fekete*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究异构机器人群体在受限一维空间中通过"桶队"（bucket brigades）机制实现去中心化、自组织的任务共享与负载均衡。提出基于本地"令牌"（token）的稳定化机制来消除系统的混沌振荡行为，使系统可靠收敛到与机器人速度成比例的区间划分，并通过事件驱动仿真验证了系统的鲁棒性与快速收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构机器人群体在协作运输等需要协调运动规划的任务中，缺乏中央控制时如何实现高效的任务分配和负载均衡是一个关键挑战。现有的"桶队"机制虽然简单有效，但可能表现出混沌行为（持续振荡），无法稳定收敛到最优区间划分，因此需要设计一种仅依赖本地感知（碰撞检测）的稳定化机制来实现系统的可靠收敛。

Method: 基于"桶队"负载均衡机制，提出一种本地稳定化方案：在机器人相遇后通过一个"令牌"（token）临时使其减速，从而消除持续振荡。研究中比较了单边界令牌与双向令牌两种方案，并优化减速因子以加速系统收敛。通过事件驱动仿真评估不同扰动（如机器人删除、位置或速度抖动）下的收敛时间和鲁棒性。

Result: 所提出的令牌机制能够消除系统的持续振荡，使系统收敛到稳定的状态。相比单边界令牌，双向令牌方案能进一步加速系统收敛；通过对减速因子的优化，系统收敛速度得到提升。事件驱动仿真表明，在多种扰动条件下（机器人删除、位置或速度抖动），系统均能可靠地重新收敛。

Conclusion: 该研究为异构机器人群体提供了一种仅依赖本地信息即可实现的鲁棒负载均衡机制，能够作为更复杂协作场景的基础工具，有望扩展到需要协调运动规划的多种应用场景中。

Abstract: We study the problem of decentralized, self-organized task sharing for a swarm of heterogeneous robots that collaborate in transportation or other objectives that require coordinated motion planning. To this end, we present theoretical and practical results for the simple but effective mechanism of \emph{bucket brigades} for load balancing, in which a team of heterogenous robots share a spatial task in a confined, one-dimensional space, while only being able to sense collisions with neighbors or walls. The goal is to optimize throughput of the overall system, without central control or information, aiming at an interval partition proportional to robot velocities. We address possible chaotic system behavior by developing a stabilization mechanism based on simple local aid, a ``token'', that temporarily decelerates robots after an encounter. This purely local change eliminates persistent oscillations, resulting in convergence towards a stable system state. We accelerate system convergence by comparing a single boundary token to ubiquitous two-directional tokens and optimizing the deceleration factor. Event-driven simulations report convergence times and robustness: For a large variety of perturbations (such as robot deletion, position or velocity jittering), the system reliably re-converges. The results suggest a local, practical mechanism for robust load balancing for heterogeneous teams of robots that promises an effective tool as basis for more complex scenarios.

</details>


### [245] [Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27088)
*Ayman Laaroussi,Peter Hanappe,David Colliaux*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自主机器人平台，将3D植物重建、几何分析和运动规划相结合，实现对植物叶片进行精准的叶绿素荧光测量，从而超越被动成像，实现高分辨率的空间分辨生理测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数表型平台主要依赖基于图像的测量，但高级植物表征需要整合主动生理传感模态（如叶绿素荧光）。现有的被动成像方法无法提供空间分辨的生理信息，需要一种能够自主定位测量点并执行接触或近接触测量的机器人方法。

Method: 系统通过多视角数据重建密集3D植物模型，基于朝向、可达性和传感约束提取候选叶片表面；然后将这些目标集成到任务级规划框架中，指导机械臂末端执行器到达精确的接触或近接触配置，以实现基于点的荧光采集。

Result: 该平台能够实现自动化、可重复且空间分辨的生理测量，超越了被动成像的能力，展示了紧耦合感知、几何推理与操作在植物表型分析中的可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种机器人驱动的高分辨率植物表型分析方法，为自主农业巡检和植物感知操控开辟了新方向。

Abstract: While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.
  A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. The platform enables automated, repeatable, and spatially resolved physiological measurements that go beyond passive imaging. By tightly coupling perception, geometric reasoning, and manipulation, the proposed system provides a robotics-driven approach to high-resolution plant phenotyping and opens new directions for autonomous agricultural inspection and plant-aware manipulation.

</details>


### [246] [Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27151)
*Haohui Pan,Takuya Kiyokawa,Kensuke Harada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化真空吸盘夹具系统，通过扩散模型与贝叶斯优化联合搜索混合连续-离散夹具布局空间，为螺丝刀和剃须刀的完整拆解序列规划单一共享支撑布局，无需中途重新配置夹具。实验验证了布局可行性并测得平均经验稳定裕度为66.9%（螺丝刀）和81.6%（剃须刀）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在异形产品的机器人拆解过程中，随着组件逐步移除，可用支撑面、质量分布和任务载荷持续变化，导致针对单一工件状态设计的夹具布局在后续阶段可能失效。因此需要在整个拆解序列上统一规划支撑方案，以避免频繁的夹具重构。

Method: 提出模块化真空夹具系统。采用去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）生成物理信息引导的初始布局配置，再通过贝叶斯优化对混合连续-离散布局空间进行精炼，在跨阶段重复评估下寻找对整个拆解序列均可行的共享支撑布局。

Result: 通过机器人螺丝与组件移除实验验证了规划布局的拆解可行性；11个方向载荷测试量化了布局稳定性。测得平均经验稳定裕度为螺丝刀66.9%、剃须刀81.6%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，针对特定产品设计的共享夹具布局能够在整个机器人拆解序列中提供稳定支撑，无需夹具重构，为异形产品拆解的稳定支撑问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.

</details>


### [247] [Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27186)
*Nithin S. Kumar,Joshua Gaston,D. Caleb Rucker,Eric J. Barth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型的实时动态模型任务空间控制框架，结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器和动态观测器，实现了平面气动软体执行器的高精度任务空间控制（精度运动中RMSE为1.5-2.3 mm，1-2 Hz周期性运动中RMSE为5.5-12.4 mm）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体执行器具有柔顺灵巧的交互能力，但其强非线性、分布式变形和动力学不确定性使得闭环任务空间控制极具挑战性。

Method: 采用绝对坐标+完整约束的非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型，通过稀疏系统矩阵保持计算效率（支持最多10根离散杆的实时控制）；结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器和动态观测器（将测量残差作为虚拟力融合），实现从稀疏传感中估计完整状态。

Result: 在三个不同几何形状的平面气动软体执行器上进行了实验验证，涵盖五项任务（数字0-9绘制、周期性跟踪、跨平台泛化、降低传感条件、实时用户定义参考）。精度运动RMSE为1.5-2.3 mm，1-2 Hz周期性运动RMSE为5.5-12.4 mm。

Conclusion: 结构化非最小动态模型能够实现平面气动软体执行器在自由空间中的实时、高精度、中带宽任务空间控制。

Abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational efficiency through sparse system matrices, enabling real-time control with up to 10 discretized rods. A quasi-static feedforward inverse model is combined with a task-space PI controller and a dynamic observer that fuses measurement residuals as virtual forces, enabling full-state estimation from sparse sensing. The approach is experimentally validated on three planar pneumatic soft actuators with varying geometries. Across five tasks, including drawing the digits 0-9 across the workspace (3-18 mm/s tip speed), tracking periodic motion (up to 37 cm/s), cross-platform generalization, reduced sensing conditions, and real-time user-defined references, our method achieves 1.5-2.3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) for precision motions and 5.5-12.4 mm RMSE at 1-2 Hz. Results demonstrate that structured, non-minimal dynamic models can enable real-time, high-precision, moderate-bandwidth task-space control of planar soft pneumatic actuators in free space.

</details>


### [248] [Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27221)
*Mahmud Hasan Saikot,Sydney Spiegel,Sudheera Akalanka Kariyawasam,Andrew Stefka,Josh Chrisler,Jianguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将张拉整体（tensegrity）柔顺躯体与爪式连接机制相结合的模块化可重构机器人（MRR），统一了模块化可重构机器人与连续体机器人的优势，使机器人既能独立操控和运动，又能在多机器人间自重构为链式、环状、分支等多种形态，实现协同操控、多模态运动及真实场景中的运动-操控一体化任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的模块化可重构机器人（MRR）大多依赖刚性模块，缺乏结构柔顺性，导致能力受限；而连续体机器人虽具有柔顺性，却无法自重构为任务自适应的多机器人构型。现有研究尚未有一种架构能够同时兼具两者的优势。

Method: 将张拉整体（tensegrity）结构作为柔顺躯体，与爪式连接机制相结合，构建新型MRR。每个机器人单元可独立完成操控和运动，多个单元可通过爪式机制自重构为不同形态（链式、环状、分支等），实现协同操控与协同运动。

Result: 实验验证了该机器人在多种任务和环境中的能力，包括协同物体操控与搬运、多模态运动以及真实世界场景中的运动-操控（loco-manipulation）一体化任务。

Conclusion: 该研究为构建适变、多功能的机器人群体奠定了基础，在制造业、太空探索和搜救等领域具有广阔的应用前景。

Abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.

</details>


### [249] [STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27225)
*Maitrey Gramopadhye,Prakash Baskaran,Xiao Liu,Songpo Li,Soshi Iba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出STEP框架，通过让多模态大语言模型显式估计系统状态并预测状态转移，解决了人机协作中任务规划的状态感知缺失和动作模糊问题，在仿真装配任务中相比SOTA在动作可执行性和最终状态误差上分别提升32.8%和14.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MM-LLMs）在工业人机协作任务规划中具有前景，但其固有缺陷包括：缺乏对系统状态的理解、无法跟踪状态转移导致产生偏离目标的幻觉动作；且以自然语言生成的动作计划仅停留在高层抽象，导致动作执行存在歧义。这两个问题限制了MM-LLMs在任务规划中的实际应用效果。

Method: 提出状态感知任务估计器与规划器（STEP），核心思路是提示MM-LLM显式估计系统状态并预测执行动作所导致的状态转移。通过将未来状态与动作同时预测，STEP确保规划结果趋向任务收敛，同时为已预测动作的执行提供额外所需辅助参数。

Result: 在仿真环境中的机器人装配任务上评估，STEP相比最先进方法在动作可执行性上提升32.8%，在最终状态误差上降低14.8%。

Conclusion: STEP通过状态感知的状态转移预测有效缓解了MM-LLM在任务规划中的幻觉问题，提升规划的可执行性与准确性，为数据稀缺场景下的人机协作任务规划提供了一种更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.

</details>


### [250] [Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27371)
*Canzhi Chen,Zan Wang,Siqi Zhu,Qi Wu,Yixuan Li,Wei Liang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出具身场景重排规划（ESRP）任务，要求具身智能体仅通过自我中心观测和俯视目标布局来重新布置3D场景中的家具。作者构建了基于OmniGibson的ESRP-Bench基准（5400余场景对、8200余物体），定义多层级评估指标并提供四种基线方法，实验表明现有方法难以高效完成该任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重排任务通常允许智能体访问全局状态，这与真实机器人部署中仅能获取局部观测的实际情况不符。同时，真实场景中存在物体相互遮挡的问题，这些因素使得长时程规划中如何将部分自我中心观测与全局目标布局对齐成为极具挑战性的问题，亟需一个新的任务定义和基准来推动该方向研究。

Method: 提出ESRP任务定义，基于OmniGibson构建包含5,400+场景对和8,200+物体的ESRP-Bench基准；设计三种多层级评估指标；提供四种基线方法：层次化任务与运动规划方法、基于视觉语言模型的方法、以及两种学习方法（模仿学习和强化学习）。

Result: 实验结果表明，当前各类方法在高效完成ESRP任务上均存在明显困难，说明该任务对具身智能体的场景理解与长时程任务规划能力构成了严峻挑战，凸显了ESRP作为前沿研究问题的重要性。

Conclusion: ESRP作为具身场景重排规划的新任务和基准，为场景理解与长时程规划研究提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，是迈向真实世界智能体部署的重要一步。

Abstract: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page: https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/.

</details>


### [251] [FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27384)
*Zekai Li,Jiaming Tang,Zhijian Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlashVLA是一个流式动作解码框架，通过多个不同噪声级别的动作块和块级因果注意力，实现每步推理产出一个可执行动作块，在单GPU上达到≥30Hz控制频率的同时保持平滑的异步执行和强任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在真实机器人部署中面临高推理延迟和不稳定的异步执行问题，尤其在基于流匹配的VLA模型中，动作解码需要多步迭代。现有高效的推理方法虽然能提升控制频率，异步方法能减少空闲时间，但难以同时实现低延迟推理和精确、时间一致的异步执行。

Method: FlashVLA采用统一的流式动作解码框架：维护一个包含多个不同噪声级别动作块的流式动作缓冲区，并使用块级因果注意力（chunk-wise causal attention）进行解码。这种设计使每个推理步骤能产出一个可执行的动作块，其块级自回归公式隐式保持动作连续性，无需额外未来状态条件即可实现平滑的异步执行。

Result: 在广泛的仿真和真实世界实验中，FlashVLA显著提升了推理速度，同时在单GPU上实现≥30Hz的控制频率，并在真实部署中表现出平滑的异步推断，同时保持较强的任务性能。

Conclusion: FlashVLA通过统一的流式解码框架同时解决了VLA模型推理延迟高和异步执行不稳定的问题，为VLA模型在真实机器人操作中的高效部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.

</details>


### [252] [CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27406)
*Kechen Liu,Ola Shorinwa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CLAP是一个跨具身（cross-embodiment）动作条件视频生成框架，能够在人类和机器人等异构视频数据上训练，通过端到端姿态、语言指令和潜在动作统一不同动作空间，并采用课程式学习范式先学习物理先验再接地到端到端动作空间，实现零样本部署和少样本微调，在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越单具身视频模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人具身，无法利用包含丰富物理泛化信号的异构视频数据。跨具身学习的关键挑战在于不同机器人平台的动作表示差异巨大，且人类视频中通常缺少动作标注。

Method: CLAP提出三个核心贡献：(1) 使用端到端姿态、语言指令和潜在动作三种形式来调和异构的动作空间；(2) 提出基于课程学习的跨具身训练策略——先利用潜在动作在无标注视频数据上学习基础物理先验，再将其接地到端到端动作空间以实现真实任务的零样本部署；(3) 通过少样本自适应进一步提升性能。

Result: CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越最先进的单具身视频模型性能，且性能优势通过少样本自适应进一步累积，建立了训练单具身视频世界模型的新范式。CLAP是目前最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件，覆盖端到端、语言和潜在等多种动作条件空间，以及跨具身、DROID、Bridge、双机械臂YAM机器人和G1人形机器人等多种机器人形态。

Conclusion: CLAP成功验证了跨具身动作条件视频生成的可行性，通过统一动作空间和课程式学习，实现了从异构视频数据中学习通用物理先验并泛化到真实世界任务的目标，为视频世界模型在机器人领域的应用开辟了新路径。代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [253] [SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing for Labeled Property Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26132)
*Michal Podstawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SLM条件化层级关系路由（SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing），一种将小型语言模型（SLM）集成到图消息选择机制中的图神经网络架构，用于解决带标签属性图中语义证据选择的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图神经网络将节点和关系的异构文本及类别属性表示为静态特征向量，无法确定哪些语义证据应影响特定预测目标的消息传播，限制了其在属性丰富图上的表示能力。

Method: 架构由两部分组成：1）拓扑GNN提供稳定的结构表示和预测锚点；2）参数高效的SLM处理结构化的图软令牌，生成目标条件化的路由查询。该查询先在每种关系类型内选择相关消息，再跨关系级别的摘要进行路由，最终产生一个有界的残差更新来修改拓扑锚点的预测。

Result: 该架构在邻居级和关系类型级均可进行可解释性分析，证明了将语言派生的语义整合到属性丰富的图学习中的通用机制的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法为属性丰富图提供了一种通用且可解释的框架，在保留结构证据的同时允许上下文语义信息动态调整预测，为将语言模型语义整合进图学习提供了新方向。

Abstract: Labeled property graphs combine relational structure with heterogeneous textual and categorical properties attached to both nodes and relationships. Conventional graph neural networks typically represent these properties as static feature vectors, limiting their ability to determine which semantic evidence should influence message propagation for a particular prediction target. We propose SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing, an architecture that integrates a small language model directly into graph message selection. A topology GNN provides a stable structural representation and prediction anchor. For each target node, incident messages combine the neighbor's structural state, node-property encoding, relationship-property encoding, and relationship type. A parameter-efficient SLM processes structured graph soft tokens and produces a target-conditioned routing query. This query first selects relevant messages within each relationship type and subsequently routes information across relation-level summaries. The resulting representation provides a bounded residual update to the topology anchor, preserving structural evidence while allowing contextual semantic information to modify the prediction. The architecture supports interpretable analysis at both the neighbor and relationship-type levels and provides a general mechanism for integrating language-derived semantics into property-rich graph learning.

</details>


### [254] [NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26222)
*Zhiyuan Xu,Muhammad Firhard Roslan,Joseph Gardiner,Sana Belguith,Lichao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronFuzz是一个白盒模糊测试框架，利用LLM内部"安全神经元"的激活值作为连续执行反馈进行安全评估，通过可微分的SafetyOracle安全警报分数替代昂贵的响应生成，实现高效且可迁移的越狱攻击模板发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化安全测试方法依赖响应级反馈，需要为目标模型生成完整响应来评估攻击效果，这不仅成本高昂，而且在强对齐模型上提供的信息稀疏（大多数候选提示被同样拒绝，反馈区分度低）。因此需要一种更高效、信息更丰富的反馈机制来指导模糊测试。

Method: NeuronFuzz包含三个关键组件：(1) SafetyOracle——利用模板不变的恶意/良性输入和稳定性感知选择，识别一组紧凑的安全神经元，将其激活值转换为连续的"安全警报分数"作为模糊测试反馈，该分数可在prefill阶段获得，无需响应生成；(2) 梯度引导——利用安全警报分数的可微分性，通过梯度识别安全敏感的模板位置；(3) 掩码语言模型——在保留原始有害载荷的前提下生成流畅、上下文兼容的模板变异，避免额外优化变量。

Result: 在21个文本和多模态模型上评估。在5个白盒源模型上，实现76-100%的越狱发现率，比基线高出最多48个百分点。优化后的模板可零样本迁移到开放权重模型和6个专有目标模型，平均ASR和top-5集成ASR分别达到69.6%/92.6%和44.1%/60.0%。

Conclusion: NeuronFuzz证明了利用内部安全神经元激活作为连续、可微分反馈可以显著提升LLM安全评估的效率，且在训练过程中无需为每个候选提示生成响应，同时优化出的越狱模板具有良好的跨模型可迁移性，为白盒安全审计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcome.
  This paper presents NeuronFuzz, a white-box fuzzing framework that exploits internal safety neurons as continuous execution feedback for LLM safety evaluation. A SafetyOracle converts safety-neuron activations into a continuous safety alarm score that serves as feedback for fuzzing and can be obtained during prefill, eliminating response generation from the fuzzing loop. To construct the SafetyOracle, NeuronFuzz uses template-invariant harmful and benign inputs and stability-aware selection to identify a compact set of safety neurons whose activations capture harmful-intent recognition. Moreover, since the safety alarm score is differentiable, NeuronFuzz uses its gradients to identify safety-sensitive template positions and a masked language model to generate fluent, context-compatible mutations while preserving original harmful payload and avoiding additional optimization variables. We evaluate NeuronFuzz across 21 text and multimodal models. Across five white-box source models, it achieves a 76-100% jailbreak discovery rate, outperforming baselines by up to 48 percentage points. Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

</details>


### [255] [Pruning Binarized Neural Networks: A Dedicated Framework and Globally Weighted Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26233)
*Roan Rubiales,Jean Pierre David*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于PyTorch的研究型框架，用于设计和优化二值化神经网络，包含冻结和剪枝机制。基于该框架，作者提出了一种全局加权剪枝方法，考虑不同抽象层级上参数的重要性，在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且精度不变，而现有方法在二值化场景下仅能达到41%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的极端压缩（如完全二值化）可大幅降低内存占用和算术复杂度，便于在FPGA和微控制器等受限边缘硬件上部署。虽然二值化与剪枝结合可带来额外的效率提升，但现有的剪枝策略不适合二值化表示，且很少能转化为实际的硬件收益。

Method: 作者提出了一个基于PyTorch的研究导向框架，集成了冻结（freezing）和剪枝（pruning）机制。基于该框架，提出了一种新的剪枝方法，通过全局加权机制考虑模型不同抽象层级上学习参数的重要性，从而实现对二值化神经网络的有效剪枝。

Result: 所提出的全局加权剪枝方法在模型精度与剪枝率之间取得了优越的权衡。在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且精度保持不变，而现有最先进方法在二值化设置下仅能达到41%的剪枝率。

Conclusion: 该框架支持快速、可复现地评估现有方法及快速原型化新方法，所提出的全局加权剪枝策略在二值化神经网络中显著优于现有方法，展示了在极端压缩场景下进一步提升硬件效率的潜力。

Abstract: Extreme compression of deep neural networks, up to full binarization, dramatically reduces memory footprint and arithmetic complexity, facilitating deployment on constrained edge hardware with field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and microcontrollers. Although combining binarization with pruning promises additional efficiency gains, existing pruning strategies are ill-suited to binarized representations and rarely translate into meaningful hardware savings. We introduce a PyTorch-based, research-oriented framework that incorporates freezing and pruning mechanisms for designing and optimizing binarized neural networks. The framework enables rapid and reproducible evaluation of state-of-the-art approaches and the fast prototyping of new ones. Leveraging this framework, we propose a novel pruning method that accounts for the relative importance of learned parameters across abstraction levels. Such a global weighting mechanism consistently achieves a superior trade-off between model accuracy and pruning rate, achieving a 70% pruning rate on VGG11 with constant accuracy, while state-of-the-art results reach only 41% in the binarized setting.

</details>


### [256] [Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz: The Smoothing Benefit in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26288)
*Mingyi Li,Taira Tsuchiya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次证明了Muon优化器中有限深度Newton-Schulz迭代不仅不损害收敛保证，反而对非光滑非凸优化是有益的。通过在线到非凸转化的分析框架，作者证明Newton-Schulz深度只需随目标精度对数增长即可保证收敛到驻点，而使用精确极分解的Muon可能不收敛，所得样本复杂度下界与已知最优结果匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器在大语言模型预训练中对矩阵值参数表现出色，它用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代近似正交化动量。然而现有理论要么用精确极分解替代该迭代，要么将有限深度视为近似误差，导致实际运行的迭代反而只能削弱理论保证。这与实证观察相矛盾，因此需要重新建立能够解释Muon实际行为（即有限深度Newton-Schulz）的理论框架。

Method: 作者采用在线到非凸转化（online-to-nonconvex conversion）的分析框架，将Muon的更新规则视为在线学习器，并将其遗憾界转化为平稳性保证。具体而言：(1) 证明有限Newton-Schulz迭代将不连续的极映射平滑化为关于奇异值的Lipschitz映射；(2) 将带有限Newton-Schulz的Muon视为具有平滑谱势的在线学习器；(3) 证明该平滑性恰好满足转化所需的充分条件；(4) 将结果推广到具有相同平滑性质的一般谱映射。

Result: 作者证明Newton-Schulz深度只需随目标精度对数增长（logarithmic in target accuracy）即可保证非光滑非凸优化收敛到驻点，而使用精确极分解更新的Muon可能无法收敛。所得样本复杂度界与非光滑非凸优化的最已知结果匹配，且在平滑非凸优化中至问题相关因子前达到最优。

Conclusion: 有限Newton-Schulz迭代的平滑效应是Muon收敛性的关键，而非需要容忍的近似误差。该分析框架不仅适用于Newton-Schulz，还可推广到任何具有相同平滑性质的一般谱映射，为理解Muon及其变体提供了统一的理论视角。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for the matrix-valued parameters in large language model pretraining, approximately orthogonalizing its momentum with a few Newton-Schulz iterations. Existing theory either replaces this iteration with the exact polar factor it approximates, or treats its finite depth as an approximation error, and thus the iteration Muon actually runs can only hurt the guarantees. We show that finite Newton-Schulz can instead be beneficial for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. To this end, we analyze Muon through the online-to-nonconvex conversion, which views the update rule as an online learner and converts its regret bound into a stationarity guarantee. The finite Newton-Schulz iteration smooths the discontinuous polar map into a Lipschitz map of the singular values, and Muon with finite Newton-Schulz can be regarded as an online learner with a smoothed spectral potential. This smoothing is exactly what the conversion needs: we prove that a Newton-Schulz depth growing only logarithmically in the target accuracy suffices for convergence to stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, whereas Muon with the exact-polar update may fail to converge. The resulting sample complexity bounds match the best-known guarantees for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and are optimal for smooth nonconvex optimization up to problem-dependent factors. The argument extends beyond Newton-Schulz to general spectral maps with the same smoothing property.

</details>


### [257] [Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26309)
*Antonia van Betteray,Jonathan Klees,Miriam Schäfers,Matthias Rottmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AMELS框架，通过快速邻域图构建和代数多重网格求解器加速标签传播，使得半监督学习能够高效应用于大规模高维数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模数据集的人工标注成本高，标签传播作为一种半监督学习技术虽然有效，但在大规模、高维数据上受限于计算成本和内存约束。

Method: AMELS框架包含两个关键组件：(1) 快速构建邻域图以提高可扩展性；(2) 引入代数多重网格迭代求解器，替代传统的随机游走迭代，利用其多级特性在一次多重网格循环中跨任意大小的图传播标签信息。

Result: 与现有实现相比，AMELS在运行时间上显著降低，同时对超参数选择更具鲁棒性（在运行时间和分类精度方面均表现稳定）。能够在仅有少量标注样本的情况下在大规模图像数据集上高效生成准确标签。

Conclusion: AMELS使标签传播能够高效应用于大规模图像数据集，即使只有少量标注样本也能产生准确的标签，为半监督学习的大规模应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models rely on large amounts of labeled data. However, manual annotation of large-scale datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Label spreading is a semi-supervised learning technique that addresses this challenge by propagating information from a few labeled examples to a larger pool of unlabeled data. Despite its effectiveness, its application to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets is limited by computational costs and memory constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading (AMELS), an efficient label spreading framework that improves scalability by fast construction of neighborhood graphs and the incorporation of algebraic multigrid solvers. The latter is an iterative solver that replaces the ordinary random walk iteration typically performed in label spreading. Due to the multilevel nature of algebraic multigrid solvers, AMELS spreads given label information across a graph of any size in a single multigrid cycle. We demonstrate that AMELS achieves significant runtime reductions compared to existing implementations while also being more robust to hyperparameter choices in terms of both runtime and classification accuracy. Our framework therefore enables efficient label spreading on large-scale image datasets and produces accurate labels even when only a few labeled samples are available.

</details>


### [258] [Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26324)
*Ishi Jain,Nandini Bhattad,Sayak Ray Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种隐私保护的推理时对齐方法（PrivBoN和PrivITP），通过在奖励分数中加入校准的Gumbel噪声或高斯噪声，在实现差分隐私的同时避免奖励黑客问题，且不会产生额外的对齐成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N (BoN)采样虽然是最广泛使用的推理时对齐策略，但存在两个关键问题：一是奖励黑客（reward hacking），即选中利用代理奖励模型缺陷的响应；二是缺乏对训练奖励模型所用敏感人类偏好数据的隐私保护。作者希望找到一种同时解决这两个问题的统一干预手段。

Method: 作者提出单一干预手段——在选择前向奖励分数中添加校准噪声。具体包含两种方法：(1) PrivBoN：在奖励分数中添加合适尺度的Gumbel噪声，可同时实现ε-差分隐私和KL正则化对齐，当隐私预算超过阈值ε*时，隐私所需的噪声即为遗憾最优的正则化；(2) PrivITP：结合χ²正则化拒绝采样与两阶段高斯机制，实现事后(ε,δ)-DP，隐私成本与响应数量n无关，并可将正则化参数与隐私参数解耦。

Result: 实验在多个语言模型、数据集和奖励模型上验证：PrivBoN和PrivITP具有缩放单调性（与BoN不同，后者在超过关键n值后性能退化）；在等价隐私水平下，PrivITP匹配或优于PrivBoN，且在强隐私场景下增益最大。

Conclusion: 在奖励分数中加入校准噪声这一简单干预，能同时解决奖励黑客和隐私保护两个问题。随着隐私预算超过关键阈值，隐私所要求的噪声恰好就是最优正则化，隐私保护不对齐质量造成额外成本，达到了信息论下界。

Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBoN), establishes that Gumbel noise at an appropriate scale simultaneously provides $ε$-differential privacy and implements KL-regularized alignment. Whenever the privacy budget exceeds a critical threshold $ε^*$, the privacy-mandated noise is the regret-optimal regularization, and privacy imposes zero additional alignment cost-matching the information-theoretic skyline of Huang et al. (2025). Because $ε^*$ depends on an unknown coverage coefficient, we introduce Private Inference-Time Pessimism (PrivITP), which combines $χ^2$-regularized rejection sampling with a two-phase Gaussian mechanism. PrivITP achieves ex-post $(ε,δ)$-DP with a privacy cost independent of the number of responses $n$, cleanly decouples the regularization parameter from the privacy parameter, and attains the skyline up to a noise-inflation term. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm our results: PrivBoN and PrivITP are scaling-monotonic (unlike BoN, which degrades past a critical $n$), and PrivITP matches or outperforms PrivBoN at equivalent privacy levels, with the largest gains in the strong-privacy regime.

</details>


### [259] [GRAS: Guided Reduced-Variance Proposals and Adaptive Selection for Training-Free Reward Alignment in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26585)
*Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GRAS方法，通过Rao-Blackwell化揭示与留一法基线降低引导扩散模型梯度估计方差，并通过组相对优势自适应重采样温度，在无需训练的情况下实现优于先前方法的奖励优化，在调控DNA和蛋白质设计任务中达到甚至超越奖励微调模型的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型已成为序列数据序列的强大生成器，在推理时无需重训练即可向指定奖励引导越来越重要。现有训练无关引导通常结合梯度引导与搜索，但该方法存在两个弱点：引导提议从单一噪声样本估计梯度导致高方差，且搜索以固定温度重采样粒子，忽略了奖励在去噪步骤间的分布差异。

Method: GRAS包含两组针对性修改：1) 提议端——对不同奖励采用Rao-Blackwell化揭示降低估计器方差，对不可微奖励采用留一法基线；2) 搜索端——将每步值标准化为组相对优势，并证明该方法本质上等价于唯一的主动成分：自适应重采样温度。所有更改不增加去噪器计算成本。

Result: 在调控DNA和蛋白质设计基准上，GRAS取得了最佳的训练无关奖励，超越了先前所有训练无关方法，并达到或超越奖励微调模型的表现；即使面对不可微奖励，GRAS仍然保持有效。

Conclusion: GRAS简单而有效，通过联合改进梯度估计的方差和搜索重采样的自适应性，在不增加去噪器成本的前提下显著提升了训练无关推理时引导的奖励优化性能，尤其在不可微奖励场景下展现鲁棒性。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have become a strong, widely adopted class of generators for sequence data, and steering them toward a downstream reward at inference time, without any retraining, is increasingly important. Such training-free steering is done by gradient guidance, by search, or by combining the two. We study the combined regime and identify two weaknesses in how it is usually run: the guided proposal estimates its gradient from a single noisy sample, and the search then resamples particles at a fixed temperature that ignores how rewards spread across each denoising step. We address both with a small set of changes that add no denoiser cost. For the proposal, we lower the estimator variance with a Rao-Blackwellized reveal for differentiable rewards and a leave-one-out baseline for non-differentiable ones; for the search, we standardize the per-step values into a group-relative advantage and prove it collapses to a single active ingredient, an adaptive resampling temperature. We call the resulting method Guided Reduced-variance proposals and Adaptive Selection (GRAS). GRAS is simple yet effective: across regulatory DNA and protein design it attains the best training-free reward, outperforming prior training-free methods and matching or surpassing a reward-fine-tuned model, and it remains effective even for non-differentiable rewards.

</details>


### [260] [Beyond Capability Benchmarks: Learning Operational Fingerprints of LLM Cloud Services from Production Incident Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26332)
*Meiwei Zhang,Eduardo Miranda,Bruce Baynes,Suvigya Jain,Wanlong Chen,Tao He,Sergey Borodavkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Operational Embedding (OpEmbed)，一个从LLM云服务的隐私保护支持工单元数据中学习紧凑"运营指纹"的框架，用于替代传统能力基准测试来评估模型部署后的运营行为。在Google Cloud 26个月内7个LLM家族的33,000+生产支持案例上验证，OpEmbed能够恢复可解释的模型家族与版本结构，改进留一模型运营预测，在早期数据有限时依然有效，并支持跨模型的故障类型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的托管LLM服务已进入生产系统，但模型选择和服务的规划仍依赖能力基准测试，这些基准在部署后几乎无法揭示模型的运营行为（如故障模式、支持需求）。需要一种从运营数据中学习模型行为特征的方法，以更好地支持模型选型和服务规划。

Method: OpEmbed将模型-时间窗口聚合为八通道运营签名，通过时间对比学习（temporal contrastive learning）、跨视图重建（cross-view reconstruction）和代际序数正则化（generational-ordinality regularization）学习低维表示。该方法仅使用结构化的、隐私保护的工单元数据，不涉及案例文本内容。

Result: 在Google Cloud超过33,000个生产支持案例（跨越7个LLM家族、26个月）上进行评估，OpEmbed能够恢复可解释的家族级和版本级结构；在留一模型运营预测上优于非学习基线；在早期窗口数据有限时仍保持可用；并支持跨模型的故障类型迁移。

Conclusion: OpEmbed为LLM云服务的运营监控、模型上线评估和支持就绪度评估提供了实用工具，并总结了构建和评估该工具过程中的实操经验，弥补了传统能力基准测试在部署后运营行为评估方面的空白。

Abstract: Managed LLM services are now part of real production systems, but model selection and service planning still rely heavily on capability benchmarks that reveal little about operational behavior after deployment. We present Operational Embedding (OpEmbed), a framework for learning compact operational fingerprints of LLM cloud services from structured, privacy-preserving support-case metadata, without using case text. OpEmbed aggregates model--time windows into an eight-channel operational signature and learns a low-dimensional representation via temporal contrastive learning, cross-view reconstruction, and generational-ordinality regularization. Evaluated on more than 33,000 production support cases spanning seven LLM families over 26 months at Google Cloud, OpEmbed recovers interpretable family- and version-level structure, improves leave-one-model-out operational forecasting over non-learned baselines, remains useful under limited early-window data, and supports cross-model fault-type transfer. We report the practical lessons learned from building and evaluating this tool for model onboarding, support readiness assessment, and operational monitoring.

</details>


### [261] [CG4AI: A Column Generation Framework for Training AI Models Under Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26375)
*Youcef Magnouche,Abderrahmane Driouch,Sébastien Martin,Pierre Bauguion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CG4AI框架，通过对多个AI模型进行凸组合，并利用线性规划求解最优混合权重，在保证输出满足线性约束的同时提升预测精度。该方法不依赖训练数据本身来保证约束，而是通过主LP问题确定权重、定价子问题生成新模型、切割平面法扩展可行性保证，已在MNIST数字分类和多商品流网络路由问题上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的机器学习训练只优化数据集上的损失函数，无法保证模型输出满足预定义的规则或约束条件。然而在许多实际应用中（如自主系统和网络路由），这种可行性保证是至关重要的，因此需要一种能够在模型输出上显式强制执行约束的方法。

Method: CG4AI框架包含三个核心组件：（1）主线性规划（LP）确定多个AI模型的最优凸组合权重；（2）定价子问题利用LP对偶变量生成新模型，重点聚焦于违反最严重的约束；（3）切割平面过程将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外的区域。该方法本质上是将列生成（Column Generation）思想与AI模型组合相结合。

Result: 在MNIST数据集上展示了四个不同的约束应用场景：仅从约束学习、提高对抗鲁棒性、修正错误分类样本以及强制输出重标记。在多商品流问题中，对神经网络路由预测器强制执行链路容量约束。实验表明CG4AI能可靠地产生可行预测器，且精度优于单模型基线。

Conclusion: CG4AI通过凸组合与列生成优化的结合，为在AI模型输出上强制执行线性约束提供了一种通用且有效的框架，在保证可行性的同时还能提升模型精度，展示了约束信息对模型性能的潜在增益。

Abstract: Standard machine-learning training minimizes a loss function over a dataset, but does not guarantee that the resulting model will satisfy predefined rules or constraints on its outputs. In many real-world applications, ranging from autonomous systems to network routing, such guarantees are essential. We propose CG4AI, a framework that builds a convex combination of AI models while enforcing linear constraints on the combined output. A master linear program (LP) determines the optimal mixture weights, while a pricing subproblem generates new models guided by LP dual variables, focusing attention on the most violated constraints. A cutting-plane procedure extends feasibility guarantees beyond the training set. We apply CG4AI to two problems: (i) digit classification on MNIST, where we demonstrate four distinct uses of constraints, learning from constraints alone, improving adversarial robustness, correcting misclassified examples, and enforcing output relabeling; and (ii) the multi-commodity flow problem, where link capacity constraints are enforced on neural-network routing predictors. Experiments on MNIST and standard SNDLIB benchmark networks show that CG4AI reliably produces feasible predictors while achieving better accuracy than single-model baselines.

</details>


### [262] [The Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy: A Framework for Constructing Classifiers and Diagnosing Their Decisions, Applied to Prompt Injection Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26423)
*Jaturong Kongmanee,Smile Thanapattheerakul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy框架，通过构建维度优化的分类器、定位潜在支持向量和构建诊断分类学，对分类器的自信决策进行可信度评估，将其划分为可安全依赖、启发式偏差/覆盖、以及需人工审查等不同处理区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习分类器常在高置信度下产生错误决策，但缺乏一个系统性的诊断框架来判断哪些自信决策可以信任，哪些存在潜在的脆弱性或可被利用的捷径。

Method: 该框架包含三个步骤：(i)构建维度优化分类器，通过交叉验证选择嵌入维度而非预先固定；(ii)定位约29%训练样本作为潜在支持向量，用于识别改变分类器预测标签的关键token；(iii)利用这些token及其攻击强度构建诊断分类学，将提示划分为不同处理区域。

Result: 应用该框架于公开的提示注入数据集时发现：约77%的自信决策在移除单个token后不再稳健，这种脆弱性可分为两类失败模式——置信度校准失败和真正可利用的捷径。

Conclusion: 该诊断分类学为端到端标记提示提供了指南，针对每个分类区域给出相应的补救策略，可作为分类器的安全防护层和配套诊断工具。

Abstract: This paper proposes a framework for constructing a classifier as a safeguard layer, and for developing a complementary diagnostic that identifies which of the classifier's confident decisions can be trusted. This framework, the Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy, consists of (i) constructing a dimensionality-optimized classifier, in which the embedding dimensionality is empirically selected via cross-validated performance rather than fixed a priori, (ii) locating a relatively small set of latent support vectors (~ 29% of total training examples) representing influential prompts for identifying tokens that alter the classifier's predicted labels, and (iii) utilizing such tokens and their associated attack magnitudes for constructing a diagnostic taxonomy. This diagnostic taxonomy provides an end-to-end guideline for flagging prompts that require different treatments: rely Safely on the classifier's decision; flag Heuristic Bias and Heuristic Override cases; route Insufficient Context cases for further human/safety review. Applying the framework to a classifier trained on a public prompt injection dataset, we find that a substantial fraction of its confident decisions (~ 77%) are not robust to removing a single token, and that this brittleness separates into two distinct failure patterns: a confidence calibration failure and a genuinely exploitable shortcut. For each zone of the taxonomy, we also recommend strategies for remediating diagnosed prompts. We illustrate the framework as a series of steps, demonstrating how each step operates.

</details>


### [263] [FedCMAPSS: A Benchmark for Federated Learning in Remaining Useful Life Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26433)
*Amelia Sorrenti,Matteo Pennisi,Concetto Spampinato,Simone Palazzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了FedCMAPSS，一个基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集的标准联邦剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计基准，定义了五个模拟真实工业场景的标准化任务，并系统地评估了多种联邦优化算法和神经架构，提供了可复现的基线和公开源码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业4.0中数据驱动的预测性健康管理（PHM）至关重要，但运行至失效（run-to-failure）数据的稀缺限制了RUL估计模型的鲁棒性。联邦学习提供了一种无需共享传感器数据的协作训练范式，然而现有研究缺乏统一的评估框架，导致不同方法之间难以公平比较，这构成了领域发展的关键瓶颈。

Method: 作者基于广泛使用的NASA C-MAPSS数据集构建了FedCMAPSS基准，设计了五个标准化联邦学习任务，覆盖从理想独立同分布（IID）设置到极端统计异质性（non-IID）的真实工业挑战场景；随后在多个神经架构上对最先进的联邦优化算法进行了系统评估，并公开了源代码和数据划分以保障可复现性。

Result: 通过系统性实验评估，论文建立了联邦RUL估计的可复现基线，量化了不同联邦优化算法在多种统计异质性条件下的性能表现，揭示了架构与算法之间的交互效应，为后续研究提供了公平比较的参照标准。

Conclusion: FedCMAPSS填补了联邦RUL估计领域缺乏统一评估框架的空白，为开发和比较联邦预测性维护解决方案提供了标准化的基础平台，有望推动该领域的规范化发展和可复现研究。

Abstract: Data-driven prognostics and health management has emerged as a key enabler for Industry 4.0, yet the development of robust remaining useful life (RUL) estimation models is often limited by the scarcity of run-to-failure data. While federated learning offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively train predictive models without sharing sensor data, research efforts have operated so far in the absence of a common evaluation framework. To address this gap, this paper introduces FedCMAPSS, a benchmark for federated RUL estimation based on the commonly-used NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We define a set of five standardized tasks designed to simulate real-world industrial challenges, ranging from ideal IID settings to extreme statistical heterogeneity, and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art federated optimization algorithms across multiple neural architectures. By establishing reproducible baselines and making the source code and data splits publicly available, this work aims to provide a standard foundation for developing and comparing federated predictive maintenance solutions.

</details>


### [264] [Distributed Training using an Intelligent Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26453)
*Nihar Shah,Ben Blier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出让广域网（WAN）本身成为分布式训练的主动参与者，利用组播（multicast）复制出站流量、内联FPGA聚合入站流量，并开发优化框架以生成围绕网络拓扑的同步调度（旋转的clique组合），在九城市DoubleZero网络上展示最优调度如何随网络能力变化，从而缩小与同地训练（colocated training）的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨广域网（WAN）的分布式训练极具挑战性，因为计算孤岛之间的持续参数交换受限于有限带宽、高延迟和不均匀的网络拓扑。现有技术（如组播和内联FPGA）已在数据中心内的跨worker训练中使用，但尚未扩展到WAN场景。

Method: 在系统层面，利用（i）组播技术复制出站流量和（ii）内联FPGA聚合入站流量，以缓解WAN中的出口和入口瓶颈；在算法层面，开发一个优化框架，生成围绕底层网络拓扑和上述技术的丰富同步调度（即岛屿的旋转clique组合），以最大化信息交换。

Result: 在基于DoubleZero网络的九城市拓扑上进行了验证，展示了最优调度如何随网络能力的变化而转变，并表明这些方法能有效缩小与同地训练这一黄金标准之间的差距。

Conclusion: 通过将网络作为训练中的主动参与者，结合硬件加速技术与拓扑感知的优化调度，可以显著缓解WAN环境对分布式训练性能的制约，使跨广域网训练更接近同地训练的效果。

Abstract: Distributed training across a wide area network (WAN) is challenging, as continuous parameter exchange by islands of compute is constrained by limited bandwidth, high latency, and uneven topology. We propose making the network an active participant in training. On the systems side, such networks should leverage (i) multicast technology to replicate outbound traffic and (ii) in-line FPGAs to aggregate inbound traffic, to ease egress and ingress bottlenecks. These technologies are used for training across workers within a data center, but this paper extends them to the WAN. On the algorithms side, we develop an optimization framework that produces rich synchronization schedules (namely, rotating cliques of islands) around the underlying network topology and these technologies, to maximize information exchange. Finally, we illustrate this on a nine-city topology modeled on the DoubleZero network, a live programmable WAN equipped with both technologies, and show how the optimal schedules shift with the network's capabilities. Together, these can narrow the gap to the gold standard of colocated training.

</details>


### [265] [NeoTriFuse: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Fusion under Missingness Heterogeneity for Neonatal Mortality Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26436)
*Jiyuan Tian,Qincheng Shen,Ye Lin,Yu Gao,Haohui Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeoTriFuse，一种可靠性感知的多模态融合框架，将缺失率建模为显式可靠性信号并动态调节模态贡献，用于新生儿死亡风险预测，在真实临床缺失条件下实现F1 0.6736和AUROC 0.9454的竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新生儿死亡风险预测面临极端类别不平衡、临床风险因素异质、多尺度时间动态和大量数据缺失等挑战。现有多模态方法主要将缺失视为预处理问题，未充分利用缺失模式本身蕴含的临床信息。

Method: NeoTriFuse框架将缺失视为显式可靠性信号，通过可靠性引导的门控机制动态调节各模态（静态围产期变量、局部-全局时间编码器、患者级统计摘要）在融合中的贡献；同时联合优化死亡预测任务和辅助住院时长（LOS）目标。

Result: F1分数达0.6736±0.0216，AUROC达0.9454±0.0056。消融实验表明局部-全局时间架构和患者级摘要分支贡献最大，可靠性感知门控在异构观测完整性下对阈值相关指标有额外提升，且对超参数扰动表现稳定。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的多模态融合是处理真实临床缺失条件下新生儿死亡预测的实用方案，将缺失信息转化为可靠性信号而非仅作预处理丢弃，具有临床应用价值。

Abstract: Neonatal mortality risk prediction from bedside monitoring data remains challenging due to extreme class imbalance, heterogeneous clinical risk factors, multi-scale temporal dynamics, and substantial missingness. We propose NeoTriFuse, a reliability-aware multimodal fusion framework for missingness-heterogeneous neonatal monitoring data. Unlike conventional multimodal approaches that treat missingness primarily as a preprocessing issue, NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal that dynamically modulates modality contributions during fusion. The framework integrates static perinatal variables, local-global temporal encoders, and patient-level statistical summaries through reliability-guided gating mechanisms, while jointly optimizing mortality prediction and an auxiliary length-of-stay objective. NeoTriFuse achieves competitive performance, with an F1 score of 0.6736 +/- 0.0216 and an AUROC of 0.9454 +/- 0.0056. Ablation studies indicate that the local-global temporal architecture and patient-level summary branch contribute most substantially to predictive performance, while reliability-aware gating provides additional improvements on threshold-dependent metrics under heterogeneous observation completeness. Sensitivity analyses further suggest stable performance across nearby hyperparameter settings. Overall, the findings support reliability-aware multimodal fusion as a practical approach for neonatal mortality prediction under realistic clinical missingness conditions.

</details>


### [266] [Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27046)
*Maciej Besta,Leonard Schmidt,Lara Nonino,Robert Gerstenberger,Pierre Pang,Patrik Okanovic,Ales Kubicek,Tiancheng Chen,Baraq Lipshitz,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在大型语言模型后训练中的应用，从计算角度对PPO、GRPO等算法框架进行分析，提出了一套涵盖传统与新型并行策略的RL-for-LLM并行性分类体系，并基于工作-深度模型（work-depth model）给出严谨分析，最后提炼实践指南并展望开放研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型（RLM）的训练计算开销巨大，需要数百万GPU小时和紧密耦合的多模型流水线，远超传统监督式LLM训练。这使得RLM训练不仅是算法问题，更是并行与分布式系统问题。当前缺乏对RL-for-LLM范式从计算与系统角度的系统性梳理，亟需一套理论框架来指导高效、可扩展且成本可控的RLM训练。

Method: 首先对RL-for-LLM范式进行系统性整理，并对PPO、GRPO及其变体等主流后训练算法框架进行以计算为中心的分析；其次构建RL-for-LLM的模型内与模型间并行策略分类体系，涵盖数据并行、张量并行、流水线并行、序列并行、上下文并行、专家并行等传统技术，以及解耦放置、阶段融合、混合并行、异步执行等新型多模型训练优化手段；最后借助并行计算中的工作-深度模型（work-depth model）使分类体系及其洞见严谨且可移植，并分析现有RLM框架。

Result: 产出了一套从计算视角出发的RL-for-LLM算法框架分析，建立了一个覆盖传统与新型并行化策略的系统化分类体系，并利用工作-深度模型提供了理论严谨性。基于对现有RLM框架的分析，提炼出面向可扩展、快速和高性价比RLM训练的实用指南及开放研究方向。

Conclusion: RLM训练本质上是一个并行与分布式系统问题，需要在算法设计与系统架构层面协同优化。通过系统化的并行策略分类和理论分析，可以为同时实现高性能、可扩展性和成本效益的RLM训练提供指导，但该领域仍存在大量开放的优化研究方向。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and other RL-style post-training paradigms have been used for aligning large language models (LLMs) with reasoning standards. The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. However, the computational footprint of these systems is massive: state-of-the-art RLM training requires millions of GPU-hours and tightly coupled multi-model pipelines that stress modern hardware far beyond classical supervised LLM training. This makes RLM training as much a parallel and distributed systems problem as an algorithmic one. In this work, to facilitate developing RLMs that are simultaneously high-performance, scalable, and cost-effective, we first systematize the RL-for-LLM paradigm and provide a compute-centric analysis of prominent post-training algorithmic frameworks: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), as well as their variants. Second, we develop a taxonomy of intra- and inter-model parallelism strategies for RL-for-LLMs, covering both traditional techniques (data, tensor, pipeline, sequence, context, and expert parallelism) as well as novel forms of parallelism and optimization techniques for multi-model RLM training, for example disaggregated placement, stage fusion, hybrid parallelism, and asynchronous execution. We harness the work-depth model of parallel computing to make our taxonomy and its insights rigorous and portable. Finally, we analyze existing RLM frameworks and we distill practical guidelines and outline open research directions for building scalable, fast, and cost-effective RLMs.

</details>


### [267] [Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26437)
*Haohui Lu,jiyuan Tian,Fangyu Zhou,Shahadat Uddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SF-GNN是一个轻量级、架构无关的图神经网络公平性框架，通过识别并过滤"偏置边缘"（结合敏感同质性和结构传播放大器），在消息传递过程中随机剔除或降权这些边缘，从源头缓解结构性偏置，同时用统计奇偶正则化器稳定训练，在五个基准数据集上实现公平性与准确率的更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN即使排除敏感属性仍可能因图拓扑和消息传递在敏感同质性下传播群体相关信号而表现不公平。已有的公平性GNN方法主要在全局层面约束表示或预测分布，缺乏对聚合过程中偏置信息传播的局部结构路径的显式控制。

Method: SF-GNN提出三个关键步骤：(1) 结合敏感同质性与结构传播放大器（枢纽参与和三角闭包）识别易偏置边缘；(2) 在每一步消息传递中引入随机边缘过滤，选择性降权或移除偏置边缘，保留其余图结构；(3) 训练中引入带预热调度的统计奇偶正则化器以稳定优化。该框架轻量且与具体GNN架构无关。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，SF-GNN在保持一致预测性能的同时实现了持续的公平性改进，相较于近期公平性感知GNN基线获得了更好的公平性-准确率权衡。

Conclusion: SF-GNN通过从结构源头干预偏置传播路径，为图神经网络公平性提供了一种轻量、即插即用的解决方案，验证了在局部结构层面控制偏置传播的有效性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can exhibit unfair behavior even when sensitive attributes are excluded from node features, because graph topology and message passing propagate group-correlated signals under sensitive homophily. Existing fairness-aware GNN methods mainly constrain representations or prediction distributions at a global level, without explicitly controlling the local structural pathways through which biased information propagates during aggregation. We propose Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks (SF-GNN), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that mitigates structural bias at its source. SF-GNN identifies bias-prone edges by combining sensitive homophily with structural propagation amplifiers, including hub participation and triadic closure. It then incorporates stochastic edge filtering into each message-passing step to selectively downweight or remove these edges while preserving the remaining graph structure. Training further incorporates a statistical-parity regularizer with a warm-up schedule to stabilize optimization. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show that SF-GNN achieves consistent fairness improvements while maintaining competitive predictive performance, leading to a better fairness--accuracy trade-off than recent fairness-aware GNN baselines.

</details>


### [268] [Toward Equitable Low-Carbon Mobility: Fairness-Aware Demand Prediction for Expanding Bike-Sharing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26451)
*Man Luo,Yixuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FairGIN是一个公平感知的图神经网络模型，用于自行车共享系统中的需求预测，通过三种机制（扩张模拟增量训练、注意力知识迁移、公平感知优化）同时解决冷启动预测和收入不平等资源分配问题，在纽约和西雅图数据集上实现了最先进的预测精度并显著减少收入差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自行车共享系统的持续扩展带来两个核心挑战：(1) 新部署站点缺乏历史骑行记录，导致图模型在训练与推理之间存在冷启动分布不匹配；(2) 历史需求数据可能编码结构性不平等（低收入社区骑行量低反映基础设施不足而非真实需求弱），直接训练会强化既有出行差距。

Method: FairGIN包含三个核心组件：(1) Expansion-Simulated Increment Training（扩张模拟增量训练），在训练中随机模拟网络扩张以缩小冷启动分布差距；(2) Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer（基于注意力的知识迁移），结合站点自适应温度缩放与正交嵌入对齐，将数据丰富站点的表征迁移到数据稀疏的新站点；(3) Fairness-Aware Optimization（公平感知优化），引入收入分层正则化和公平校准的部署评分，支持更包容的站点布局。

Result: 在纽约和西雅图的实验中，FairGIN在各种扩张场景下达到了最先进的预测精度，同时在不牺牲整体系统效率的前提下显著减少了基于收入的差异。

Conclusion: FairGIN证明了在扩张中的自行车共享系统中，可以将预测精度与公平性同时优化，为城市共享出行系统的可持续和包容性扩展提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Bike-sharing systems are an important component of low-carbon urban mobility, but continued expansion creates challenges in both cold-start prediction and equitable resource allocation. Newly deployed stations lack historical ridership records, causing a mismatch between training and inference for graph-based models on evolving networks. Historical demand may also encode structural inequalities, as lower ridership in low-income neighborhoods can reflect limited infrastructure access rather than weak latent demand. Models trained directly on such data may therefore reinforce existing mobility disparities. We propose FairGIN, a fairness-aware graph neural network for demand prediction in expanding bike-sharing systems. FairGIN integrates three components. Expansion-Simulated Increment Training stochastically simulates network expansion during training to reduce the cold-start distribution gap. Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer combines station-adaptive temperature scaling with orthogonal embedding alignment to transfer representations from data-rich existing stations to data-sparse new stations. Fairness-Aware Optimization introduces income-stratified regularization and an equity-calibrated deployment score to support more inclusive station placement. Experiments on NYC and Seattle demonstrate that FairGIN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy across diverse expansion scenarios while substantially reducing income-based disparities without compromising overall system efficiency.

</details>


### [269] [Diff Mining: Logit Differences Reveal Finetuning Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26462)
*Greg Kocher,Robert West,Clément Dumas,Julian Minder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Diff Mining框架，通过比较微调模型与基础模型的logits输出来识别微调过程中模型学习到的新行为，无需访问模型内部结构，仅需输出logits即可扩展到大规模模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调已成为语言模型调整行为的黄金标准，但微调过程中具体涌现了哪些行为仍不清晰。随着模型能力增强，理解微调效果变得日益重要，尤其是微调可能引入不期望的行为，因此需要有效的审计工具来检测微调目标。

Method: Diff Mining包含两个模块化阶段：(1) 在参考语料上提取微调模型与基础模型之间每个上下文的logits差异；(2) 聚合这些差异信号构建可解释的token集合来表示微调内容。聚合阶段探索了两种方法：简单的Top-K频率方法和基于非负矩阵分解（NMF）的方法，后者可分离多个微调目标为不同的token聚类。

Result: 在微调域检测任务中，Diff Mining显著优于最先进模型diffing方法，在识别相关token方面和下游性能方面均表现更好；在注入偏差的模型中，无需定向探测即可识别超过三分之一的偏差。此外，即使在与微调领域无关的文本上也能有效识别微调指纹。

Conclusion: Diff Mining在大规模模型上仅需logits访问即可有效识别微调目标，展现出作为审计工具检测微调目标的潜力，尤其在识别微调中引入的不期望行为方面具有前景。

Abstract: Finetuning has become the gold standard for refining existing behaviors and inducing new ones in language models, yet it often remains unclear exactly which behaviors emerge during this process. As models grow ever more capable, understanding finetuning better becomes increasingly important, particularly since unwanted behaviors may arise during finetuning. In this paper, we introduce Diff Mining, a simple yet effective framework for identifying what a finetuned model has learned by comparing its logits to those of its base model. Diff Mining effectively surfaces salient tokens that are amplified in the finetuned model, serving as a fingerprint of its training -- even on text unrelated to the finetuning domain. Unlike many existing model diffing methods which require model internals, Diff Mining only needs access to output logits and scales to large models. The framework consists of two modular stages: (i) extracting per-context logit differences between the finetuned and base models on a reference corpus, and (ii) aggregating the resulting signals to construct an interpretable token set representing the finetune. For aggregation, we explore both a simple Top-K frequency method and a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF)-based approach for disentangling multiple finetuning objectives into distinct token clusters. Empirically, Diff Mining succeeds across diverse settings: on finetune domain detection, it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art model diffing methods both in identifying relevant tokens and in downstream performance when an interpretability agent is given access to the extracted token set; on models with injected biases, it identifies more than one third of the biases without targeted probing. Overall, our framework shows promise in developing auditing tools to detect finetuning objectives.

</details>


### [270] [Active Curriculum Refinement for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26469)
*Zhenya Liu,Yuxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PATH是一个基于课程图的主动学习框架，通过显式建模环境间的先决关系（有向无环图），先采样多样化课程路径以扩展覆盖范围，再重新分配训练资源至未掌握区域，从而提升强化学习的鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多强化学习环境中，任务间存在先决关系（如难度递增的编辑或参数增量），形成有向无环课程图（DAG）。虽然这种结构常被隐式利用，但显式建模它可以显著改善训练效果。

Method: PATH框架包含两个关键步骤：(1)通过采样多样化的课程路径来扩展覆盖范围；(2)将训练资源重新分配至尚未掌握的区域，实现对课程图的主动学习。

Result: 在多个不同环境的实验中，PATH显式利用图结构，展现出强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 显式建模并利用课程图的DAG结构进行主动学习，可以有效提升强化学习训练的稳健性与泛化性能。

Abstract: In many reinforcement learning (RL) domains, environments are connected by prerequisite relations, such as difficulty-increasing edits or parameter increments, which induce a directed acyclic curriculum graph (DAG). Although this structure is often exploited only implicitly, explicitly modeling it can improve training. We introduce PATH, a curriculum-learning framework that performs active learning over the curriculum graph. PATH first expands coverage by sampling diverse curriculum paths and then reallocates training toward regions that remain unmastered. Experiments across diverse environments show that PATH explicitly leverages the graph structure to achieve strong robustness and generalization.

</details>


### [271] [Shared Actors Need Not Share Critics: Effects of Value Mismatch in Parallel Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26481)
*Zhenya Liu,Yang Meng,Zhuokai Zhao,Xuefeng Liu,Yuxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究并行强化学习中多个环境共享一个critic导致的价值不匹配（value mismatch）问题，指出不同环境对同一观测可能分配不同期望回报，共享critic被迫调和这些不同的价值目标，从而系统性地偏移采样优势（advantages），扭曲策略更新。作者通过多环境bandit模型的理论分析揭示了共享critic如何强化无益动作并削弱甚至反转有用动作，并提出一个极简干预方案——仅向critic提供一个环境索引（multihead conditional critic），使其能够分离价值目标。实验在CartPole、MuJoCo、BipedalWalker和全部16个Procgen游戏上验证了该方法，在Procgen的600个未见关卡上提升了40.8%的归一化回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在并行强化学习中（如程序化生成关卡、随机化动力学或课程学习），常见做法是多个环境共享一个critic。然而不同环境对critic可见的同一输入可能分配不同的期望回报，导致共享critic被迫调和不同的价值目标，系统性偏移采样得到的优势估计，从而影响策略更新的正确性。作者旨在理解这一退化机制并提出有效干预。

Method: 首先构建带多个环境和单一最优臂的bandit模型，理论上刻画价值不匹配如何重新分配策略更新——强化无帮助动作、衰减甚至反转有用动作。证明在固定策略下，使用无基线、共享价值或环境特定价值的oracle过程具有相同的平均logit更新并能收敛到同一最优策略，但实际学习路径差异显著。基于此提出最小干预：只向critic提供记录的环境索引，使其用多头结构分离各环境的价值目标。在CartPole、MuJoCo、BipedalWalker和16个Procgen游戏上进行对照实验验证。

Result: 受控的CartPole和MuJoCo实验验证了理论预测的偏移价值、偏移优势和性能差距。在BipedalWalker和Procgen中，条件化干预带来更稳定的学习和更高的回报。在全部16个Procgen游戏中，多头条件critic在每个游戏的600个未见关卡上将聚合归一化回报提升了40.8%。

Conclusion: 理论分析识别出价值不匹配是共享critic退化解随机学习动力学的直接机制，这种退化无法仅靠标量估计器的方差来解释。实验证明基于索引的条件化处理在并行强化学习中广泛有效，为该问题提供了一个简单、通用的解决方案。
