At a frozen software snapshot, a selected manifest of 1,457 portable offline backend contract tests passed; 596 cases were retrospectively mapped to six contract families central to the reported LLM-agent architecture. This evidence establishes implementation conformance for the tested software contracts, not superior report quality, forecasting accuracy, or investment returns.

</details>


### [403] [ASIL: Replacing Screenshot-and-Click with Structured State and Semantic Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26991)
*Rui Xie,Lu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ASIL（Agent-Software Interaction Layer），一种面向软件操作Agent的原生交互界面，通过结构化JSON观测和可执行语义动作代替截图-点击方式，在15个应用、380个任务上达到80%以上的成功率，且显著优于GUI和部分原生API方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强大的代码型Agent能执行脚本和调用工具，但许多重要应用仍主要通过图形用户界面访问。截图-点击界面效率低下：截图无法完整表示状态，GUI动作脆弱、语义弱，且不适合长时序规划。需要一种更高效的Agent与软件交互的方式。

Method: 提出ASIL层，将软件暴露为结构化JSON观测和可执行语义动作，通过每个应用可行的最深访问路径实现（如API、UNO等）。在15个应用上实例化，构建300个单应用和80个多应用任务的基准。同时使用SFT和资源受限的on-policy RL进行小规模训练。

Result: ASIL在闭源模型上达到80%以上成功率，平均每个任务执行少于5个动作。在修复后的运行时和50步截图预算下，同一任务在截图-点击控制下仅取得6.6和26.6的严格成功率（容易版为15.0和53.3）。相比应用原生接口，ASIL超过LibreOffice UNO API 28-38个严格点，与draw.io MCP相当。小规模SFT将Qwen3.5-2B从58.0提至72.1，Qwen3.5-9B从66.6提至80.4；on-policy RL进一步提至74.4和82.2。

Conclusion: ASIL证明结构化、代码执行的交互层比截图-点击界面在软件操作Agent上具有显著优势，且在训练效率和性能上均有出色表现，为Agent-软件交互提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Powerful code agents can execute scripts, call tools, and manage files, yet many important applications remain accessible primarily through graphical user interfaces. We argue that screenshot-and-click is an inefficient interface for software-operating agents: screenshots are state-incomplete, and GUI actions are brittle, semantically weak, and poorly matched to long-horizon planning. We introduce ASIL (Agent-Software Interaction Layer), an agent-native interface that exposes software through structured JSON observations and code-executable semantic actions, realized through the deepest feasible access path for each application. We instantiate ASIL across 15 applications and a benchmark of 300 single-application and 80 multi-application tasks. ASIL reaches above 80 with closed models while executing fewer than five actions per task. Under a repaired runtime and a 50-step screenshot budget, the same tasks yield 6.6 and 26.6 strict success under screenshot-and-click control, rising to 15.0 and 53.3 on an easier OSWorld-comparable band. Against application-native interfaces on matched tasks, ASIL exceeds LibreOffice's UNO API by 28-38 strict points but only matches draw.io's MCP content contract. The structured modality also suits training: small-scale SFT raises Qwen3.5-2B from 58.0 to 72.1 and Qwen3.5-9B from 66.6 to 80.4, and resource-limited on-policy RL further raises them to 74.4 and 82.2.

</details>


### [404] [A Multi-Modal AI Framework for Real-Time Queue Prediction, Management and Optimisation in Intelligent Border Control Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27010)
*Varvara Mama,Eleni Veroni,Nikolaos Kapsalis,Christos D. Nikolopoulos,Anargyros T. Baklezos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多模态人工智能框架的高效边境管控程序，利用LSTM网络进行实时队列预测，并结合模型预测控制与调度优化实现动态资源分配。在合成数据评估中，该方法相比ARIMA和规则方法将队列预测误差降低35%，平均等待时间减少30%，吞吐量提升近20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的运维队列管理系统基于静态数据运作，无法适应动态交通条件，在不确定性场景下难以实现最优性能。边境管控系统需要一种能够考虑实时交通状况、实现预测、管理和资源优化的高效方案。

Method: 提出多模态AI框架，集成异构数据源并通过统一表示呈现；采用LSTM网络进行队列预测，利用模型预测控制（MPC）和调度优化生成可操作的控制策略，呈现给边境管控人员。

Result: 使用模拟真实交通的合成数据进行评估，结果显示队列预测误差减少35%，平均等待时间降低30%，吞吐量提升近20%，均优于ARIMA和基于规则的方法。

Conclusion: 将AI架构与优化技术相结合，能够实现主动且自适应的边境交通管理，验证了该方法在效率和有效性方面的优势。

Abstract: In the present work an efficient border control management procedure is proposed. Compared to operational queue management systems, whose operations are based on mostly static data, the proposed work takes into account dynamic traffic conditions, thus enabling optimal performance, even in cases of uncertainty. To this end, we are proposing a multi-modal Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework, tailored to th needs of border control systems, which enables real-time queue prediction, management, and resource optimization. The novel proposed approach integrates heterogeneous data sources and presents them through a unified representation by employing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for queue forecasting. Furthermore, it leverages Model Predictive Control (MPC) and scheduling optimization to derive actionable control policies, which in turn can be presented to border control officers. The proposed work has been evaluated using synthetic data simulating realistic traffic. The evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces queue prediction error by up to 35% and average waiting time by 30%. Accordingly, the average throughput increases by nearly 20%, compared to ARIMA and rule-based methods. The abovementioned results show the effectiveness and efficiency of combining AI architectures with optimization techniques for proactive and adaptive border traffic management.

</details>


### [405] [Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27044)
*Wei-Yao Wang,Kazuya Tateishi,Shuyang Cui,Christian Simon,Takashi Shibuya,Shusuke Takahashi,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniUE（Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder），这是首个支持文本、视频、音频跨模态统一嵌入空间，并支持全模态交互式查询（文本、视觉区域、音频片段）的通用嵌入模型。同时引入OmniCHOIR基准来评估全模态交互组合检索能力，实验表明OmniUE在多项基准上超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态表示学习正从传统双塔架构转向基于大语言模型（LLM）的嵌入器，但已有方法主要聚焦于语言和图像两种模态，且用户交互方式也主要局限于这两种模态。作者希望打破这一限制，提出一个能够统一文本、视频、音频三种模态，并支持用户以多种交互形式（文本、视觉区域、音频片段）进行查询的通用嵌入器。

Method: OmniUE通过以下核心设计实现：(1) 利用可学习的special token的中间层表示来学习文本、视频、音频的统一嵌入空间；(2) 视觉和音频分割器（segmenters）处理多样化的用户交互输入；(3) 将分割器与全模态LLM（omni-LLM）集成，通过上下文聚合（context aggregation）生成用户条件化的任意到任意（any-to-any）嵌入。

Result: OmniUE在多个基准上超越SOTA方法：文本交互视频基准（MMEB-v2-video）平均提升10.5%，音频任务（MAEB）提升1.1%，视觉交互基准（SCaR）提升83.7%，以及新提出的全模态交互基准OmniCHOIR上提升24.1%。

Conclusion: 作者认为，同时推进全模态表示学习和全模态交互式查询是通往通用嵌入器（universal embedders）的关键路径。OmniUE的成功表明将文本、视频、音频统一到同一嵌入空间并支持灵活的用户交互方式是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Multimodal representation learning has been shifting from traditional two-tower architectures to large language model (LLM)-based embedders due to their strong instruction-following capabilities. Despite this progress, existing approaches primarily focus on language and image modalities, which also remain the dominant modalities for user-conditioned interactions in current embedders. In this paper, we propose the first Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder (OmniUE), which not only learns a unified embedding space across text, video, and audio by leveraging intermediate-layer representations from dedicated learnable tokens, but also supports omni-interactive querying, enabling users to provide inputs in the form of text, visual regions of interest, and audio spans. Within OmniUE, visual and audio segmenters process diverse user interactions and integrate them with an omni-LLM to produce user-conditioned any-to-any embeddings via context aggregation. To evaluate OmniUE's omni-interactive capabilities, we introduce OmniCHOIR, benchmarking models for omni-interactive compositional audio retrieval based on the given text, video, and audio as well as unimodal or multimodal interaction prompts. OmniUE consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines across diverse modalities, with average improvements of 10.5% on textual-interactive video benchmarks (MMEB-v2-video), 1.1% on audio tasks (MAEB), 83.7% on visual-interactive benchmarks (SCaR), and 24.1% on our omni-interactive OmniCHOIR benchmark. We believe that jointly advancing omni-modal representation learning and omni-interactive querying paves the way toward universal embedders.

</details>


### [406] [A Contract-Centered Architecture for Scalable and Manageable Agentic Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27086)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Zhenghe Hou,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出企业级AI部署的协调问题，引入四个责任对象（Skill、Harness、Scaffold和栈外数据底座）作为组织间共享契约，并提出了唯一有界可证伪假设P1（成本感知的能力-容量可分离性），设计了群组周期随机交叉实验来验证该假设，但本文尚未完成任何实现、实验、数据集或测量结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI部署本质上是跨业务单元、应用团队、AI团队、测试、平台工程、基础设施、安全、运维和数据治理的协调问题。现有的用例基准只能验证单个智能体是否完成单个任务，无法回答能力、模型、运行时机制、容量和企业数据应如何被共同拥有、变更、准入和验证的问题。

Method: 提出四个责任对象作为组织级共享契约：Skill（可复用、带版本的能力和工作流资产）、Harness（运行时编译器和治理器）、Scaffold（执行/控制边界及非功能需求所有者）、以及由CIO独立治理语义和遥测的栈外数据底座。运行时核心为A=<S,H,X>，数据底座位于栈外。核心贡献是一个有界可证伪假设P1（成本感知的能力-容量可分离性），在声明运行区域内，变更激活能力在预设等价边界内保持容量-响应交互，变更兼容Scaffold容量在非劣性边界内保持能力语义，所需控制不超出声明的执行预算。六个设计条件转化为可测量的义务，其覆盖率、违规、不确定性、成本和排除项决定P1是否可判定。提出群组周期随机交叉实验（平衡顺序、重置/洗脱、重复种子和故障体制、集群感知不确定性），给出四种判定状态：支持、证伪、条件工程、不确定。

Result: 本文贡献了契约约束的运行时架构、源保持的数据底座和可证伪的测量协议。论文明确声明尚未报告完整的实现、实验、数据集或测量结果。

Conclusion: 该论文处于理论框架和协议设计阶段，贡献在于为企业AI部署提供了一个可度量的架构抽象和严格的实验设计框架，后续需要通过实际实现和实验数据来验证P1假设的可判定性与工程适用性。

Abstract: Enterprise AI deployment is a coordination problem across business units, application and AI teams, testing, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, operations, and data governance. Use-case benchmarks show whether one agent completes one task, but not how changing capabilities, models, runtime mechanisms, capacity, and enterprise data should be owned, changed, admitted, or evidenced together.
  We present four responsibility objects as shared organizational contracts: Skill (reusable, versioned capability and workflow asset), Harness (runtime compiler and governor), Scaffold (execution/control boundary and NFR owner), and a stack-external data substrate under independent CIO-governed semantics and telemetry. The runtime core is A = <S, H, X>, with the data substrate outside that stack.
  The central contribution is one bounded, falsifiable hypothesis, P1 (cost-aware capability-capacity separability): within a declared operating region, changing activated capability preserves the capacity-response interaction within a preregistered equivalence margin, while changing compatible Scaffold capacity preserves capability semantics up to a non-inferiority margin, and the required controls stay within a declared enforcement budget. Six design conditions become measured obligations whose coverage, violations, uncertainty, cost, and exclusions determine whether P1 is decidable.
  We propose a cluster-period randomized crossover experiment (balanced order, reset/washout, repeated seeds and failure regimes, cluster-aware uncertainty) with a four-state verdict: supported, falsified, conditional-engineering, or inconclusive. This paper contributes a contract-bounded runtime architecture, a source-preserving data substrate, and a falsifiable measurement protocol. It reports no completed implementation, experiment, dataset, or measured result.

</details>


### [407] [pro-team at LLMs4OL 2026 Tasks Flagship and Reuse: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Vocabulary-Constrained Filtering for Ontology Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27101)
*Shivam Mishra,Dhannu Ram Meena,Muneendra Ojha,Krishna Pratap Singh,Kuldeep Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种离线检索增强的少样本提示流水线来解决LLMs4OL 2026挑战赛的端到端旗舰任务（Task A）和本体扩展复用任务（Task B），使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct搭配all-MiniLM-L6-v2进行演示检索，并通过左截断上下文窗口策略和词汇约束过滤来提升性能。Task B在语义图相似度上达到0.8692，Term-Typing F1为0.9200，Taxonomy Discovery F1为0.8540，Task A语义图相似度为0.7416，但未能提取非分类关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在多领域取得了显著进步，但在本体学习中仍存在领域术语幻觉、格式不一致以及对层级关系偏好于关联关系等问题。为了解决这些挑战，作者参加了LLMs4OL 2026挑战赛，旨在通过端到端本体构建和本体扩展复用两个任务来验证系统的有效性。

Method: 系统采用离线检索增强的少样本提示流水线，使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct作为基础模型，配合all-MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入模型进行演示检索（Task A选top-5，Task B选top-2）。采用左截断的上下文窗口策略以在长提示中保留任务指令。对于Task B，生成的三元组经过确定性词汇约束过滤，仅保留至少一个端点属于样本封闭术语/类型词汇表的三元组并去重初始本体的重复项。

Result: Task B取得了语义图相似度0.8692、Term-Typing F1 0.9200和Taxonomy Discovery F1 0.8540的成绩；Task A的语义图相似度为0.7416。然而系统未能提取任何非分类关系，反映出封闭的、面向分类法的关系词汇表的局限性。

Conclusion: 所提出的检索增强少样本提示方法在本体学习任务中表现良好，尤其在Task B上获得了较高的语义图相似度和F1分数。但非分类关系提取的缺失表明当前封闭关系词汇表的约束限制了三元组的关联发现能力，未来需要扩展关系类型或采用更开放的关系生成策略。

Abstract: Ontology learning from text remains challenging despite significant progress in Large Language Models (LLMs), which can hallucinate domain terms, produce inconsistent formats, and favor hierarchical over associative relations. In the LLMs4OL 2026 Challenge, we address both the End-to-End Flagship Task (Task A) and Ontology Extension Reuse Task (Task B) using an offline retrieval-augmented few-shot prompting pipeline. Our system employs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for demonstration retrieval, selecting the top-5 examples for Task A and top-2 for Task B. A left-truncated context-windowing strategy preserves task instructions within long prompts. For Task B, generated triples undergo deterministic vocabulary-constrained filtering, retaining triples when at least one endpoint belongs to the sample's closed term/type vocabulary and removing duplicates of the initial ontology. The approach achieves Semantic Graph Similarity of 0.8692, Term-Typing F1 of 0.9200, and Taxonomy Discovery F1 of 0.8540 on Task B, while Task A achieves 0.7416 Semantic Graph Similarity. However, no non-taxonomic relations are extracted, highlighting limitations of closed, taxonomy-oriented relation vocabularies.

</details>


### [408] [TransMeme: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Cultural Meme Transcreation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27127)
*Jingyi Zheng,Yule Liu,Zifan Peng,Tianyi Hu,Yuemeng Zhao,Xinhu Zheng,Xinlei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体框架用于跨文化迷因（meme）转创（transcreation），解决文化知识理解、意图与语气保持、多模态一致性三大核心挑战。在双向中英迷因转创任务上，该方法在人类评估和LLM-as-a-Judge两种评估设置下均优于所有基线，人类评估中平均提升33.1%，LLM-as-a-Judge中Top-1排名率达60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络迷因是普遍的多模态在线交流形式，但用户来自不同语言和文化背景。跨文化迷因转创对于促进在线交流中的相互理解至关重要，但这不同于普通翻译或单独文本改写，需要同时保持交际意图、适应目标受众的文化相关含义，并维持文本与图像之间的一致性，具有独特挑战。

Method: 首先对跨文化迷因转创任务进行显式任务分析，识别三大核心挑战：文化特定知识理解、意图与语气保持、多模态一致性。基于此提出多智能体框架，包含专门化的智能体，通过文化适配、目标文本改写、修订和有条件的视觉调整协同解决这些挑战。该框架通过协调反馈增强目标文本适配，以处理需要更深层文化或视觉干预的困难案例。

Result: 在双向中英迷因转创上评估，方法在人类评估和LLM-as-a-Judge两种设置下均一致优于所有基线。人类评估中，在全部四个维度获得最佳性能，平均提升最强基线33.1%；LLM-as-a-Judge中，Top-1排名率达60%（第二好基线为26%）。消融分析表明每个组件都对性能有贡献。错误分析显示剩余瓶颈主要在于幽默重构和图文对齐，而非简单的文化知识缺口。

Conclusion: 多智能体框架有效解决了跨文化迷因转创中的核心挑战，但幽默迁移仍是未来需要重点突破的方向。该工作为多模态跨文化交流任务提供了清晰的任务分析和有效的方法框架。

Abstract: Internet memes are a pervasive form of multimodal online communication; however, such communication often involves users from diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds. Therefore, adapting memes across cultures and languages is a central challenge for enabling mutual understanding in online communication. Unlike ordinary translation or standalone text rewriting, cross-cultural meme transcreation must jointly preserve communicative intent, adapt culture-dependent meaning for the target audience, and maintain coherence between text and image. In this work, we first provide an explicit task analysis of cross-cultural meme transcreation and identify three core challenges: culture-specific knowledge understanding, intent and tone preservation, and multimodal consistency. Based on this analysis, we propose a multi-agent framework with specialized agents that are coordinated to address these challenges through cultural adaptation, target text rewriting, revision, and conditional visual adjustment. The framework strengthens target text adaptation with coordinated feedback to handle difficult cases that require deeper cultural or visual intervention. We evaluate the framework on bidirectional Chinese-English meme transcreation using both human evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge. Our method consistently outperforms all baselines across both evaluation settings. In human evaluation, it achieves the best performance on all four dimensions and delivers a 33.1% average improvement over the strongest baseline, while in LLM-as-a-Judge, it attains the highest Top-1 ranking rate (60% versus 26% for the second-best baseline). Further analysis indicates that each component contributes to the performance. Our error analysis suggests that the remaining bottlenecks lie in humor reconstruction and image-text alignment rather than simple cultural knowledge gaps, pointing to future work on humor transfer.

</details>


### [409] [GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27142)
*Zike Yuan,Han Zhang,Jianzhi Yan,Le Liu,Cai Ke,Huozhi Zhou,Jian Xie,Jiran Yin,Yukun Cao,Yue Yu,Hui Wang,Ming Liu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GRAIN框架，通过强化学习优化单智能体系统的语义解析和图工具执行流程，并引入结构不变性奖励来增强LLM对节点标识符和任务表述变化的鲁棒性；同时提出GRIT基准评估语言偏移敏感性。GRAIN在准确率上超过多智能体基线16.45%，延迟降低约24%，并将OOD差距从15.77%减半至7.80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在标准化图任务中表现良好，但对现实世界中的节点标识符变化和任务表述方式的变化非常脆弱。现有的确定性图工具具有不变性，但LLM从噪声文本中提取拓扑结构时容易过拟合表面模式；多智能体系统虽可缓解解析失败但延迟过高。因此需要一个既能鲁棒解析又能保持高效的单智能体方案。

Method: GRAIN采用单智能体框架，将推理建模为语义解析与工具执行的流水线，并通过强化学习进行优化。核心机制是结构不变性奖励（Structure Invariance Reward），它将提取的中间图与真实拓扑结构进行验证，迫使LLM学习稳健的文本到结构映射而非记忆语言伪影。同时引入GRIT基准用于评估对语言偏移的敏感性。

Result: GRAIN在多智能体基线上准确率提升16.45%，延迟降低约24%；在结构泛化上表现优异，将SFT模型的OOD差距从15.77%减半至7.80%；在超出训练分布的大规模图上仍保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过结构不变性奖励驱动的强化学习，单智能体GRAIN能够在不牺牲效率的前提下实现与甚至超越多智能体系统的鲁棒性，有效缩小OOD泛化差距，为LLM在图任务中的实际部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Despite their potential in standardized graph tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain brittle to real-world shifts in node identifiers and task formulation. While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework optimized via reinforcement learning. GRAIN models reasoning as a semantic parsing and tool-execution pipeline, guided by a Structure Invariance Reward. By validating extracted intermediate graphs against ground-truth topologies, this reward forces the LLM to learn robust text-to-structure mappings rather than memorizing linguistic artifacts. We also introduce GRIT, a benchmark evaluating sensitivity to such linguistic shifts. GRAIN outperforms multi-agent baselines by 16.45\% in accuracy with approximately 24\% lower latency. Furthermore, it demonstrates superior structural generalization, halving the out-of-distribution (OOD) gap of SFT models (from 15.77\% to 7.80\%) and maintaining robustness on large-scale graphs beyond the training distribution.

</details>


### [410] [Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering for Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27144)
*Xiang Wang,Zhijun Cheng,Zhenyu Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出JPGFN（特征变换增强的雅可比多项式图滤波网络）用于图异常检测，通过特征分离变换网络学习细粒度节点特征、基于雅可比多项式的自适应图滤波模块捕获复杂频域特征、以及节点标签约束模块充分利用标签信息，在多个真实数据集上显著优于主流方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于频域滤波的图异常检测方法存在三大挑战：（1）使用静态基函数构建图滤波器，无法自适应适配图数据的频域分布；（2）未充分考虑节点特征向量中各属性的重要性信息，导致细粒度信息丢失；（3）对节点标签的利用不足。

Method: 提出三个核心模块：（1）特征分离变换网络（FSTNN），通过特征分离并对不同维度的节点特征施加非线性变换来学习细粒度节点特征；（2）基于雅可比多项式的自适应图滤波模块，动态捕获图信号的复杂频域特征；（3）节点标签约束模块，充分利用节点标签提升异常检测性能。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的JPGFN方法显著优于主流基线方法。

Conclusion: JPGFN通过自适应图滤波、细粒度特征学习与标签约束的有效结合，为解决图异常检测中频域自适应、特征细粒度化和标签利用三大问题提供了可行方案，展现出优越性能。

Abstract: In recent years, graph anomaly detection (GAD) based on frequency-domain filtering have achieved promising results. However, existing approaches still face three major challenges: First, they use static basic function to constructed graph filter which cannot effectively adapt to the frequency-domain distribution of graph data. Second, they fail to adequately consider the importance information of each attribute in the node feature vector, leading to the loss of fine-grained information. Third, they insufficiently utilize node labels for GAD. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel graph anomaly detection method called JPGFN (Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering Network). First, a Feature Separation Transformation Network (FSTNN) is developed to better learn fine-grained node features by feature separation and applying nonlinear transformations to node features across different dimensions. Second, an adaptive Jacobi polynomial graph filtering module is constructed based on Jacobi polynomials to adaptively capture complex frequency-domain features of graph signals. Finally, a node label constraint module is developed to facilitate the use of node labels and enhance the performance of GAD. Experimental results on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms mainstream approaches.

</details>


### [411] [When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27146)
*Xiaokun Guo,Zhen Xu,Dongdong Huo,Yanqiu Zhang,Wei Wang,Qinfu Yang,Dongjin Yu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SARA提出将动作归纳与执行授权分离的框架，通过上下文隔离的Action Probe区分动作来源与执行权限，并采用No-History-Promotion防止历史动作混淆授权边界，将攻击成功率限制在0.63%以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强的LLM智能体依赖不可信的工具输出完成任务，但当工具输出从提供数据转变为指定具体动作时，它们实际上成为可驱动真实世界副作用的"命令"，超出用户意图。现有风险在于混淆了动作归纳与执行授权这两种不同的概念。

Method: SARA将动作归纳与执行授权视为不同的运行时角色，从动作来源与执行权限两方面分离。观察侧采用上下文隔离的Action Probe暴露动作归纳语义并跨步骤记录动作来源作为审查信号；执行侧仅在满足目标、执行链和参数级支持时，基于用户目标和已授权成功执行的审计证据来授权实际工具调用。多步执行中采用No-History-Promotion防止历史循环将动作来源"洗白"为执行权威。

Result: 在AgentDojo和AgentDyn基准上，SARA在四个主要评估设置中将攻击成功率限制在不超过0.63%，同时保持具有竞争力的任务效用，并在额外Agent骨干网络上持续降低攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 通过严格分离动作归纳与执行授权，SARA有效缓解了不可信工具输出被用作命令的风险，在保障任务效用的同时显著降低攻击成功率，为工具增强LLM智能体的安全授权提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents must rely on untrusted runtime Observations to complete open-ended tasks; however, when tool outputs no longer merely provide data but begin to specify concrete actions, they effectively become ``commands'' that can drive real-world side effects beyond user intent. We argue that this risk arises from conflating action induction with execution authorization. To address this distinction, we propose SARA, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinct runtime roles and separates action provenance from execution authority. On the Observation side, a context-isolated Action Probe exposes action-inducing semantics and persistently records action-origin provenance across steps as a review signal; on the execution side, actual tool calls are authorized only against the user objective and audited evidence from authorized successful executions, while satisfying goal, execution-chain, and argument-level support. To preserve this separation across multi-step execution, SARA applies No-History-Promotion to prevent historical recurrence from laundering action origins into execution authority. Across AgentDojo and AgentDyn, SARA limits ASR to no more than \(0.63\%\) across four primary evaluation settings while maintaining competitive task utility, and consistently reduces ASR across additional Agent backbones.

</details>


### [412] [Thomson: Continual Learning of Frontier Models for SovereignAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27147)
*Shengzhuang Chen,Jerrod Parker,Yejin Bang,Andrew M. Bean,Nabeel Seedat,Stefan Winzeck,Daniil Glazko,Jannik Zgraggen,Fangyi Yu,Scott Arnott,Dietrich Trautmann,Luca Ciuffreda,Guglielmo Bonifazi,Davide Romano,Bradley Bell,Kirsty Fielding,Daniele Giofrè,Tom Zielund,Ipshita Chatterjee,Sneha Murthy Ghantasala,Manpreet Nanreh,John Scoville,Maciej Sakowicz,Wassim Seifeddine,Lukas Thede,Jonathan Richard Schwarz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出持续学习（Continual Learning）路线，使更多机构能够基于开源权重模型构建前沿性能的通用模型，实现"主权AI"（SovereignAI）；并以Thomson模型展示该方法在高风险专业任务上达到与近期前沿模型相当的性能，且几乎无灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型的开发通常被认为只属于少数资金充裕的机构，导致开发者与广泛用户群体之间存在信息、经济和权力不对称。虽然公共讨论呼吁"主权AI"，但缺乏在多样化资金条件下短期可行的具体方案。

Method: 基于现代开源权重模型，通过持续学习（Continual Learning）而非小规模微调、提示工程或冻结模型的工具增强，利用现代的mid-training和post-training技术栈；在每一阶段引入保持可塑性与稳定性的保护机制，对参数施加最小数量但高影响的干预。

Result: 以Thomson模型验证，在代理任务、安全性、法律、税务、多语言及大规模深度研究等任务上与近期前沿模型竞争；表现出独特的π形性能模式——在广泛能力上取得显著提升（包括未显式目标的能力），同时几乎完全消除窄域适配中常见的遗忘问题。计算和人员预算远低于通常认知。

Conclusion: 前沿性能可以通过持续学习的路线在广泛的机构中实现，使更多参与者能够拥有SovereignAI技术栈的主要部分（模型、工具基础设施、价值观与数据隐私），显著降低信息、经济和权力不对称。

Abstract: The development of frontier models is commonly perceived to be the exclusive remit of a small number of heavily funded players, creating an information, economic and power asymmetry between developers and the diverse user base of modern AI. Recent public discourse acknowledges this concern, calling for SovereignAI (an organisation's capability to independently build, deploy and govern AI use), but offers little concrete advice on how this can be achieved in the short term under a diversity of funding settings. We argue that frontier performance is achievable by a wide range of institutions through Continual Learning on readily available open-weight models. Unlike limited approaches such as small-scale fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or tool-augmentation of a frozen model, our approach exploits a modern mid- & post-training stack while introducing safeguards that preserve both plasticity and stability at each stage, making the minimal number of high-impact interventions on the parameters. This yields gains comparable to those typically seen across multiple successive model generations, at compute and personnel budgets substantially lower than commonly thought, making ownership of large parts of the SovereignAI stack (model, tool infrastructure, values & data privacy) viable for far more actors. We demonstrate this with Thomson, a general-purpose frontier model trained with an enhanced focus on high-stakes professional work. Thomson performs competitively with recent frontier models across agentic tasks, safety, legal, tax & multilingualism, and large-scale Deep Research. Evaluations show a distinctive $π$-shaped pattern: distinct improvements across a wide range of capabilities, including those not explicitly targeted, while almost completely eliminating the forgetting problem common to narrow domain adaptation.

</details>


### [413] [BPMN4CAI: A BPMN Extension for Modeling Dynamic Conversational AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27149)
*Björn-Lennart Eger,Daniel Rose,Barbara Dinter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种符合BPMN标准的扩展方法（BPMN4CAI），用于在业务流程中建模会话式AI系统（如聊天机器人和虚拟助手），并通过案例研究验证了其在自适应决策、上下文管理和透明交互方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会话式AI系统（如聊天机器人和虚拟助手）在数字业务流程中日益重要，但现有的BPMN标准在表示动态、上下文敏感交互时面临挑战，存在方法论和实践层面的研究空白。

Method: 采用设计科学研究（Design Science Research）方法论，系统性地扩展现有BPMN元素并纳入专门化组件，开发出标准兼容的BPMN扩展框架BPMN4CAI。

Result: 通过案例研究验证了BPMN4CAI框架的适用性和相关性，结果表明该扩展能够促进业务流程中会话式AI的自适应决策过程、稳健的上下文管理和透明交互。

Conclusion: BPMN4CAI扩展解决了BPMN在建模会话式AI交互方面的不足，为业务流程中集成会话式AI提供了标准化建模方案。

Abstract: Conversational AI systems, such as chatbots and virtual assistants, are becoming increasingly important to digital business processes. However, the established Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) standard faces challenges when representing dynamic, context-sensitive interactions. This paper addresses this methodological and practical research gap by developing a standard-compliant BPMN extension (BPMN4CAI). Using Design Science Research methodology, this paper develops an approach that systematically extends existing BPMN elements and incorporates specialized components. The applicability and relevance of the BPMN4CAI framework are demonstrated and evaluated through a case study. The results show that the BPMN4CAI extension facilitates adaptive decision-making processes, robust context management, and transparent interactions for Conversational AI within business processes.

</details>


### [414] [Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27167)
*Pranav Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究揭示了一个核心现象：LLM智能体在看到一个"专业"市场面板时，对根本无法预测的问题做出方向性判断的意愿从6.5%飙升至54.0%（跨12个前沿模型）。关键在于，即使面板上的所有数字都是伪造的，模型的承诺度依然与真实数据无异（36.8% vs 37.6%），表明触发信心行动的不是信息本身，而是信息"包装"的权威性。该失败可精确定位：模型并非能力不足（可回答问题时准确率接近完美），也非信念问题（声明概率几乎不变），更非判断缺失（模型90%能识别问题不可知但仍会行动），而是"行动/不行动"这一决策门控机制失效。该门控可通过540个合成案例对3B模型进行监督微调，将承诺度降至0.0%并迁移到三个未见领域，但在严格要求格式化的场景下会崩塌——格式移除推理空间时模型会自信地答错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解并定位LLM智能体在不确定条件下过度自信行动的根本机制——究竟是信息缺失、信念偏差还是判断能力不足所致，以及该缺陷是否可修复。

Method: 对12个前沿模型进行对照实验，逐步升级市场面板的"证据强度"（从裸问题到真实专业面板再到完全伪造面板）；通过匹配可答问题、测量声明概率、要求先验分类可测性等多角度归因实验定位失败环节；对3B模型进行540个合成案例（骰子、硬币、罐子、定时器等）的监督微调，并在三个未见领域测试迁移。

Result: 承诺率在12个模型上从6.5%升至54.0%；伪造面板与真实面板的承诺率在统计上不可区分（36.8% vs 37.6%）；声明概率几乎不随证据变化且比气候基线差；模型预判不可知性准确率达90%但仍有0.4%会行动；微调后承诺率降至0.0%并跨域迁移，但在无推理空间的严格格式下失效。

Conclusion: LLM的过度自信行动并非源于信息不足、信念错误或判断缺失，而是"行动/不行动"决策门控的分离性缺陷。该门控可被训练修复且具有情境脆弱性——部署时必须同时考虑这两个属性：模型需要足够的推理空间来激活门控保护，否则在强制格式下会自信地答错。

Abstract: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.

</details>


### [415] [What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27260)
*Xingshan Zeng,Zishan Xu,Boju Zhang,Yuzhou Wu,Lingzhi Wang,Jianghao Lin,Liangyou Li,Yasheng Wang,Lifeng Shang,Xin Jiang,Weinan Zhang,Yong Yu,Qun Liu,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于智能体数据生成领域的两层分析框架：将智能体数据表示为因子化对象$(E,q,τ,v)$，并通过Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity（ACE）视角将生成过程建模为约束分布设计，揭示了领域从执行锚定准确性、学习者相对复杂度到超表面多样性的演进趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体数据生成研究按领域组织且评估标准异质，导致常见生成机制被掩盖，候选构造与验证、选择过程被混淆。需要一个统一的框架来系统化理解该领域。

Method: 提出两层框架：(1) 将智能体数据表示为公共因子化对象$(E,q,τ,v)$，包括环境规范、任务信号、交互实现和可选验证器，并按主要锚点和依赖结构组织生成范式；(2) 通过ACE（准确性-复杂度-多样性）视角将生成建模为约束分布设计——准确性确定可行支撑集，复杂度相对声明学习者与执行配置分配学习质量，多样性控制覆盖与冗余。

Result: 文献分析揭示了三个趋势：(a) 准确性的执行锚定（execution-grounded），(b) 复杂度的学习者相对性（learner-relative），(c) 多样性超越表面变异或数据集规模的扩展。框架被用于分析先前工作如何验证生成经验、构建校准难度、扩展行为覆盖，并探讨了扩展性、数据来源、训练范式与自适应学习的广泛方向。

Conclusion: 智能体数据生成的核心挑战不是简单地生成更多数据，而是在智能体和环境演化过程中持续分配有效、信息丰富且非冗余的经验数据。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object $(E,q,τ,v)$, comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.

</details>


### [416] [Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27266)
*Yuan Chang,Xiaoqi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO)，一种轻量级单谱系提示优化方法，仅需教师模型和rollout反馈即可迭代改进提示。NPO在性能上与复杂方法GEPA相当或更优，且所需rollout更少；更强的教师模型可部分替代优化器端的搜索复杂度。在交互式游戏中NPO与GEPA表现大致相当，而GRPO在某些任务上表现更好。NPO优化后的提示可迁移至其他同类学生模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体跨多样任务的效率提升是加速递归自我改进(RSI)的核心，提示优化相比权重微调能获得相当的性能提升且计算成本更低。然而近期研究倾向于使用不必要复杂的提示优化器，作者希望通过极简方法验证简单线性搜索是否足以媲美复杂搜索流程。

Method: NPO采用轻量级单谱系（single-lineage）迭代策略：使用教师模型对当前提示生成修订版本，并通过rollout反馈评估效果，持续在单一提示谱系上进行迭代改进，而非维护多分支候选集合进行复杂搜索。

Result: NPO在更少的rollout次数下达到与GEPA相当或更优的性能；更强的教师模型能进一步增强NPO优势（表明教师推理能力可替代部分优化器搜索复杂性）；在交互式游戏中NPO与GEPA大致持平，GRPO在某些提示优化不友好的任务上更优；NPO优化出的提示可原样迁移到其他学生模型（尤其同系列模型）并获得相似性能提升。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明，简单线性提示优化足以匹敌显著更复杂精细的搜索流程，提示优化器的复杂度可能并非必要，应重新审视复杂化趋势的价值。

Abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.

</details>


### [417] [BrailleBench: Investigating Multi-Criteria Braille Comprehension in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27268)
*Jinghan Zhang,Fengran Mo,Zhiyu Chen,Xiaoyan Han,Kunpeng Liu,Chang-Tien Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍BrailleBench，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）盲文理解能力的基准测试。通过5,570个实例、五个数据集、两种盲文等级（Grade 1和2）以及多种配置，系统评估了六种代表性LLM，发现模型在盲文理解与表达方面存在显著的能力差距，尤其Grade 2盲文在输入端表现脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLMs为知识获取和计算辅助提供了途径，但其能力应平等惠及包括盲人和聋盲人在内的弱势群体。然而现有AI系统是否通过盲文（其指示符、缩写和数字表示方式对模型理解提出独特要求）提供同等功能仍是未知数，缺乏系统的评估基准来量化这一问题。

Method: 研究构建了BrailleBench基准：从五个数据集中对齐5,570个实例，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答，涉及英语及盲文Grade 1和Grade 2。设计多种配置以评估系统是否能理解盲文书写的输入、以盲文表达答案及完成端到端盲文交互。基准通过确定性、专家审查的流程构建，使用自创的Braille Toolkit，完全避免使用LLM生成的数据实例以保证质量和防止评估偏差。

Result: 评估了六种代表性LLM，结果显示印刷英语能力与盲文可及性之间存在持续差距。盲文理解与表达是不对称的：Grade 2盲文在输入端（理解）比Grade 1更脆弱，而使用完全盲文的请求会进一步降低性能。

Conclusion: 实验结果对未来盲文AI系统的开发提供了有价值的指导。BrailleBench的全部相关资源已公开，可供未来研究使用。

Abstract: Although Large language models (LLMs) mediate access to knowledge and computational assistance, their capabilities should benefit vulnerable groups in the same way. However, it is unclear whether existing AI systems are inclusive enough for blind and deafblind users to access the same functionality through Braille, whose indicators, contractions, and digital representations introduce distinct requirements for model comprehension. To this end, we introduce BrailleBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Braille comprehension from different Criteria. BrailleBench aligns 5,570 instances from five datasets, including mathematics, commonsense, and multi-hop question answering across English and Braille Grades 1 and 2. Different configurations are designed to understand whether the systems can comprehend Braille-authored content, express answers in Braille, and complete end-to-end Braille interaction. To ensure the quality and prevent evaluation bias, the benchmark is built through a deterministic, expert-reviewed pipeline via a self-created Braille Toolkit without using any data instances generated by LLMs. We evaluate six representative LLMs from various aspects. The results reveal a persistent gap between print-English capability and Braille accessibility. Braille understanding and expression are asymmetric, where Grade 2 is especially fragile on the input side compared to Grade 1, and fully Braille requests further reduce performance. The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.

</details>


### [418] [LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27296)
*Jackie Baek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）能否为定义良好的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效算法，覆盖库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化三类问题。通过两级LLM使用方式评估，发现最强模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有测试实例上匹配或超越现有最佳方法，即使在第2级（返回的算法在未见评估实例前就已固定）也是如此，且该能力在不到八个月的模型迭代中显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索前沿LLM是否可以作为运筹学算法设计的严肃经验基线，检验其在无需大量人工调优的情况下，能否生成与专门方法竞争的算法。

Method: 研究两类LLM使用级别：(1) 第1级——模型接收单个问题实例并返回该实例的解；(2) 第2级——模型仅接收问题类别描述和宽泛参数范围，返回一个将实例参数映射到解的算法。人类输入极少：仅提供一个未调优的提示词描述问题，模型可使用固定计算预算的Python沙箱工具。在库存控制、排队网络控制、品类优化三类问题上测试。

Result: 最强模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有评估实例上匹配或超越现有最佳方法，甚至在算法固定于评估实例之前的第2级设置下也成立。性能在相隔不足八个月发布的模型之间显著提升，表明该能力正快速发展。

Conclusion: 对于所研究的定义良好的运筹学问题，单次未调优的LLM查询即可生成与专门方法竞争的算法，前沿LLM可作为运筹学算法设计的严肃经验基线。

Abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.
  The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

</details>


### [419] [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27311)
*Jinghan Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Weiyuan Li,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HarnessLens是一个预算感知的自动化代理框架演进框架，通过联合探索任务空间和可配置组件、从执行轨迹中派生候选修改，并使用可归因证据门控在行为相关任务上选择性验证每个候选，从而在三个代理框架和四个基准上平均提升7.6-13.6%的留出性能，同时显著降低评估预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型代理的harness（指令、工具和运行时组件）对其行为有重要影响，但适配这些harness需要昂贵的验证成本。现有propose-and-verify方法通常在固定任务集上对所有候选进行评分，这不仅浪费rollout在与无关行为上，而且聚合分数可能掩盖特定性能回退。

Method: HarnessLens采用预算感知的自动化harness演进框架，具体包括：1) 联合探索任务空间与用户可配置组件；2) 从代理执行轨迹中提取并派生候选修改方案；3) 利用可归因证据门控（attributable-evidence gate），仅在与候选修改行为相关的任务上进行选择性验证，而非对所有固定任务集评分。

Result: 在三个代理harness和四个基准上，HarnessLens将平均留出性能提升了7.6-13.6%，同时相比竞争基线消耗了更少的评估预算。

Conclusion: 行为感知验证配合显式归因机制，能够在受限交互预算下实现更可靠和样本高效的harness演进。代码已开源。

Abstract: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable components, derives candidate modifications from execution trajectories, and selectively verifies each candidate on behavior-relevant tasks using an attributable-evidence gate. Across three agent harnesses and four benchmarks, HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6-13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget than competing baselines. These results demonstrate that behavior-aware verification with explicit attribution enables more reliable and sample-efficient harness evolution under constrained interaction budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens.

</details>


### [420] [Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27340)
*Allison Zhuang,Santiago Aranguri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示评估感知（eval-awareness）并非行为上统一的单一量，而是可以被区分为能力型、安全型、两者兼顾或两者皆非等不同表述框架（framing），这些框架对模型合规行为的影响截然不同。在Qwen3-32B和FORTREST数据集上，能力型框架相比安全型框架在合规率上高出+24到+46个百分点，并通过CoT-prefill干预验证了因果性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全评估管线中常将评估感知视为单一量进行抑制，但这种方法可能掩盖重要的行为差异。作者希望证明评估感知不是行为统一的，需要更细致地理解其内部结构，以改进安全评估策略。

Method: 在Qwen3-32B模型上使用FORTRESS数据集，将思维链中言语化的评估感知分类为能力型、安全型、两者兼顾或两者皆非四种表述框架，分析不同框架对合规行为的预测能力；并通过CoT-prefill干预实验（在评估感知为负的rollouts上注入不同prefill）检验其因果关系。

Result: 能力型框架比安全型框架对合规行为的预测差距达+24至+46个百分点；在10/11个prefill条件下，干预使合规行为沿预测方向移动，支持因果性；发现聚合抑制率变化可能掩盖安全相关子成分不变的情况，同一"X%抑制评估感知"可能对应截然不同的行为结果。

Conclusion: 评估感知不是一个行为上统一的量，安全评估中仅报告聚合抑制率是不够的，需要按组件信号分别追踪，否则可能产生误导性的安全结论。

Abstract: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very differently. On Qwen3-32B over the FORTRESS dataset, capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing across all tested steering conditions. A CoT-prefill intervention on eval-awareness-negative rollouts suggests the link is causal, with 10 of 11 prefills shifting compliance in the predicted direction. Then, eval-awareness is not behaviorally uniform: aggregate suppression rates can move while the safety-relevant component does not, and the same "X% suppression of eval-awareness" can correspond to qualitatively different behavioral outcomes.

</details>


### [421] [Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27364)
*Nicholas J. Hallman,Zachary T. Kowaleski,Anu Puvvada,Jaime J. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用一家大型企业8个月内的71万多个员工提示词及其大模型响应数据（涉及近4000名后台员工、15个职能部门），研究了生成式AI使用熟练度的差异性，发现资深员工使用更熟练、不同职能部门间差异显著（战略、数字创新和项目管理最熟练），且熟练度随时间无明显提升，正式AI培训也无持续改善效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在企业后台员工中的实际使用方式缺乏系统性度量；管理者需要了解哪些因素影响genAI使用的熟练度，以改进组织的AI应用成效；现有文献缺乏大规模、细粒度的实证数据来刻画员工与AI交互的质量差异。

Method: 基于一家大型企业约4000名后台员工在2025年8个月内产生的713,564条提示词及其大语言模型响应数据，覆盖15个职能部门，通过专有数据进行实证分析，从多个维度度量genAI使用的熟练度（sophistication），并比较不同资历层级、职能部门及时间维度上的差异。

Result: 三个主要发现：第一，资深员工展现出更熟练的genAI使用方式，与领域专业知识补足genAI能力的观点一致；第二，熟练度跨部门差异显著，战略、数字创新和项目管理三个聚焦公司级战略举措和组织变革的部门最高；第三，熟练度随时间无改善，正式AI培训后也无持续性提升，说明熟练使用难以改变。

Conclusion: 本研究为管理者和研究者提供了度量genAI使用熟练度的工具和洞见，可用于改进组织AI应用成效，并为未来研究奠定基础。

Abstract: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

</details>


### [422] [CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27391)
*Sil Hamilton,Albert Yu Sun,Oscar J. Romero,Carl-Leander Henneking,David Mimno,Bishan Yang,Igor Labutov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CorporateBench（CB），一个经过人工验证、覆盖超过23万份文档的企业级多任务问答基准测试，用于评估LLM在企业规模语料上的信息提取和知识库查询能力。对五个LLM的评估显示，当输入规模接近真实企业场景时，模型性能显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM对企业级文档问答能力的评估存在明显缺口：企业不愿共享内部通信数据，而合成数据集往往过于简单，无法反映真实企业通信网络的复杂性和规模。

Method: 通过四个合成企业（12至10,000名员工）构建多任务Q&A基准，每个语料从随时间演化的知识库中采样，确保跨文档逻辑一致性。评估涵盖信息提取和知识库查询两个维度，并对五个LLM进行测试。

Result: 五个LLM在CorporateBench上的性能随输入规模接近现实尺度而逐渐恶化，揭示了当前模型在大规模语料推理方面的不足。

Conclusion: CorporateBench填补了企业通信推理基准测试的空白，为LLM开发者提供了贴近现实规模的评估指标。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

</details>


### [423] [Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27421)
*Kevin Zhu,Ryan Zhang,Baraa Abed,Tilendra Choudhary,Malvern Madondo,Mehak Arora,Yixuan Yang,Alasdair Gent,Aditya Nagori,Omer T. Inan,Krista L. Haines,Patrick Georgoff,Suresh M. Agarwal,Vijay Krishnamoorthy,Tetsu Ohnuma,Mihai V. Podgoreanu,Michael R. Pinsky,Gilles Clermont,Craig M. Coopersmith,Craig S. Jabaley,Rishikesan Kamaleswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种基于72小时治疗窗口内43项常规记录变量、以死亡率为治疗级别排序信号的新脓毒症指数（替代传统固定权重评分），在29,116和7,691名Sepsis-3患者的两队列回顾性研究中，该指数在各SOFA-2分层内均能区分存活与死亡患者，与临床指标（乳酸盐等）相关，并表现出跨机构的可转移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脓毒症严重程度评分（如SOFA）基于数十年前的固定变量和权重，离散化粗糙且校准人群不再反映当代重症监护实践；且没有从患者轨迹直接学习的替代方案被常规使用。

Method: 开发了一个使用43项常规记录变量、72小时治疗窗口的脓毒症指数。与以往研究不同，该方法将死亡率作为治疗级别的排序信号而非每状态目标，允许信用在时间步上非均匀重新分配。使用永久20%测试留出集进行评估，采用临床小插图（vignettes）和Spearman相关分析，通过整患者引导重采样获取不确定性区间。

Result: 在0-10量表中，非幸存者得分比幸存者高1.19-1.64分（所有基线SOFA-2分层内），在乳酸盐、MAP和肌酐分层内结果类似。患者内指数变化与乳酸盐变化相关（rho=0.39，n=1,854），MAP和肌酐的相关较弱。跨机构一致性为同一站点相关的70-77%，外部患者内相关性为0.54和0.59（上限为0.92和0.90）。指数与已建立的指标相关，而零对照接近零。

Conclusion: 该指数提供了每小时级的预后信息，能有效区隔患者结局并符合临床预期，表明其作为补充临床判断的决策支持工具有一定的潜力。

Abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively.
  We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero.
  Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

</details>


### [424] [Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27429)
*Nguyen Xuan-Vu,Octavian Susanu,Daniel Armstrong,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAELLE是一个基于离散流匹配（flow matching）在电子占据向量空间上建模化学反应的新型框架，将反应视为电子空间中的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），通过最优传输构造中间编辑轨迹，在USPTO-480K基准上取得竞争性性能，并在分布外场景下保持鲁棒性，同时能够恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹并预测副产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习化学反应预测方法要么通过从头生成产物分子，要么通过启发式图编辑直接操作分子拓扑，但化学反应的本质是电子空间的变换。这两种方法都没有从电子层面刻画反应机理，缺乏可解释性和对分布外数据的泛化能力。

Method: MAELLE将反应物到产物的映射建模为定义在键合位点、非键合位点和氢位点上的图结构整数电子占据空间中的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）。通过将离散流匹配混合路径推广到离散电子重排场景，并利用最优传输（Optimal Transport）构造中间编辑轨迹，生成一系列机理可解释的编辑步骤，且无需基元步标注。

Result: MAELLE在USPTO-480K基准上达到与领先反应预测模型相当的性能。在结构复杂度和反应类型两个分布外设定下，MAELLE保持强性能而现有方法性能下降。此外，MAELLE能够不依赖显式标注自然恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹，并预测反应的副产物。

Conclusion: 在电子占据空间而非分子拓扑上进行反应建模是可行且有效的，不仅能提升预测精度和分布外鲁棒性，还能提供机理层面的可解释性，为化学反应预测开辟了新的建模视角。

Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.
  We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.
  Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites.
  To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations.
  MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models.
  Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade.
  Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

</details>


### [425] [WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27454)
*Liyan Tang,Cyrus Rashtchian,Chun-Sung Ferng,Andrew Tomkins,Da-Cheng Juan,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了WikiSkill框架，将智能体技能与持久化知识库（wiki）协同演化，将原始执行经验、累积知识和可执行技能分离，持续将经验整合到wiki中供后续技能更新使用，在多个基准和模型上优于最先进的技能演化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动发现技能的方法虽然能让智能体通过交互逐步适应，但指导技能发展的洞察通常散落在优化历史中，缺乏跨迭代的系统性复用，限制了技能演化的效率与效果。

Method: WikiSkill框架采用协同演化机制，将原始执行经验、累积知识和可执行技能三个层次分离；通过持续将执行经验整合（consolidation）到持久化的wiki知识库中，使后续技能更新能够基于此前累积的知识进行构建，形成经验→知识→技能的闭环演化。

Result: 在多种基准和模型上，WikiSkill一致优于最先进的技能演化方法，并超越大多数无技能基线；技能演化与模型规模互补，大模型更受益于演化技能，小模型带技能可超越更大的无技能模型；演化技能可跨模型及模型家族迁移，且其他模型演化的技能可优于自演化技能；消融实验证实wiki中持久知识累积对技能演化至关重要。

Conclusion: 系统性地积累和精炼智能体经验对于开发可复用、可迁移的技能具有显著益处，WikiSkill通过持久化知识库实现了技能与知识的协同演化，验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.GN'></div>

# q-bio.GN [[Back]](#toc)

### [426] [Learning Interpretable Tumor Microenvironment Representations by Fitting Pan-Cancer Cell State-Niche Correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26208)
*Xiao Xiao,Jiashu He,Shiyang Zhang,Meiyi Mao*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 本文提出GITIII-scale，一个层次化、可解释的泛癌空间转录组基础模型，用于肿瘤微环境表示学习，能够从全转录组覆盖的单细胞数据中推断细胞状态-微环境关联及其潜在的配体-受体信号通路，在未见过的癌症类型中优于现有模型，并通过乳腺癌案例研究展示了可解释性和药物靶点发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤微环境中细胞状态受邻近细胞间相互作用（CCIs）影响，识别与病理过程相关的失调CCIs对药物发现至关重要。然而，成像型空间转录组数据和单细胞RNA测序数据各有局限——前者有空间信息但缺乏全转录组覆盖，后者有全转录组覆盖但缺乏空间信息——现有空间转录组基础模型无法有效从全转录组覆盖的空间分辨单细胞数据中学习，也无法显式推断驱动细胞状态-微环境关联的CCI机制，且缺乏可解释性以支持直接的生物学解释。

Method: GITIII-scale采用三级层次架构：(1) 使用Transformer对特定空间距离内的细胞对进行交互建模；(2) 采用无前馈网络的可解释单层图Transformer，将接收细胞中每个基因受到邻近发送细胞的影响进行分解；(3) 使用图Transformer生成细胞邻域嵌入。模型在自建的配对的scRNA-seq和成像型空间转录组泛癌数据库上进行训练。

Result: GITIII-scale生成的TME嵌入在恢复与微环境相关的细胞状态变化方面，在训练中未见的癌症类型中优于现有空间转录组基础模型。在未见过的乳腺癌数据集案例研究中，模型成功识别了与内皮过度生长和肿瘤发生相关的潜在可药物靶向的配体-受体信号通路，验证了其可解释性。

Conclusion: GITIII-scale作为一种可解释的泛癌空间转录组基础模型，能够有效弥合成像型空间转录组与scRNA-seq之间的模态鸿沟，不仅提升了跨癌种的TME表示学习性能，还通过可解释的架构设计实现了对CCI机制的直接生物学解释，为识别药物靶点提供了新工具。

Abstract: In the tumor microenvironment, cell's state is influenced by cell-cell interactions (CCIs) with neighboring cells in its niches. Identifying dysregulated CCIs that are associated with pathogenic process pinpoints targets for drug discovery. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics and single-cell RNA sequencing provide, respectively, single-cell spatial information and transcriptome-wide measurements needed to study CCIs, but neither modality provides both. Existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models also cannot effectively learn from spatially resolved single-cell data with full-transcriptome coverage, explicitly infer the CCI mechanisms driving cell state-niche associations, or interpretable enough to support direct biological interpretations. Here, we present GITIII-scale, a hierarchical, interpretable pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics foundation model for TME representation learning that investigates cell state-niche associations and their underlying ligand-receptor (LR) signaling pathways. GITIII-scale uses transformers to model interactions between pairs of cells at defined spatial distances, an interpretable single-layer graph transformer without a feed-forward network to decompose how each gene in a receiver cell is influenced by each neighboring sender cell, and a graph transformer to generate cellular-neighborhood embeddings. Trained on our assembled pan-cancer database of specimen-matched scRNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets, GITIII-scale generated TME embeddings that recovered niche-associated state changes more accurately than existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models in cancer types unseen during training. A case study of an unseen breast cancer dataset further demonstrated the model's interpretability by identifying potentially drug-targetable LR pathways associated with endothelial overgrowth and tumorigenesis.

</details>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [427] [ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26204)
*Joy Chen,Alejandro Castillejo Munoz,Pierluca D'Oro,Yuxuan Sun,Chloe Evans,Joseph Tighe*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ADeptS-Bench是一个双流可信度基准，用于评估计算机使用代理（CUA）在视觉界面中的安全性（对抗恶意任务）和歧义消解（是否主动澄清意图）能力。评估七个模型发现没有任何模型能同时满足任务成功率高于80%且攻击成功率低于30%的阈值，揭示了CUA在安全性方面的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管CUA越来越多地部署于移动和桌面应用以代理用户操作，但尚无基准能够全面评估这些代理在视觉界面中安全交互并处理模糊指令的能力。现有安全评测主要针对文本或纯功能，缺乏对视觉界面嵌入威胁和模糊意图处理的系统性评估。

Method: 作者基于ADEPTS能力框架和普通人群用户研究构建了ADeptS-Bench双流基准：(1) Safety流——提供成对的良性/恶意任务，威胁嵌入在视觉界面中；(2) Disambiguation流——评估代理在意图模糊时是否会主动寻求澄清。对七个模型进行系统评估，并通过消融实验分析安全性架构。

Result: 七个模型的评估显示：无模型能同时超过80%任务成功率且低于30%攻击成功率；所有模型都会毫不犹豫地点击$25K订单的"Checkout"按钮；没有模型能检测出被误标为"Optimize"的"factory reset"按钮。消融实验揭示了三种不同的安全架构：工具依赖型（移除拒绝工具后ASR上升21-23pp）、部分工具依赖型（上升10-11pp）、无安全机制型（无变化）。在歧义消解方面，所有模型都高估了后果严重性，反映出与安全领域中过度拒绝偏差相似的现象。

Conclusion: 当前CUA在视觉界面安全性方面存在系统性缺陷：既无法抵御嵌入视觉的恶意攻击任务，也缺乏主动澄清模糊意图的能力。基准的发布将为CUA安全性研究提供标准化评估工具，并为安全架构设计提供分类依据。

Abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed to navigate mobile and desktop applications on behalf of users, yet no benchmark comprehensively evaluates whether they can safely interact with visual interfaces while handling ambiguous instructions. We introduce ADeptS-Bench, a dual-stream trustworthiness benchmark, grounded in the ADEPTS capability framework and general population user studies. The Safety stream provides paired benign/malicious tasks with threats embedded in the visual interface. The Disambiguation stream evaluates whether agents seek clarification when intent is ambiguous. Evaluating seven models reveals that no model consistently exceeds 80% task success while staying below 30% attack success; every model clicks "Checkout" on a $25K order without hesitation, and none detects that a "factory reset" button is mislabeled as "Optimize." An ablation reveals three distinct safety architectures: tool-dependent (ASR +21-23pp without refusal tool), partially tool-dependent (+10-11pp), and no mechanism (unchanged). In disambiguation, all models overestimate consequence severity, mirroring the over-refusal bias observed in safety. We release all data, evaluation code, and analysis tools upon publication.

</details>


### [428] [How Do LLM Agents Actually Get the Flag? Trace-Level Provenance for Agentic Offensive Security Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26237)
*Kimberly Milner,Minghao Shao,Nanda Rani,Haoran Xi,Venkata Sai Charan Putrevu,Meet Udeshi,Sandeep K. Shukla,Prashanth Krishnamurthy,Farshad Khorrami,Muhammad Shafique,Ramesh Karri*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出CTF-ABACUS，一个基于轨迹的CTF智能体审计框架，通过重构agent求解过程为证据支持的solve profile，区分真实漏洞利用与捷径（如直接暴露flag、记忆召回、外部查询等）。在1,435次CTF尝试、240个挑战、6个模型的评估中，发现仅62-87%的恢复flag得到轨迹验证，揭示现有CTF评估高估了agent的攻防能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CTF基准评估仅依赖二元判定或聚合分数，忽略了agent到达flag的轨迹，导致实际漏洞利用与flag直接暴露、记忆召回、外部查询、猜测等捷径行为被混为一谈，可能高估agent的网络安全能力。需要一种能够验证agent是否真正通过漏洞利用获得flag的审计方法。

Method: CTF-ABACUS框架将agent动作分解为渗透测试阶段和分类技术，识别漏洞利用发生位置、flag首次出现位置，并判断恢复的flag是否受演示行为支持。通过聚合所有agent的solve profiles生成challenge signatures，揭示成功是通过预期利用路径还是捷径路径实现的。

Result: 应用CTF-ABACUS于1,435次CTF尝试（6个前沿和开源模型、240个挑战），在两种评判视角下生成2,870个solve profiles。轨迹验证的漏洞利用仅占恢复flags的62-87%，表明相当比例的flag恢复是通过捷径实现的，且捷径恢复的轨迹深度显著较浅。

Conclusion: CTF评估应从"统计恢复flag数量"转向"验证展示的漏洞利用行为"，为设计能更好隔离agent攻防能力的基准提供基础。

Abstract: Capture-the-Flag (CTF) benchmarks are widely used to assess the offensive security capabilities of autonomous language-model agents. Evaluations rely on shallow binary judgments or aggregate scores, overlooking the agent's trajectory to the flag. Consequently actual exploitation is conflated with direct flag exposure, memorized recall, external lookup, guessing, and unsupported claims, potentially overstating the agent's cybersecurity capability. We introduce CTF-ABACUS, a trace-based agent auditing framework that reconstructs each run as an evidence-grounded solve profile. By decomposing agent actions into penetration-testing phases and categorical techniques, it identifies where exploitation occurs, where the flag first appears, and whether the recovered flag is supported by demonstrated behavior. Aggregating solve profiles across agents yields challenge signatures that reveal whether success was achieved via the intended exploit or via shortcut pathways. We apply CTF-ABACUS to 1,435 CTF attempts by six frontier and open-source models on 240 challenges, yielding 2,870 solve profiles under two judge lenses. Trace-verified exploits account for only 62-87% of recovered flags across benchmarks, while shortcut recoveries follow substantially shallower trajectories. These findings shift CTF evaluation from counting recovered flags to verifying demonstrated exploitation and provide a basis for designing benchmarks that better isolate the offensive capabilities.

</details>


### [429] [FRESCO: Complete and Scalable Temporal Safety for CHERI Application Processors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26353)
*Merve Gülmez,Nils Jordan,Jialun Zhang,Hossam ElAtali,Gang Tan,N. Asokan,Thomas Nyman*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: FRESCO是一个基于CHERI的硬件/软件协同设计，通过给栈指针赋予每次调用的provenance标识符来"着色"栈帧，使所有派生的能力（capability）在函数退出时被硬件立即失效，从而系统性解决use-after-return问题，同时与堆的时间安全机制共存，实现完整的、可扩展的时间安全保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CHERI提供硬件强制的空间内存安全，但现有扩展仅覆盖堆的时间安全，栈上的use-after-return问题仍未解决。已有的编译器分析只能可靠捕获作为函数返回值逃逸的引用，而动态sanitizer开销过大无法用于生产部署。

Method: FRESCO基于"栈能力不得超越创建它的帧的生命周期"这一原则，通过给栈指针添加每次调用的provenance标识符来"着色"；所有从中派生的能力继承该生命周期，函数退出时硬件立即使其失效。为应对栈帧退役远频繁于堆分配带来的颜色压力，FRESCO采用两个关键机制：1) Color Saver——静态能力感知逃逸分析（核心算法在Rocq中机械验证），将着色限制在需要的函数上；2) capability-color分段——将内存划分为不相交的分段，每段有独立的颜色命名空间，使栈和堆的时间安全共存。

Result: FRESCO在CHERI-RISC-V QEMU全系统模拟器和乱序CHERI-Toooba FPGA软核上实现，软件支持包括CHERI-enabled Clang/LLVM编译器和CheriBSD OS。系统性地防止了use-after-return、use-after-free和double-free（NIST Juliet测试套件和CVE），SPEC CPU的几何平均开销仅4%，SQLite和PostgreSQL为10-14%。

Conclusion: FRESCO是首个为CHERI应用处理器提供完整且可扩展的时间内存安全的硬件/软件协同设计，成功将栈时间安全能力扩展到不存在逃逸的函数中，同时保持可接受的开销。

Abstract: CHERI provides hardware-enforced spatial memory safety. While prior work extends it with heap temporal safety, stack use-after-return remains unaddressed. Existing defenses fall short: compiler analysis reliably catches only references that escape as function return values, while dynamic sanitizers impose overheads that preclude production deployment.
  We present FRESCO, built on the principle that a stack capability must not outlive the frame that created it. FRESCO "colors" the stack pointer with per-invocation provenance identifiers; every capability derived from it inherits that lifetime and is hardware-invalidated the moment the function exits, regardless of how or where it escaped.
  Because stack frames retire orders of magnitude more frequently than heap allocations, FRESCO manages the resulting color pressure through: 1) Color Saver, a static capability-aware escape analysis that confines coloring to functions needing it, and whose core algorithm we mechanically verify in Rocq, and 2) capability-color segmentation, which partitions memory into disjoint segments, each with an independent color namespace. Color segmentation lets stack and heap temporal safety coexist on one system, making FRESCO the first hardware/software co-design to provide complete and scalable temporal safety for CHERI application processors.
  We realize FRESCO on the CHERI-RISC-V QEMU full-system emulator and the out-of-order CHERI-Toooba FPGA softcore, with software support in the CHERI-enabled Clang/LLVM compiler and CheriBSD OS. FRESCO systematically prevents use-after-return, use-after-free, and double-free across the NIST Juliet Test Suite and CVEs, with only a small run-time overhead in SPEC CPU (4% g.m.), SQLite, and PostgreSQL (10-14%).

</details>


### [430] [PRISM: Lightweight Enclave Isolation with Prismatic Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26367)
*Merve Gülmez,Adam Caulfield,Hakan Englund,N. Asokan,Thomas Nyman*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: PRISM是一种基于CHERI棱柱能力（prismatic capabilities）的TEE架构，通过将enclave标识绑定到物理内存访问控制，实现用户空间安全飞地的O(1)所有权建立、高效域切换和远程证明，开销仅≤15%，优于Intel SGX。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CHERI虽能提供对象级空间内存安全，但基于CHERI原语构建TEE面临四大挑战：能力撤销成本高、依赖宿主操作系统进行溯源追踪和物理内存保护、域切换开销大、缺乏远程证明支持。

Method: PRISM引入棱柱能力（prismatic capabilities），将飞地标识（hue）绑定到物理内存访问控制中；实现无需内存扫描的O(1)所有权建立；支持原子化激活/停用棱柱能力的快速域切换；并实现飞地远程证明机制。

Result: 用户空间飞地在PRISM中执行仅产生中等开销（≤15%），比相同工作负载在Intel SGX下的性能有显著提升。

Conclusion: PRISM通过棱柱能力架构有效解决了CHERI-based TEE的四大挑战，在保持内存安全的同时实现了低开销、高效的远程证明，为TEE设计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Trusted execution environments (TEEs) protect sensitive code and data from external interference, but lack inherent memory safety. CHERI can enforce spatial memory safety at the object level. Attempts to establish a TEE using CHERI primitives suffer from (1) expensive capability revocation operations, (2) need to rely on the host operating system (OS) to support provenance tracking and physical memory protection, (3) expensive domain transitions, and (4) lack of support for remote attestation.
  We introduce prismatic capabilities and present PRISM, a TEE architecture for CHERI leveraging prismatic capabilities to create userspace enclaves while addressing these challenges. PRISM binds enclave 'hues' (identifiers) in prismatic capabilities to physical memory access controls, enables O(1) ownership establishment without memory sweeps, and supports efficient domain transitions that atomically activate and deactivate prismatic capabilities. Additionally, PRISM enables remote attestation of its enclaves. We demonstrate that execution of userspace enclaves in PRISM incurs only moderate overhead (<= 15%), a significant improvement over the same workloads under Intel SGX

</details>


### [431] [Improving the Robustness of the XRP Ledger Network via Edge Augmentation Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26380)
*Afonso Vilalonga,Orkun İrsoy,João S. Resende,Henrique Domingos,Osman Yağan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文评估了多种提升XRP Ledger网络拓扑鲁棒性的策略，提出基于边添加（augmentation）的策略，并与先前工作中基于边重连（rewiring）的策略进行了对比。实验表明，增边策略显著提升网络鲁棒性，少量增边（每节点3条）即可达到甚至超越重连策略的效果，且随机K-out增边策略在保持原有拓扑相似性方面优于重连策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XRP Ledger的共识协议要求参与者独特节点列表（UNL）之间有显著重叠，且节点内达成阈值较高（如80%）。攻击者可通过针对网络连接骨干节点实施攻击，将被信任的通信参与者数量降至阈值以下，从而破坏共识过程。因此需要评估和改进现有网络拓扑的鲁棒性。

Method: 作者首先形式化定义了quorum鲁棒性和网络鲁棒性指标。然后提出了一种增边/增强策略，基于不同结构构造方式添加新边；同时与先前工作中的重连/换边策略（保持总边数不变但重新排列）进行对比。每种策略考虑两种情形：所有节点参与构造，以及仅部分节点参与。

Result: 增边策略相较于默认XRP Ledger拓扑带来了显著的鲁棒性提升；部分增边策略在仅少量增边（每节点3条边）的情况下即可达到或超过重连策略的鲁棒性指标。此外，随机K-out增边策略在Jaccard相似度指标上与原始网络的拓扑相似性高于重连策略。

Conclusion: 增边策略是提升XRP Ledger网络鲁棒性的有效手段，较之重连策略更具优势，尤其是在增边数量较少时就能达到高性能，且能更好地保持与原始网络的拓扑相似性，是一种更实用、侵入性更低的拓扑加固方案。

Abstract: The XRP Ledger allows its network participants to select a set of trusted peers within the network (i.e., the Unique Node List (UNL)) and communicate with them to reach consensus on which transactions should be included in the next ledger state. However, its consensus protocol requires significant overlap among participants' UNLs, along with a high agreement threshold among the nodes within each UNL (e.g., 80\%). Consequently, an attacker could disrupt the consensus process in such a network by targeting the nodes that form the network's connectivity backbone and reducing the number of trusted participants that can communicate with one another below the required threshold. In this paper, we evaluate strategies to improve the robustness of the XRP Ledger's existing topology, as measured by our formal definitions of quorum and network robustness, and compare them to a second strategy from prior work. The strategy we present is an addition/augmentation approach, in which new edges are added based on different constructions. The second strategy is a rewiring or edge-replacement approach, in which the overall number of edges is preserved but they are rearranged. For each strategy, we consider two different cases: one in which all nodes participate in the edge construction or rewiring process, and another in which only a subset of nodes participates. Our findings demonstrate substantial improvements in robustness when augmentation strategies are used over the default XRP Ledger topology and show that some augmentation strategies achieve robustness metrics equal to or exceeding the rewiring strategy, even when the number of edges added is small (e.g., three edges per node). Additionally, we show that the random K-out-based augmentation strategy maintains higher topological similarity to the original network than rewiring, as measured by Jaccard similarity.

</details>


### [432] [SILK: Closing the Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Gap in RoT-Protected AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26402)
*Ruichen Qi,Xinting Jiang,Ema Dimitrova,Junyi Luo,Quan Cheng,Mehdi Saligane*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: SILK是一种流式内联轻量密钥完整性机制，在最终预计算边界验证权重流，通过复用量化权重的LSB作为完整性比特并在权重字节间建立链式依赖，在不引入独立认证标签的情况下抵御DNN模型加载后到计算前的TOCTOU完整性攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 根信任（RoT）认证只在加载时验证DNN模型，但权重在从DRAM经DMA、互连和预取路径到达计算引擎的过程中可能被篡改，形成TOCTOU完整性缺口——认证后的模型镜像不变但实际消费的权重已被修改。

Method: SILK将量化权重的LSB重新用作密钥化的完整性比特，并在权重字节之间建立依赖链，使得局部修改会扰动多个完整性检查。流式检查器无需独立的认证标签即可重算这些检查，并通过提交门控（commit gating）阻止未经校验的权重进入计算。通过稀疏检查可配置安全-质量权衡。

Result: 在安全PRF假设下，伪造概率随受影响检查数量指数下降，实测漏检率与理论界紧密吻合。SILK在功能攻击套件中检测到所有流修改实例。INT8下质量损失在CNN上不超过0.76pp，在8个LLM上不超过0.17困惑度。在Xilinx ZCU102上，参考流水线实现以756MB/s吞吐运行，面积仅为Caliptra 2.x RoT的1.00%；保守配置（2^-128逐次伪造界）下仍保持678MB/s，面积成本为RoT的6.15%。

Conclusion: SILK在预计算边界建立了轻量级流式完整性验证，以极低面积开销和可忽略的质量损失有效弥合了DNN模型DToCTOU完整性缺口，为硬件侧DNN推理提供了实用的安全-效率平衡方案。

Abstract: Root-of-trust (RoT) authentication verifies a DNN model at load time, but weights may subsequently traverse DRAM, DMA, interconnect, and prefetch paths before reaching the compute engine. Post-verification tampering along this path can therefore alter the weights actually consumed while leaving the authenticated model image unchanged, creating a time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) integrity gap.
  We present SILK (Streaming Inline Lightweight Keying), an in-place integrity mechanism that verifies the weight stream at the final pre-compute boundary. SILK repurposes quantized-weight LSBs as secret-keyed integrity bits and chains dependencies across weight bytes, so a local modification perturbs multiple integrity checks. A lightweight streaming checker recomputes these checks without separate authentication tags and uses commit gating to prevent unverified weights from reaching computation. Under a secure pseudorandom function (PRF), the forgery probability decreases exponentially with the number of affected checks, and measured miss rates closely track the analytical bound. SILK detects every stream-modifying instance in our functional attack suite. For INT8, it limits quality loss to at most 0.76 pp across evaluated CNNs and 0.17 perplexity across eight LLMs, while INT4 and MXFP4 provide a configurable security-quality tradeoff through check sparsity. On a Xilinx ZCU102, the synthesized reference pipelined implementation sustains 756 MB/s at only 1.00% of the equivalent area cost of a Caliptra 2.x RoT, while a configuration with a conservative per-attempt forgery bound of 2^-128 still sustains 678 MB/s at 6.15% of the RoT cost.

</details>


### [433] [IoMT-SecAlarmBench: A Counterfactual Benchmark for Integrity Attacks in IoMT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26416)
*Emmanuel C. Ugwuabonyi,Dmitri Perkins*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了IoMT-SecAlarmBench，一个半合成的物联网医疗（IoMT）基准测试，通过向真实ECG+PPG信号中注入受控的完整性攻击来评估异常检测方法，并发现现有检测器在最具挑战性的场景（重放攻击和低幅度瞬态尖峰）中表现接近随机水平，且攻击检测与传感器故障区分之间存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物联网医疗（IoMT）将临床生理数据与网络系统信息结合，但无法确定异常读数反映的是真实的生理事件、设备故障还是网络攻击。回答这一问题的关键在于反事实真值（即没有攻击时本应观察到的干净信号），而现有数据集均无法提供此信息。因此需要构建一个带有反事实真值的基准测试。

Method: 构建IoMT-SecAlarmBench半合成基准：向真实的ECG+PPG耦合信号中注入受控的完整性攻击，采用结构化实验设计，包含四种攻击形态、四个严重级别、两种生理合理性条件以及重放攻击。每个注入窗口保留其原因、攻击子类型和无攻击时的干净信号。评估了来自五个方法族的六个检测器，使用阈值无关的指标和匹配的误报预算。

Result: 没有方法能在最困难的情况下（重放攻击和低幅度瞬态尖峰）持续检测到攻击，各检测器在这些情况下的表现接近随机水平。检测攻击与区分传感器故障之间存在权衡：在困难案例上表现最佳的检测器对故障/伪影窗口的标记率是其正常数据误报率的5.3倍。三分类对真实生理事件的分类性能不佳。泄漏审计发现，先前报道的IoMT入侵检测性能部分由识别信息驱动。

Conclusion: 现有多模态IoMT异常检测方法在对抗复杂完整性攻击方面存在明显不足，尤其是重放攻击和低幅度攻击难以检测；攻击检测与故障区分之间存在固有矛盾；需警惕现有基准中信息泄漏导致性能虚高的现象。IoMT-SecAlarmBench为未来研究提供了带有反事实真值的标准化评估平台。

Abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) combines clinical physiological data with cyber-system information, creating challenges in determining whether an abnormal reading reflects a genuine physiological event, a device fault, or a cyber-attack within the expected physiological range. Answering this requires counterfactual ground truth, which no existing dataset provides. We present IoMT-SecAlarmBench, a semi-synthetic benchmark that injects controlled integrity attacks into genuine coupled ECG+PPG recordings using a structured experimental design combining four attack morphologies, four severity levels, two physiological plausibility conditions, and replay attacks. Each injected window retains its cause, attack subtype, and the clean signal that would have been observed without the attack. We evaluate six detectors from five method families using threshold-independent measures and a matched false-alarm budget. Results show no method consistently detects the most difficult cases: replay attacks and low-amplitude transient spikes remain close to chance-level performance across detectors. Results also reveal a trade-off between detecting attacks and distinguishing them from sensor faults: the best-performing detector on hard cases flags fault/artifact windows at 5.3 times its false-alarm rate on normal data. Three-way classification performs poorly for genuine physiological events, and a leakage audit of a dual-modality network dataset indicates previously reported IoMT intrusion-detection performance is partly driven by identifying information. Benchmark, generation code, preprocessing, evaluation tools, and datasheet are released.

</details>


### [434] [Unsaid, Unsafe? Implicit Security Obligations in LLM-Based RTL Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26588)
*Guang Yang,Xing Hu,Xiang Chen,Xin Xia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SECRTL-GEN基准，用于评估LLM生成RTL代码的安全性（392个任务、5个CWE族、4种HDL），发现前沿LLM功能正确性高但安全性极低（14-35%），并据此提出RTL-Obliger神经符号框架，通过推断隐含安全义务提升安全与功能双通过率至61.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成RTL代码的功能正确性提升迅速，但安全性研究主要集中于软件领域。与软件不同，有缺陷的RTL在流片为硅片后无法修补，安全漏洞代价极其高昂。现有研究缺乏针对LLM生成RTL代码的安全评估基准，且功能规格说明中常省略安全义务，导致模型难以感知安全要求。

Method: 首先构建SECRTL-GEN基准，包含5个CWE族、4种HDL的392个任务，每个任务配有黑盒功能和安全测试台，且功能规格有意忽略安全义务。其次进行五项前沿LLM的实证研究，比较不同提示策略（vanilla、CWE知识、自思考、安全导向提示）的安全表现。最后提出RTL-Obliger神经符号框架：LLM从规格提取功能语义图，符号引擎将其与CWE模式本体匹配以识别缓解证据缺口和信号级义务，LLM再在功能保持的两阶段生成中据义务修正RTL。

Result: 实证发现：前沿LLM在vanilla提示下功能通过率约73-79%但安全通过率仅14-35%，且功能更强的模型并不更安全；加入CWE知识可提升安全性，但自思考帮助有限，安全导向提示会降低功能通过率。RTL-Obliger在5个模型和4种语言中将平均全通过率从基线（SecV/RESCUE）的49.6-51.4%提升至61.6%，安全性和功能性均优于现有安全生成基线。

Conclusion: LLM生成RTL的安全瓶颈在于规格中缺失的弱点感知（weakness awareness），而非模型缺乏编写防御性RTL的能力。RTL-Obliger通过神经符号方式推断隐含安全义务，有效弥合了这一缺口，为安全RTL生成提供了新的范式。但整体通过率仍不理想，表明该方向仍需进一步探索。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate register-transfer-level (RTL) code with rapidly improving functional correctness. Security of LLM-generated code, however, has been studied mainly for software, where flaws can still be patched after deployment. Insecure RTL offers no such remedy once taped out into silicon. We construct SECRTL-GEN, a multi-language resource-access security benchmark grounded in real SoC IP: 392 tasks over five CWE families and four HDLs (Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, and Python), each with black-box functional and security testbenches. Functional specifications intentionally omit security obligations, matching how obligations are often kept out of functional docs in practice. An empirical study of five frontier LLMs shows a sharp gap: under vanilla prompts they pass functional tests in about 73-79% of cases but security tests in only 14-35%, and stronger functional models are not safer. Adding CWE knowledge raises security, while unaided self-thinking helps less and both security-oriented prompts cut functional pass rates, showing that the bottleneck is missing weakness awareness in the specification, not an inability to write defensive RTL. We present RTL-Obliger, a neuro-symbolic framework that infers these implicit obligations.
