### [462] [Exploring the Role of LLMs in HPC Programming: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26110)
*Strahinja Ljaljevic,Josep Jorba,Sergio Iserte*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了大语言模型（LLMs）在高性能计算（HPC）领域的应用，覆盖代码生成、并行化与优化、框架与架构、评估与基准测试五个方面，指出通用LLM在串行和OpenMP类任务上表现尚可，但在MPI等分布式范式上存在不足，领域专用模型虽精度更高但范围狭窄。结论认为LLM短期内不会取代HPC专家，但将成为软件开发流程中的有力协作者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC编程复杂且依赖专家知识，LLM作为新兴工具展现出助手潜力，但缺乏对其应用于HPC领域的系统梳理，需要全面综述以厘清机遇与局限。

Method: 采用系统性综述方法，将LLM在HPC中的应用划分为五个类别（代码生成、并行化与优化、框架与架构、评估与基准测试、更广泛的挑战），并对各类别下的实例（如HPC-Coder、HPC-GPT、chatHPC）进行比较分析。

Result: 通用LLM在串行和OpenMP类任务上表现合理，但在MPI等分布式范式上正确性和可扩展性不足；领域专用模型通过微调、精选数据集和RAG达到更高精度，但适用范围窄且评估多限于基准测试或微内核。

Conclusion: LLM短期内不会取代HPC专家，但有望成为强大的协作工具；有效部署需要更丰富的数据集、与性能分析和调度器的集成、严格的评估框架以及保障透明度和信任的治理结构，AI与HPC的融合应视为长期的共同演化过程。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as promising assistants in High-Performance Computing (HPC), where programming remains complex and expertise-intensive. This survey systematically reviews their application across five categories: code generation, parallelization and optimization, frameworks and architectures, evaluation and benchmarking, and broader challenges. The analysis highlights both opportunities and limitations: while general-purpose LLMs perform reasonably well on serial and OpenMP-like tasks, they fall short in distributed paradigms such as MPI, where correctness and scalability are critical. Domain-specialized models (e.g., HPC-Coder, HPC-GPT, chatHPC) achieve higher accuracy through fine-tuning, curated datasets, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet their scope remains narrow and their evaluations largely limited to benchmarks or micro-kernels. The broader picture is one of dual potential and fragility: LLMs can lower barriers to entry, accelerate prototyping, and support code modernization, but they remain brittle under production-level requirements where correctness, performance portability, and scaling cannot be compromised.
  We conclude that LLMs are unlikely to replace HPC experts in the near term but are positioned to become powerful collaborators in the software development pipeline. Their effective deployment will require richer datasets, integration with performance analysis and schedulers, rigorous evaluation frameworks, and governance structures that ensure transparency and trust. The convergence of AI and HPC should therefore be understood as a long-term, co-evolutionary process, where each advance uncovers new challenges and opportunities for reshaping scientific software development.

</details>


### [463] [Multi-Dataset Inverse Problem Solving with Distributed Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26283)
*Daniel Lersch,Steven Goldenberg,Johann Rudi,Markus Diefenthaler,Kevin Brager,Xingfu Wu,Yaohang Li,Nobuo Sato*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种广义框架，将生成式AI反问题求解器扩展到多个异构数据集的联合分析中，每个数据集由不同的前向算子和判别器处理，但共享同一组未知推理参数，通过全局参数一致性来引导生成器。在受多探测器散射实验启发的受控设置中验证了方法的鲁棒性和多GPU扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从多个异构数据集中提取共享的未知不可直接测量量是跨科学领域的常见挑战。现有的分布式数据并行训练范式无法直接处理非独立同分布的数据集，而简单合并数据集或独立分析各有弊端——前者忽视数据异质性，后者无法利用互补信息，因此需要一种能够同时联合分析多个异构数据集的框架。

Method: 在一个已有的可扩展异步生成式反问题求解器（SAGIPS）框架基础上，将分布式数据并行训练范式扩展到非独立同分布的数据集场景。每个数据集配备各自的前向算子和判别器，提供互补约束，共同引导一个共享的生成器实现全局参数一致性。

Result: 在受多探测器散射实验启发的受控设置中验证了方法，数值结果表明该框架对源自探测器未知系统学效应的不同数据保真度具有鲁棒性，并在多GPU领导力计算系统上展示了良好的扩展性。

Conclusion: 该方法适用于实验条件跨测量变化的真实多数据集分析场景，为科学领域中异构数据联合分析提供了可行的生成式AI解决方案。

Abstract: Extracting a shared set of unknown, not directly measurable quantities from multiple, heterogeneous datasets is a common challenge across scientific domains. A prominent example is the combination of datasets obtained from different measurements with different settings (e.g. varying detector resolutions). Analyzing such datasets jointly, rather than independently or after naive merging, is essential for obtaining precise and unbiased estimates of the unknowns, but requires careful treatment of dataset heterogeneity and is computationally demanding. We present a generalized framework for simultaneously analyzing multiple heterogeneous datasets in the context of generative AI-based inverse problem solvers. Building on our recent Scalable Asynchronous Generative Inverse Problem Solver (SAGIPS) framework, we extend the well-established distributed data-parallel training paradigm to non-identically distributed datasets, where each dataset is controlled by the same set of unknown inference parameters but covers a different region of the available feature space. Each dataset is processed through its own forward operator and discriminator, providing complementary constraints that collectively guide a shared generator toward global parameter consistency. We validate the approach using a controlled setup inspired by a multi-detector scattering experiment. We provide numerical evidence that our framework is robust to different data fidelities, which arise from unknown detector systematics in the Rutherford experiment, and we show the scaling behavior on multi-GPU leadership computing systems. The results show that our approach is well suited for real-world multi-dataset analyses in which experimental conditions vary across measurements.

</details>


### [464] [VPP: Virtual Pipeline Parallelism for Efficient Chunked Prefill in Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26523)
*Yan Shi,Xiaochao Wang,Jingchun Gao,Jintao Luo,Xinyi Zhou,Feng Liu,Kui Luo,Xushi Li,Xinjie Guo,Liangjun Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出虚拟流水线并行（VPP），通过固定块大小的V形虚拟阶段遍历优化流水线布局，以解决分块预填充流水线并行中长序列负载不均衡导致的气泡问题。在vLLM-Ascend上基于三个MoE模型、最长1M token序列、16块Ascend 910C NPU的评估表明，VPP相比动态分块流水线并行（DCPP）在长序列上吞吐量提升最高13.1%，混合负载提升6.7%，在512K token DeepSeek-V3.1预填充场景中将流水线气泡比从6.4%降至0.1%（降低98.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPP是LLM推理的关键技术，但等尺寸分块存在延迟不均衡问题——后续分块需要关注更长的前缀KV缓存，注意力开销更高，导致流水线气泡。现有DCPP通过动态调整分块大小来缓解这种不均衡，但实测表明这种方案在长序列上以调度开销换取负载均衡，得不偿失。

Method: VPP保持分块大小固定，通过虚拟阶段优化流水线布局。具体包括：(1) V形虚拟阶段遍历，让每个分块昂贵的中间阶段与相邻分块较轻的头尾阶段重叠执行；(2) 异步通信减少通信停顿；(3) 流水线打包减少跨请求的排空气泡。

Result: 在vLLM-Ascend上使用三个MoE-based LLM，最长1M token序列，16块Ascend 910C NPU评估。VPP在长序列上比DCPP吞吐量提升最高13.1%，混合工作负载提升6.7%，短序列性能保持。在512K-token DeepSeek-V3.1预填充场景中，流水线气泡比从6.4%降至0.1%，实现98.0%的降低。

Conclusion: VPP通过固定块大小与V形虚拟阶段遍历的组合，在不引入动态分块调度开销的前提下有效消除了长序列分块预填充中的流水线气泡，显著优于DCPP，是长序列LLM推理场景下更具优势的并行策略。

Abstract: Chunked prefill pipeline parallelism (CPP) is a key technique for LLM inference. However, equal-size chunks exhibit imbalanced latency, as later chunks attend longer prefix KV caches and incur higher attention costs, leading to pipeline bubbles. Existing approaches mitigate this imbalance through dynamic chunk resizing (Dynamic CPP, DCPP), but our measurements show that this trades scheduling overhead for load balancing, which becomes unfavorable on long sequences. In this study, we propose Virtual Pipeline Parallelism (VPP), which keeps chunk sizes fixed and optimizes the pipeline layout through virtual stages. A V-shaped virtual-stage traversal overlaps each chunk's expensive middle stages with the lighter head and tail stages of its neighbors, while asynchronous communication and pipelined packing further reduce communication stalls and cross-request drain bubbles. We implement VPP in vLLM-Ascend and evaluate it on three MoE-based LLMs with sequences up to 1M tokens on 16 Ascend 910C NPUs. VPP improves throughput by up to 13.1% over DCPP on long sequences and 6.7% on mixed workloads, while preserving performance on short sequences. On a 512K-token DeepSeek-V3.1 prefill workload, VPP reduces the pipeline bubble ratio from 6.4% to 0.1%, achieving a 98.0% reduction compared with DCPP.

</details>


### [465] [Optimizing API Gateway Placement in Multi-Cloud Kubernetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26573)
*Vinoth Punniyamoorthy,Murali Shankar Dulam,Aswathnarayan Muthukrishnan Kirubakaran,Akshay Deshpande,Nachiappan Chockalingam,Bikesh Kumar,Naga Surya Pasupuleti,Narender Reddy Bitla*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出将API网关部署建模为带容量约束的设施选址问题，联合优化多集群Kubernetes中的网关副本数量与流量分配，给出MILP和贪心启发式两种解法，后者在3.2%-4.7%最优性差距下实现660x-3490x加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多云Kubernetes集群中部署API网关需要在基础设施成本、计算资源与网络延迟之间进行权衡，现有方法缺乏统一的优化框架来同时决策集群激活、副本数量与流量路由。

Method: 将问题建模为带容量约束的设施选址问题，约束包括客户端到集群的网络往返延迟上界（排除网关处理、排队和后端服务延迟）及网关副本容量利用率的头空间因子。提出MILP精确求解和按增量成本排序的贪心启发式算法，后者在分配容量时已考虑已承诺负载。

Result: 在种子可控的确定性合成实例上，贪心算法相对MILP最优解的最优性差距为3.2%-4.7%（单实例最大25.0%），加速比为660x-3490x（3-12个候选集群）。在10候选10需求区域的典型实例中，MILP最优部署比全复制基线节省24.2%月成本；选最便宜单集群可节省24.8%但不满足10个需求区域中3个的延迟要求。

Conclusion: 贪心启发式在大幅降低计算时间的同时保持接近最优的部署质量，且延迟约束对选址决策至关重要——仅追求成本最低可能违反关键区域的延迟要求，联合优化模型能有效平衡成本与延迟约束。

Abstract: The use of API gateways within geographically distributed multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters poses a tradeoff between infrastructure cost, computational resources, and network latencies. We present an optimization formulation that addresses API gateway placement as a capacitated facility location problem that jointly determines which candidate clusters to activate, how many gateway replicas to deploy, and how regional traffic should be distributed across the selected clusters. The formulation imposes an upper bound on estimated client-to-cluster network round-trip latency, excluding gateway processing, queuing, and backendservice latency, and incorporates a utilization headroom factor for gateway replica capacity. We present both a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation and a constructive greedy heuristic that ranks candidates according to incremental cost, comprising cluster-activation and marginal replica costs, per unit of assignable capacity while explicitly accounting for already committed load. Both formulations are applied to deterministic, seed-controlled, geography-based synthetic instances. For each problem size, 30 instances are generated with random seeds to analyze their performance. The greedy algorithm achieves an optimality gap of 3.2% to 4.7% to the MILP optimal solution, with a maximum observed gap of 25.0% for one particular instance, and a speedup of approximately 660x to 3,490x for 3 to 12 candidate clusters. In a canonical 10-candidate, 10-demand region instance, MILP-optimal deployment saves 24.2% in terms of monthly cost compared to the full-replication baseline. On the other hand, selecting the single cheapest candidate yields savings of 24.8% compared to the MILP optimum but does not satisfy the latency requirement for 3 out of 10 demand regions.

</details>


### [466] [Benchmarking Confidential Computing Performance on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26575)
*Daniyal Khan,Amean Asad,Ansgar Grunseid*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文测量了在NVIDIA B200 GPU上使用Intel TDX机密VM和NVIDIA CC（Blackwell GPU）运行大语言模型推理与训练时的性能开销。结果表明当配置正确时，机密推理吞吐量开销仅为1-3%；但默认推理栈配置不当会导致30-40%的性能损失。开销由两个独立维度决定：随批大小摊销的固定每主机操作成本和与NVLink加密流量成比例的每流量成本。文章还提供了可精确预测服务性能损失的微基准以及具体部署指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在云环境中广泛部署，数据隐私和模型机密性成为关键需求。可信执行环境（TEE）用于保护LLM推理和训练过程免受恶意管理程序或主机侧攻击，但此前缺乏对Blackwell GPU平台上机密计算性能开销的系统性量化研究。作者旨在通过严格控制变量的配对实验，精确测量并归因机密计算带来的性能成本。

Method: 作者在单台物理主机上设计了配对实验，唯一的变量是GPU CC位（confidential computing bit）和VM启动中的TDX guest对象。通过对比机密与非机密运行的性能差异，得出纯CC开销。进一步将总开销分解为两个独立轴：固定每主机操作成本（随批大小增长摊销）和每NVLink流量成本（追踪与加密集合通信时间成正比的份额），并通过微基准预测实际服务性能损失。

Result: 配置正确的机密推理在Blackwell上仅产生约1-3%的低个位数吞吐量开销；而使用默认推理栈时，由于可避免的配置问题会产生30-40%的性能代价（这并非硬件本身的可达性能上限）。GPU计算能力、能耗和可用内存容量不受CC影响。两个成本轴中哪个占主导取决于工作负载和软件栈。

Conclusion: 机密计算在Blackwell GPU上对LLM推理的性能代价可以控制在极低水平（1-3%），前提是正确配置软件栈；现有的默认配置存在显著可改进空间。作者将每种开销定位到具体的加密边界，提供了可预测服务罚分的微基准，并给出了具体的部署指导，为在实际生产环境中采用TEE保护LLM工作负载提供了可行路径。

Abstract: This paper measures the performance impact of running large language model inference and training inside a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, using Intel Trust Domain Extensions (TDX) confidential VMs together with NVIDIA Confidential Computing (CC) on Blackwell GPUs. The performance impact is derived from paired confidential versus non-confidential runs on a single physical host where the only variable is the GPU CC bit and the TDX guest object in the VM launch. The main result is that confidential inference on Blackwell achieves low single-digit throughput overhead when the stack is configured correctly, at about 1-3%. Stock inference stacks incur 30 to 40% penalties due to avoidable configurations rather than the achievable operating point. The cost is not fully represented by a single number because it is governed by two independent axes, a fixed per-host-operation cost that amortizes as batch size grows and a per-NVLink-traffic cost that tracks the share of the step spent in encrypted collectives, and which of the two dominates is set by the workload and the software. We localize each cost to a specific encrypted boundary, give a microbenchmark that predicts the serving penalty to within a submission count, and end with concrete deployment guidance. GPU compute, energy draw, and usable memory capacity are unaffected by CC.

</details>


### [467] [Sintr: Safe Interactive Transactions in the Presence of Byzantine Clients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27091)
*Austin T. Li,Daniel H. Lee,Lorenzo Alvisi,Natacha Crooks,Florian Suri-Payer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Sintr框架，用于解决客户端中心化BFT数据库系统中拜占庭客户端可能破坏数据库完整性的安全漏洞。Sintr通过冗余执行验证交易结果，并结合灵活的策略框架表达应用的数据完整性需求，对现有BFT数据库系统施加仅3%-16%的吞吐量开销和3%-21%的延迟开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BFT系统是涉及互不信任参与方的交易应用的有吸引力基础，但性能和开发者便利性是其两大障碍。近年系统通过客户端中心化架构（客户端本地并发执行交易，系统解决数据冲突以维持数据库可串行性）在这两方面取得进展。然而，这种架构引入了严重漏洞：数据库完整性暴露给可能发起恶意或错误交易的拜占庭客户端。

Method: Sintr框架通过两个核心机制保护数据库完整性：(1) 冗余执行——验证交易结果，检测恶意或错误交易；(2) 灵活的异构策略框架——用于表达应用的数据完整性需求。Sintr被应用于加固多个现有BFT数据库系统。

Result: 将Sintr应用到现有BFT数据库系统后，仅引入3%-16%的吞吐量开销和3%-21%的延迟开销，表明其保护机制是高效的。

Conclusion: Sintr有效解决了客户端中心化BFT系统面临拜占庭客户端威胁的完整性漏洞，在提供强大安全保证的同时保持可接受的性能开销，提升了BFT系统在实际交易应用中的可用性。

Abstract: Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) systems are, in principle, an appealing foundation for transactional applications involving mutually distrustful participants. Yet their adoption has been hampered by two persistent stumbling blocks-performance and developer convenience-which are often in tension with one another. Recent systems show promising progress on both fronts by shifting to a client-centric architecture; clients execute transactions locally and concurrently, while the system resolves any data conflicts to maintain database serializability. We argue that, in its current form, this approach introduces a critical vulnerability: it leaves the integrity of the database exposed to Byzantine clients, which may issue malicious or incorrect transactions. We address this threat with Sintr, a framework that prevents Byzantine clients from compromising database integrity by executing rogue transactions. Sintr combines redundant execution to validate transaction outcomes with a flexible, heterogeneous policy framework for expressing an application's data-integrity requirements. We apply Sintr to harden several existing BFT database systems and find that it imposes only modest overheads-3%-16% in throughput and 3%-21% in latency.

</details>


### [468] [Decoupled I/O-Dominant Pipelines for Large-Scale Whole-Slide Image Embedding Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27278)
*Mayanka Chandrashekar,Xi Zhang,Ethan Seefried,Tirthankar Ghosal,John Gounley,Heidi Hanson*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种解耦的、I/O感知的大规模全切片图像（WSI）嵌入提取流水线，将工作流分解为三个阶段：patch生成与暂存、并行嵌入推理、分片向量数据库摄入。该设计将数据移动与计算隔离，实现高效的多节点推理，最终生成一个紧凑且可复用的分布式向量数据库，用于检索、分类和少样本学习等下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSI尺寸过大，必须以patch为单位进行基础模型推理；然而在大规模场景下，海量patch的生成与处理会引入显著的I/O和编排开销，常常主导端到端性能，使WSI嵌入提取成为一个数据密集型而非纯计算密集型问题。

Method: 将WSI嵌入提取分解为三阶段解耦流水线：(1) patch生成与暂存阶段，负责数据准备；(2) 尴尬并行（embarrassingly parallel）的嵌入推理阶段，实现多节点高效推理且通信开销极小；(3) 分片向量数据库摄入阶段，将嵌入与丰富的元数据（患者、切片、patch属性）持久耦合存储。

Result: 实验表明，解耦I/O、计算与摄入三者能够实现高吞吐的WSI嵌入提取；通过刻画扩展（scaling）界限，揭示了在中高并发下存储成为主导瓶颈，即WSI嵌入提取本质上是数据中心的系统问题而非纯计算负载。

Conclusion: 将WSI嵌入提取重新定义为数据中心的系统问题，强调存储和I/O管理在规模化性能中的核心地位；所构建的表示数据库紧凑且可复用，尤其有利于低资源环境下的检索、分类和少样本学习任务。

Abstract: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are central to computational pathology but are prohibitively large, making patch-based processing the practical unit for foundation model inference. At scale, however, generating and handling massive numbers of patches on quickly introduces significant I/O and orchestration overhead, often dominating end-to-end performance. We present a decoupled, I/O-aware pipeline for large-scale WSI embedding extraction that decomposes the workflow into three stages: (1) patch generation and staging, (2) embarrassingly parallel embedding inference, and (3) sharded vector database ingestion. This design isolates data movement from compute, enabling efficient patch delivery, scalable multi-node inference with minimal communication. The resulting system produces a distributed vector database where embeddings are persistently coupled with rich metadata (e.g., patient, slide, and patch attributes), enabling efficient filtering, retrieval, and downstream reuse. This representation database is compact and reusable for tasks such as retrieval, classification, and few-shot learning, particularly benefiting low-resource environments. We show that decoupling I/O, computation, and ingestion enables high-throughput WSI embedding extraction at scale. By characterizing the scaling envelope, we demonstrate that storage dominates beyond moderate concurrency, reframing WSI embedding extraction as a data-centric systems problem rather than a purely compute-bound workload.

</details>


### [469] [Consensus with Stochastic Broadcast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27336)
*Pierre Fraigniaud,Boaz Patt-Shamir,Sergio Rajsbaum*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究随机广播模型下的二值共识问题。在n≥2个进程中，每轮每个进程向所有其他进程广播消息，每个广播以概率p独立成功。该模型下共识不可解，目标是为给定轮数r设计r轮终止的共识算法，最小化错误分歧概率。该问题已在2进程场景得到深入研究（DISC 2025），本文将其扩展到n>2场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将随机广播模型下的共识算法研究从2进程扩展到任意n>2进程，因为在现实分布式系统中通常涉及多于两个的进程，而此前的研究仅深入探索了2进程的情况。

Method: 在随机广播模型下，为n>2个进程设计给定轮数r内终止的共识算法，并最小化错误分歧（error/disagreement）的概率。该模型假设每轮每个进程向所有其他进程广播，每个广播独立以概率p成功；广播成功则所有进程收到消息，失败则无人收到，发送者无法得知结果。

Result: 本文扩展了此前2进程的研究成果（DISC 2025），为n>2进程的随机广播模型提出了新的共识算法并可能提供了相应的错误概率分析，具体结果需见论文正文。

Conclusion: 在随机广播模型下，由于共识不可解（存在不确定性），合理的替代目标是设计有限轮终止的算法并最小化错误分歧概率。本文将该研究从2进程推广至n>2进程，填补了该模型下多进程共识算法的空白。

Abstract: We study binary consensus in the \emph{stochastic broadcast model}, which assumes $n\geq 2$ processes communicating synchronously by message broadcasts. At each round, every process broadcasts a message to all the other processes. Each broadcast succeeds independently with some probability $p\in[0,1]$. If a broadcast succeeds, all processes receive the message, and if it fails, no process receives the message. The sender does not know whether its broadcast was successful or not. In this model, consensus is not solvable; the objective is to design, for a given number of rounds $r$, consensus algorithms that terminate in $r$ rounds, minimizing the probability of error disagreement. This problem has been studied in depth for 2 processes [DISC 2025]. We extend the study to $n> 2$.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.QM'></div>

# q-bio.QM [[Back]](#toc)

### [470] [Multimodal risk trajectories reveal heterogeneous paths to dementia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26210)
*Zhiqi Lee,Haowen Li,Tao Liu,Shiyuan Zhang,Bingjie Wang,Jinzhao Fan,Yunkai Zhang,Zhuonan Wang,Lijun Bai*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: NetMoint是一个多模态框架，整合血浆蛋白质组学、结构MRI和脑血流动力学表型数据，用于预测阿尔茨海默病(AD)、血管性痴呆(VD)和额颞叶痴呆(FTD)在1、5、10和20年时间窗内的个体化风险。在104,120名UK Biobank参与者中，AD、VD和FTD的AUC分别达到0.937、0.930和0.932，并揭示了随时间变化的生物学决定因素和亚型特异性的高风险轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 痴呆症在生物学上是异质性疾病，但现有的风险评估方法无法在临床诊断之前揭示亚型特异性风险如何产生和分化。需要一个能够整合多种模态数据、在多个时间尺度上区分不同痴呆亚型风险的多模态框架。

Method: 开发了NetMoint多模态框架，整合了部分观察到的血浆蛋白质组学、结构性MRI和脑血流动力学表型数据，在1-、5-、10-和20-年时间尺度上预测AD、VD和FTD的个体化风险。使用UK Biobank中104,120名基线无痴呆参与者进行训练和验证，并通过ADNI-to-UK Biobank独立分析进行外部验证（据138个共享特征进行协调化处理）。

Result: NetMoint在AD、VD和FTD上的平均AUC分别为0.937、0.930和0.932。预测的生物学决定因素随时间变化：短时间窗以结构性脑脆弱性为主，长时间窗转向循环分子特征，且具有亚型特异的生物学特征。多时间窗风险分析识别出不同的风险轨迹：AD发展者中0.7%呈持续极高风险轨迹（20年预测风险达53.50%），FTD发展者中8.3%呈上升极高风险轨迹（达67.17%）。高风险轨迹具有不同分子特征：AD组以低TGFB1为特征，FTD组以高NDRG1为特征。ADNI-to-UK Biobank外部验证中，20年AD预测AUC为0.741。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了轨迹分辨的痴呆风险分层多模态框架，能够识别各痴呆亚型中比例较小但风险极高的人群，并将其不同的风险轨迹与独特的分子特征联系起来，为痴呆症的个性化风险评估和早期干预提供了新的工具。

Abstract: Dementia comprises biologically heterogeneous disorders, yet current risk assessment provides limited insight into how subtype-specific risk emerges and diverges before clinical diagnosis. We developed NetMoint, a multimodal framework integrating partially observed plasma proteomic, structural magnetic resonance imaging and cerebral haemodynamic phenotypes to predict individualized risks of Alzheimer's disease (AD), vascular dementia (VD) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) across 1-, 5-, 10- and 20-year horizons. Among 104,120 UK Biobank participants free of dementia at baseline, NetMoint achieved mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.937, 0.930 and 0.932 for AD, VD and FTD, respectively. The biological determinants of prediction shifted with time, from structural brain vulnerability at shorter horizons towards circulating molecular signatures at longer horizons, with distinct subtype-specific biological profiles. Multi-horizon risk profiling identified distinct temporal trajectories of dementia susceptibility. Among participants who subsequently developed AD, 0.7% followed a persistently very-high-risk trajectory, with predicted risk reaching 53.50% at 20 years, whereas 8.3% of those who developed FTD followed an increasing very-high-risk trajectory, reaching 67.17%. These high-risk trajectories were marked by distinct molecular signatures, with lower TGFB1 characterizing the AD group and higher NDRG1 the FTD group. In an independent ADNI-to-UK Biobank analysis, AD risk prediction remained informative after harmonization to 138 shared features, with an AUC of 0.741 at 20 years. Together, these findings establish a multimodal framework for trajectory-resolved dementia risk stratification, identifying small but high-risk populations within dementia subtypes and linking their divergent risk trajectories to distinct molecular signatures.

</details>


### [471] [PathoMIC: A Benchmark for Cross-Species Antimicrobial Peptide Activity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26228)
*Yeqing Lu,Xiaoyan Zhao,Fuli Feng*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出PathoMIC，目前最大且最多样化的抗菌肽定量活性预测统一数据集，包含74751个MIC测量值和424个病原体物种，并建立跨物种Few-shot和Zero-shot评估协议，开发知识增强框架利用病原体描述与分类学关系实现知识迁移，显著提升低资源物种的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AMP-MIC预测器主要针对少数代表性病原体训练，很少利用物种间的生物学关系，导致对低资源和未见病原体的泛化能力受限。由于MIC在不同肽-病原体组合间差异显著，准确预测特定组合的MIC对候选先排序和避免昂贵实验验证至关重要。

Method: 构建统一化的PathoMIC数据集，整合肽序列、标准化MIC值、病原体描述和分类学关系；设计Few-shot和Zero-shot跨物种评估协议；提出知识增强框架，利用病原体描述和分类学信息促进相关物种间的知识迁移。

Result: 知识增强框架在低资源物种（少量监督）上取得显著改进；对完全未见物种的收益仍然有限，突显了Zero-shot跨物种MIC预测的挑战性。

Conclusion: PathoMIC为跨物种活性建模和病原体特异性虚拟筛选提供了标准化基础，并对未来研究方向（尤其是Zero-shot泛化）提出了明确的挑战和启示。

Abstract: With activity against multidrug-resistant pathogens and mechanisms distinct from conventional antibiotics, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer a promising approach to combating antibiotic-resistant infections. However, their potency varies substantially across pathogen species, making accurate prediction of the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) for specific peptide-pathogen pairs essential for prioritizing candidates before costly experimental validation. Existing predictors are trained mainly on a few well-represented pathogens and rarely exploit biological relationships across species, limiting their generalization to low-resource and unseen pathogens. We introduce PathoMIC, the largest and most pathogen-diverse unified dataset for quantitative antimicrobial peptide activity prediction, containing 74,751 experimentally reported MIC measurements across 424 pathogen species. PathoMIC integrates peptide sequences, standardized MIC values, pathogen descriptions, and taxonomic relationships to facilitate knowledge transfer across related species. We establish few-shot and zero-shot cross-species evaluation protocols and develop a knowledge-enhanced framework that leverages pathogen descriptions and taxonomy. The framework yields substantial improvements for low-resource species with limited supervision, while gains for entirely unseen species remain modest, highlighting the difficulty of zero-shot cross-species MIC prediction. PathoMIC provides a standardized foundation for cross-species activity modeling and pathogen-specific virtual screening. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathoMIC-546D/.

</details>


### [472] [Interpreting Latent Protein Language Model Features with Geometric Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26419)
*Siddharth Setlur,Djordje Mihajlovic,Darrick Lee*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化、可扩展的方法，利用蛋白质Cα主链的几何特征来解读ESM-2蛋白语言模型中稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征，实现残基级别的可解释性分析，并连接机制可解释性与结构生物学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白语言模型（pLM）的内部表示缺乏理解，稀疏自编码器（SAE）虽能解耦潜在表示，但现有注释管道依赖数据库标签和LLM的蛋白级别注释，无法捕捉稀疏特征编码的残基级别和几何模式。

Method: 利用蛋白质Cα主链的几何启发特征，在ESM-2 8M层上进行FDR控制的发现分析，评估局部几何与SAE特征的关联；通过消融实验在接触预测层面验证几何特征的因果作用，并扩展到未注释的宏基因组序列。

Result: 局部几何与大量SAE特征显著关联，且预测强度各异，扩展了超越数据库和序列方法的覆盖范围；几何能够区分共享同一数据库注释的SAE特征，揭示已知生物标签内的子结构；部分SAE特征激活于未注释的宏基因组蛋白序列；消融实验表明去除几何特征会使接触图预测朝描述符方向偏移。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了在残基级别注释SAE神经元激活蛋白的稳健途径，搭建了机制可解释性与结构生物学之间的桥梁。

Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) encode information about protein sequences which enable downstream tasks such as structure prediction, but their internal representations are not well understood. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising tool to disentangle latent pLM representations into interpretable features, but existing annotation pipelines largely rely on protein-level annotations derived from database labels and LLM annotations of top activating sequences. Such annotations can overlook the localized residue-level and geometric patterns encoded by sparse features. We introduce an automated and scalable method for interpreting SAE features in ESM-2 by using geometrically inspired features of the protein $\text{C}_α$ backbone. Across ESM-2 8M layers, an FDR-controlled discovery analysis shows that local geometry is significantly associated with many SAE features, with varying levels of predictive strength, expanding coverage beyond database and sequence-based methods. In particular, geometry can distinguish SAE features sharing the same database annotation, revealing substructure within known biological labels. A significant portion of SAE features activate on unannotated metagenomic protein sequences enabling us to use our SAE annotations to better understand these sequences. In addition, ablation experiments at the level of contact prediction show that removing found geometric features shifts ESM-2's predicted contact maps in the direction of the descriptor. This provides a robust method of annotating proteins activated within SAE neurons at a residue level, providing a bridge between mechanistic interpretability and structural biology.

</details>


### [473] [RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26586)
*Siyuan Ma,Yi Chai,Yi Wu,Qixin Zhang,Yajing Yuan,Kanglu Zhao,Zhikang Chen,Haowei Wang,Shuying Cao,Xiaolei Yu,Xiangfei Han,Yun Liu,Yang Liu,Tingting Zhu,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出RegimeFormer，一个大规模蛋白质扰动模型，结合RegimeAtlas数据库（覆盖202,556,313条非冗余蛋白质序列），通过百万级蛋白质子集进行高分辨率训练与推断，可在残基级别和替换特异性层面预测蛋白质扰动特征，并识别可复现的蛋白质扰动态势（regime），提升突变预测性能及下游转录组和药物响应建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型虽能组织序列与结构信息，但缺乏一个全局性的、表征蛋白质如何响应突变（扰动）的统一表示。作者旨在弥合这一空白，构建面向全序列空间的蛋白质扰动景观。

Method: 构建RegimeAtlas数据库（整合并索引2亿余条非冗余蛋白质序列，覆盖生命之树），从中抽取保留多样性的百万级蛋白质子集作为高分辨率训练与推断层；995,995个蛋白质生成407,048,356个残基级扰动摘要，并提供替换特异性预测。通过实验深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信与进化约束等数据，训练RegimeFormer识别蛋白质级扰动态势（regime），用于组织残基脆弱性、适应性与预测不确定性；以regime作为条件改进替换特异性预测，并将导出的分子先验用于下游转录组和药物响应建模。

Result: RegimeFormer能够识别可复现的蛋白质级扰动态势；Regime条件化显著提升替换特异性预测，在未见蛋白质、未见家族和低同源性评估场景中相对增益最大；其分子先验进一步改善了下游转录组与药物响应建模。

Conclusion: RegimeFormer与RegimeAtlas共同构成一个可扩展的框架，用于在全局序列空间中绘制、预测和查询蛋白质扰动景观，为突变效应的系统化理解与应用提供支撑。

Abstract: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.

</details>


### [474] [DINIRS: Digital Twin for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26915)
*Md Fantacher Islam,Jarrod Mosier,Vignesh Subbian*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本研究开发并验证了DINIRS框架，一种基于数字孪生的个体化治疗效果估计方法，用于识别急性呼吸衰竭患者中哪些人更能从无创呼吸支持（NIRS）而非有创机械通气（IMV）中获益。基于MIMIC-IV和eICU-CRD两个大型重症数据库，DINIRS策略平均每名患者增加2.07个呼吸机自由日，且发现NIRS获益主要源于幸存者通气时长缩短而非死亡率降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急性呼吸衰竭患者在选择无创呼吸支持（NIRS）与有创机械通气（IMV）之间面临复杂且时间敏感的决策，治疗效果在不同患者亚组间存在异质性。现有临床试验和指南仅提供群体层面的指导，无法明确哪些患者从NIRS中获益更多，因此需要个体化治疗效果（ITE）估计方法。

Method: 基于MIMIC-IV中5,336名急性呼吸衰竭患者的23项ICU首24小时基线临床变量，训练DINIRS框架。采用带生存注意力门的Transformer编码器，将28天呼吸机自由日（VFD-28）分解为生存概率和条件通气时长两个部分；使用交叉拟合的双稳健学习器估计个体化治疗效果（ITEs）。在包含2,540名患者的多中心eICU-CRD数据集上进行外部验证。

Result: DINIRS策略相较实际临床实践，平均每名患者获益2.07个呼吸机自由日（每100名患者207天）。预测NIRS获益在器官功能障碍较轻的患者中更高（88.4%对比49.0%），且该模式在不同低氧血症严重程度下持续存在。外部验证无需重新训练即可复现该模式。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了利用ICU数据可实现对NIRS获益的个体化估计，NIRS的获益主要来源于避免插管相关并发症带来的幸存者通气时长缩短，而非降低死亡率。在将这些估计用于指导临床治疗决策前，仍需前瞻性验证。

Abstract: Objective: Choosing between noninvasive respiratory support (NIRS) and invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) for patients with acute respiratory failure is a complex, time-sensitive decision with heterogeneous treatment effects across patient subgroups. Although clinical trials and guidelines provide population-level guidance, it remains unclear which patients benefit more from NIRS than IMV. We developed and validated a censoring-aware Digital Twin framework for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support (DINIRS) to estimate individualized treatment effects (ITEs) that capture mortality and ventilation duration.
  Materials and Methods: We trained DINIRS on 23 baseline clinical variables from the first 24 ICU hours in 5,336 MIMIC-IV patients with acute respiratory failure. We used a transformer encoder with a survival attention gate to decompose 28-day ventilator-free days (VFD-28) into survival probability and conditional ventilation duration. A cross-fitted, doubly robust learner estimated ITEs. We externally validated DINIRS in 2,540 patients from the multi-site eICU-CRD dataset.
  Results: The DINIRS policy achieved a mean benefit of 2.07 ventilator-free days per patient (207 per 100 patients) compared with the observed practice. Predicted NIRS benefit was higher among patients with less organ dysfunction (88.4% versus 49.0%) and persisted across hypoxemia severity. External validation reproduced this pattern without retraining.
  Discussion: Our analysis revealed that the NIRS benefit stemmed from shorter ventilation among survivors rather than from reduced mortality, indicating that avoiding intubation-associated complications was the primary mechanism.
  Conclusion: This study demonstrated individualized estimation of NIRS benefit using ICU data, though prospective validation is needed before these estimates inform treatment decisions.

</details>


### [475] [Surf_2_Volume: a workflow for converting CIFTI parcellations to NIfTI volume space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27012)
*Shuguang Yang,Ziyi Wang,Yujing Shen,Junyi Li,Yujing Nie,Feizhen Cao,Suiping Wang*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出Surf_2_Volume工作流，将CIFTI格式的皮层和皮层下脑分区图像转换为NIfTI体素格式，通过整合Connectome Workbench、FreeSurfer、AFNI、neuromaps和Python图像处理工具，在两项独立的分区图集评估中均取得了优于现有Workbench设置的调整Dice分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIFTI格式的分区图像无法被许多需要体素（volume）输入的分析程序直接使用，而现有的转换方法在映射过程中可能使皮层灰质体素未被标记或使标签分配到灰质之外，导致转换精度不足。

Method: 该工作流首先将皮层和皮层下组件分离，通过fsaverage和MNI152模板的表面表示传递皮层标签，利用可调节的概率阈值限制灰质内的体素赋值，最后重新组合各组件，输出NIfTI格式文件。

Result: 使用Cole-Anticevic脑宽网络分区时，Surf_2_Volume的调整Dice分数为0.776，而评估的Connectome Workbench设置最高仅为0.637；在Schaefer 2018 17网络体积图集测试中，Surf_2_Volume为0.727，最优Workbench设置为0.535。两项评估中Surf_2_Volume均优于所有Workbench设置。

Conclusion: 该工作流为需要NIfTI输入的分析软件提供了使用表面分区的可行方案，同时允许对灰质覆盖范围进行显式控制，提升了转换的准确性和灵活性。

Abstract: Parcellations distributed in Connectivity Informatics Technology Initiative (CIFTI) format cannot be used directly in many analysis programs that require volume input. Existing conversion options may leave voxels in cortical gray matter unlabeled or assign labels outside gray matter, depending on the mapping parameters. We present Surf_2_Volume, a workflow that combines Connectome Workbench, FreeSurfer, AFNI, neuromaps, and Python image processing to convert cortical and subcortical CIFTI parcellations into Neuroimaging Informatics Technology Initiative (NIfTI) volumes. The workflow separates cortical and subcortical components, transfers cortical labels through fsaverage and a surface representation of the target MNI152 template, restricts voxel assignment using an adjustable probability threshold for gray matter, and recombines the components. Using the Cole-Anticevic Brain-wide Network Partition, Surf_2_Volume had an adjusted Dice score of 0.776, compared with a maximum of 0.637 among the evaluated Connectome Workbench settings. In a separate test using the Schaefer 2018 17-network volume atlas, the scores were 0.727 for Surf_2_Volume and 0.535 for the best Workbench setting. Across both atlas evaluations, Surf_2_Volume had higher adjusted Dice scores than the evaluated Workbench settings. The workflow provides a way to use surface parcellations in software that requires NIfTI input while allowing explicit control over gray matter coverage.

</details>

### [476] [Hysteresis and multistability in network spreading with neuronal activity feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26528)
*Christoffer G. Alexandersen,Dani S. Bassett*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该论文研究网络中扩散过程与活动过程之间的非线性反馈，证明非线性反馈可从根本上改变入侵动力学，产生有限振幅入侵阈值、滞回和多重稳定性，并在神经退行性疾病背景下得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经退行性疾病中，病理蛋白通过解剖连接扩散，而神经元活动既受影响又反过来影响蛋白扩散，形成扩散-活动反馈回路。然而现有模型大多仅考虑两个过程之间的线性反馈，忽略了非线性反馈可能带来的动力学复杂性。

Method: 在一般加权网络上，将易感-感染-易感（SIS）扩散过程与共同演化的活动过程耦合，系统分析非线性反馈的强度和形状对入侵动力学的影响。在规则图上进行数学分析（排除周期解，建立多项式耦合函数阶数与地方性状态数量的约束），并在二次积分-发射（QIF）神经网络的随机脉冲仿真中进行验证。

Result: 非线性反馈可在一般加权网络中产生有限振幅入侵阈值、滞回现象和地方性多重稳定性。在规则图中，多项式耦合函数的阶数限制了地方性稳定状态的数量，单调耦合需要增强反馈才能产生多重稳定性。QIF神经网络仿真中恢复了有限振幅入侵阈值和地方性双稳态。

Conclusion: 活动过程的反馈可以在网络扩散动力学中创造滞回和多重稳定性。在神经科学应用中，神经元动力学可能成为神经退行性疾病的一个控制点，即使活动的短暂变化也能使大脑在健康和疾病状态之间切换。

Abstract: Spreading processes on networks often interact with other dynamics on the same nodes. Neurodegenerative disease provides one example: pathological proteins spread through anatomical connections, while neuronal activity influences and is altered by their spread, forming a spreading-activity feedback loop. However, models coupling pathological protein spreading and neuronal activity have largely focused on linear feedback between the two processes. Here we show that nonlinear feedback can fundamentally change the invasion dynamics in a susceptible--infected--susceptible spreading process coupled to a co-evolving activity process. On general weighted networks, the strength and shape of the feedback may generate finite-amplitude invasion thresholds, hysteresis, and endemic multistability. On regular graphs with homogeneous dynamics, we rule out periodic solutions and show that the degrees of polynomial coupling functions bound the number of endemic states, while monotone couplings require reinforcing feedback for multistability. We test these predictions in simulations of a stochastic spiking neuronal network described by quadratic integrate-and-fire dynamics, where we recover both finite-amplitude invasion thresholds and endemic bistability. These results show that feedback from activity processes can create hysteresis and multistability in network spreading dynamics. In neuroscientific applications, our work suggests that neuronal dynamics may act as a control point in neurodegenerative disease, with even transient changes in activity capable of tipping the brain between health and disease.

</details>


### [477] [Beta oscillation changes in ALS: A Dual-Site International Replication Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27003)
*Marit Boxum,Gabriel Rodrigues Palma,Robin Jansen,Iris A. Bastmeijer,Sanya Dalal,Eva Woods,Narin Suleyman,Eileen Rose Giglia,Aoife Troy,Abby Field,Serena Plaitano,Marjorie Metzger,Niall Pender,Orla Hardiman,Leonard H. van den Berg,Roisin McMackin,Stefan Dukic*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究旨在验证ALS患者在SART任务中β波段事件相关去同步化（ERD）减弱和事件相关同步化（ERS）增强的先前发现，在荷兰和爱尔兰两个独立队列中进行128通道EEG验证。结果在健康对照中可靠复现了theta ERS、alpha/beta ERD及beta ERS的时空模式；但ERD/ERS的ALS组间差异仅在爱尔兰队列复现，荷兰队列未见显著差异，且队列间的功能损伤差异至少部分解释了这种不一致性。研究支持这些EEG指标可作为反映ALS皮质运动网络功能障碍的可靠标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ALS患者运动与认知功能障碍需要可重复的生物标志物进行客观监测，此前已有研究发现ALS患者在前额和顶叶通道中β波段ERD减弱、运动后ERS减弱，但这些发现尚未在独立队列中得到验证，因此亟需跨队列验证其可重复性和可靠性。

Method: 在荷兰（ALS n=63，匹配对照n=64）和爱尔兰（ALS n=36，对照n=36）两个队列中进行随机化SART任务结合128通道EEG记录。使用复Morlet小波计算非锁相活动的基线归一化刺激后ERD和ERS，对Go和NoGo试验分别检验组间差异以及EEG与任务表现的关联。

Result: 两个对照队列均可靠复现了theta ERS、alpha和beta频段ERD以及随后的beta ERS反弹沿额顶轴的经典时空模式，且NoGo试验的theta ERS更强、alpha ERD更强而beta ERS更弱。与先前零结果不同，两个中心的ALS患者均表现出降低的Go准确率与总准确率（p<0.002），爱尔兰队列还出现Go反应减慢（p=0.02）。ALS队列间在NoGo准确率、Go反应时间和预期错误上存在差异。beta ERD/ERS减弱仅在一个队列复现。两个中心均发现更强的beta ERS与更快的Go反应相关（p<0.011）。

Conclusion: 健康对照的EEG模式具有跨队列可重复性，且beta ERS与运动表现存在一致关联，表明这些指标能够可靠捕获ALS患者的皮质运动网络功能障碍，支持将其作为监测ALS运动功能衰退的EEG标志物。但ALS组间效应的跨队列复现性受功能损伤差异影响，提示后续研究需注意队列异质性。

Abstract: Reproducible biomarkers that monitor motor and cognitive dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are needed. Previous work reported reduced beta-band event-related desynchronization (ERD) and attenuated post-movement event-related synchronization (ERS) in frontal and parietal channels during the sustained attention to response task (SART). We aimed to validate these findings in Dutch and Irish cohorts. A randomized SART with 128-channel electroencephalography (EEG) was performed in Dutch (ALS n=63; matched controls n=64) and Irish (ALS n=36; controls n=36) cohorts. Non-phase-locked activity was quantified using complex Morlet wavelets to compute baseline-normalized post-stimulus ERD and ERS. Group differences and EEG associations with task performance were examined for Go and NoGo trials. In both control cohorts, the SART elicited theta ERS and alpha- and beta-band ERD, followed by rebound beta ERS across the frontoparietal axis, with greater theta ERS, stronger alpha ERD, and weaker beta ERS on NoGo than Go trials. In contrast to previous null findings, people with ALS showed reduced Go and total accuracy in both centres (p<0.002) and slower Go responses in the Irish cohort (p=0.02). The ALS cohorts differed in NoGo accuracy, Go response time, and anticipation errors (all p=0.03). Replicating prior work, the Irish ALS cohort showed reduced beta ERD and ERS versus controls, with no such differences in the Dutch cohort. Greater beta ERS was associated with faster Go responses in both centres (p<0.011). ERD and ERS changes replicated in the Irish but not the Dutch cohort. Cohort differences in these metrics reflected, at least in part, varying functional impairment. Reproducible control findings and consistent associations with motor performance indicate reliable capture of cortical motor network dysfunction, supporting these measures as EEG markers of motor decline in ALS.

</details>
